# Plugin reconfiguration can leave active farming without swap hooks
**#214903**
- Severity: Medium
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/core/contracts/AlgebraPool.sol` (2 locations)
#### Lines 327-332 — _afterSwap is skipped entirely when the pool configuration omits AFTER_SWAP_FLAG._

```
  function _afterSwap(address recipient, bool zto, int256 amount, uint160 limitPrice, int256 amount0, int256 amount1, bytes calldata data) internal {
    if (globalState.pluginConfig.hasFlag(Plugins.AFTER_SWAP_FLAG)) {
      IAlgebraPlugin(plugin).afterSwap(msg.sender, recipient, zto, amount, limitPrice, amount0, amount1, data).shouldReturn(
        IAlgebraPlugin.afterSwap.selector
      );
    }
```
⋯
#### Lines 413-426 — _Pool plugin/configuration administration can clear or change hook flags without invoking plugin reconciliation._

```
  function setPlugin(address newPluginAddress) external override onlyUnlocked {
    _checkIfAdministrator();
    _setPluginConfig(0);
    _setPlugin(newPluginAddress);
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPoolPermissionedActions
  function setPluginConfig(uint8 newConfig) external override onlyUnlocked {
    address _plugin = plugin;
    if (_plugin == address(0)) revert pluginIsNotConnected(); // it is not allowed to set plugin config without plugin

    if (msg.sender != _plugin) _checkIfAdministrator();

    _setPluginConfig(newConfig);
```
### `src/plugin/contracts/AlgebraBasePluginV1.sol` (2 locations)
#### Lines 188-219 — _The incentive survives plugin detachment and reconciliation runs only when setting an incentive while attached._

```
  function setIncentive(address newIncentive) external override {
    bool toConnect = newIncentive != address(0);
    bool accessAllowed;
    if (toConnect) {
      accessAllowed = msg.sender == IBasePluginV1Factory(pluginFactory).farmingAddress();
    } else {
      // we allow the one who connected the incentive to disconnect it,
      // even if he no longer has the rights to connect incentives
      if (_lastIncentiveOwner != address(0)) accessAllowed = msg.sender == _lastIncentiveOwner;
      if (!accessAllowed) accessAllowed = msg.sender == IBasePluginV1Factory(pluginFactory).farmingAddress();
    }
    require(accessAllowed, 'Not allowed to set incentive');

    bool isPluginConnected = _getPluginInPool() == address(this);
    if (toConnect) require(isPluginConnected, 'Plugin not attached');

    address currentIncentive = incentive;
    require(currentIncentive != newIncentive, 'Already active');
    if (toConnect) require(currentIncentive == address(0), 'Has active incentive');

    incentive = newIncentive;
    emit Incentive(newIncentive);

    if (toConnect) {
      _lastIncentiveOwner = msg.sender; // write creator of this incentive
    } else {
      _lastIncentiveOwner = address(0);
    }

    if (isPluginConnected) {
      _updatePluginConfigInPool();
    }
```
⋯
#### Lines 217-229 — _The plugin only repairs config during its own incentive transition and reports false when detached or hook-disabled._ — _The code detects the mismatch in isIncentiveConnected but does not enforce it during farming._

```
    if (isPluginConnected) {
      _updatePluginConfigInPool();
    }
  }

  /// @inheritdoc IFarmingPlugin
  function isIncentiveConnected(address targetIncentive) external view override returns (bool) {
    if (incentive != targetIncentive) return false;
    if (_getPluginInPool() != address(this)) return false;
    (, , , uint8 pluginConfig) = _getPoolState();
    if (!pluginConfig.hasFlag(Plugins.AFTER_SWAP_FLAG)) return false;

    return true;
```
## Description

Administrative calls can detach or replace a plugin through `setPlugin`, which clears the pool configuration, or can independently alter the configuration through `setPluginConfig`. A nonzero `incentive` remains in the old plugin, but `_updatePluginConfigInPool` is only called by `setIncentive` when that plugin is attached. Consequently, reattaching the same plugin can leave its incentive active while `AFTER_SWAP_FLAG` remains unset; the same inconsistency can result from disabling that flag directly. The pool then skips `afterSwap`, because `_afterSwap` dispatches the plugin hook only when `AFTER_SWAP_FLAG` is enabled. Although `isIncentiveConnected` identifies the detached or hook-disabled state, the supplied findings state that farming entry and update flows do not enforce this invariant.
## Root cause

Pool plugin attachment and hook-configuration changes are not synchronized with the stored `incentive` and farming state, while farming flows do not require `isIncentiveConnected`.
## Impact

Farms can remain recorded as active while swaps no longer advance the associated virtual pool, so rewards and position accounting can diverge from actual pool activity. Farming operations may continue against stale virtual state until an administrator restores the plugin configuration or farming explicitly disconnects the incentive, making the affected farming accounting unavailable or unreliable.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { ZeroHash } from 'ethers';

import { algebraFixture, BNe18, expect, FeeAmount, getMaxTick, getMinTick, TICK_SPACINGS } from './shared';
import { ActorFixture } from './shared/actors';
import { HelperCommands } from './helpers';

describe('PoC: active farming can outlive the pool afterSwap hook', () => {
  it('keeps farming active and stale after an administrator disables AFTER_SWAP_FLAG', async () => {
    const context = await loadFixture(algebraFixture);
    const wallets = (await ethers.getSigners()) as any;
    const actors = new ActorFixture(wallets, ethers.provider);
    const helpers = HelperCommands.fromTestContext(context as any, actors, ethers.provider);
    const pool = context.poolObj.connect(ethers.provider);

    const narrowTicks: [number, number] = [-120, 120];
    const farmAmounts: [bigint, bigint] = [BNe18(10), BNe18(10)];

    // Non-farmed, wider liquidity keeps the real pool swappable after it crosses
    // the farmed virtual pool's initialized top tick.
    await helpers.mintFlow({
      lp: actors.lpUser1(),
      tokens: [context.token0, context.token1],
      amounts: [BNe18(1_000), BNe18(1_000)],
      tickLower: getMinTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]),
      tickUpper: getMaxTick(TICK_SPACINGS[FeeAmount.MEDIUM]),
      fee: FeeAmount.MEDIUM,
    });

    const incentive = await helpers.createIncentiveFlow({
      poolAddress: context.pool01,
      rewardToken: context.rewardToken,
      bonusRewardToken: context.bonusRewardToken,
      totalReward: BNe18(1_000),
      bonusReward: BNe18(1_000),
      nonce: await context.eternalFarming.numOfIncentives(),
      rewardRate: 10,
      bonusRewardRate: 0,
      minimalPositionWidth: 0,
    });
    const virtualPoolAddress = await incentive.virtualPool.getAddress();

    await helpers.mintDepositFarmFlow({
      lp: actors.lpUser0(),
      tokensToFarm: [context.token0, context.token1],
      amountsToFarm: farmAmounts,
      ticks: narrowTicks,
      createIncentiveResult: incentive,
    });

    const connectedConfig = Number((await pool.globalState()).pluginConfig);
    expect(connectedConfig & 2).to.equal(2);
    expect(await context.pluginObj.incentive()).to.equal(virtualPoolAddress);
    expect(await context.pluginObj.isIncentiveConnected(virtualPoolAddress)).to.equal(true);
    expect(await context.farmingCenter.virtualPoolAddresses(context.pool01)).to.equal(virtualPoolAddress);

    // Vulnerable public administration path: setPluginConfig can independently
    // remove AFTER_SWAP_FLAG. It does not clear plugin.incentive or the farming
    // center's virtual pool mapping.
    const pluginDefaultConfigWithoutFarming = Number(await context.pluginObj.defaultPluginConfig());
    expect(pluginDefaultConfigWithoutFarming & 2).to.equal(0);
    await pool.connect(context.ownerSigner).setPluginConfig(pluginDefaultConfigWithoutFarming);

    const disconnectedConfig = Number((await pool.globalState()).pluginConfig);
    expect(disconnectedConfig & 2).to.equal(0);
    expect(await context.pluginObj.incentive()).to.equal(virtualPoolAddress);
    expect(await context.farmingCenter.virtualPoolAddresses(context.pool01)).to.equal(virtualPoolAddress);
    expect(await context.pluginObj.isIncentiveConnected(virtualPoolAddress)).to.equal(false);

    // Farming entry still succeeds against the recorded incentive even though
    // the plugin itself reports that the incentive is not connected.
    const enteredWhileHookDisabled = await helpers.mintDepositFarmFlow({
      lp: actors.lpUser2(),
      tokensToFarm: [context.token0, context.token1],
      amountsToFarm: farmAmounts,
      ticks: narrowTicks,
      createIncentiveResult: incentive,
    });
    expect(await context.farmingCenter.deposits(enteredWhileHookDisabled.tokenId)).to.not.equal(ZeroHash);

    const staleVirtualTick = await incentive.virtualPool.globalTick();
    expect(staleVirtualTick).to.be.lt(120);

    // Move the real pool across the farm's upper initialized virtual tick. With
    // AFTER_SWAP_FLAG removed, AlgebraPool._afterSwap skips AlgebraBasePluginV1.afterSwap,
    // so EternalVirtualPool.crossTo is not called.
    await helpers.moveTickTo({
      desiredValue: 180,
      trader: actors.traderUser0(),
    });

    const realTickAfterSwap = (await pool.globalState()).tick;
    expect(realTickAfterSwap).to.be.gte(120);
    expect(await incentive.virtualPool.globalTick()).to.equal(staleVirtualTick);

    // The stale farm remains recorded rather than being rejected or disconnected.
    expect(await context.pluginObj.incentive()).to.equal(virtualPoolAddress);
    expect(await context.farmingCenter.virtualPoolAddresses(context.pool01)).to.equal(virtualPoolAddress);
    expect(await context.pluginObj.isIncentiveConnected(virtualPoolAddress)).to.equal(false);
  });
});

It demonstrates the direct `setPluginConfig` hook-disable variant of the finding, not the alternative `setPlugin` detach/reattach variant. The Hardhat Node.js v24 unsupported-version warning was emitted but did not affect compilation or execution.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Treat an incentive as deactivated whenever its recorded plugin no longer reports the virtual pool as connected, including plugin replacement/detachment and removal of AFTER_SWAP_FLAG. Existing farming entry and update paths already gate behavior through _isIncentiveDeactivated, so this central invariant check prevents entry and stale-state updates while preserving normal connected farming.
### Patch

```diff

--- a/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol
+++ b/src/farming/contracts/farmings/AlgebraEternalFarming.sol
@@ -1,499 +1,501 @@

   function createEternalFarming(
     IncentiveKey memory key,
     IncentiveParams memory params,
     address plugin
   ) external override onlyIncentiveMaker returns (address virtualPool) {
     address connectedPlugin = key.pool.plugin();
     if (connectedPlugin != plugin || connectedPlugin == address(0)) revert pluginNotConnected();
     if (IFarmingPlugin(connectedPlugin).incentive() != address(0)) revert anotherFarmingIsActive();
 
     virtualPool = address(new EternalVirtualPool(address(this), connectedPlugin));
     IFarmingCenter(farmingCenter).connectVirtualPoolToPlugin(virtualPool, IFarmingPlugin(connectedPlugin));
 
     key.nonce = numOfIncentives++;
     bytes32 incentiveId = IncentiveId.compute(key);
     Incentive storage newIncentive = incentives[incentiveId];
 
     (params.reward, params.bonusReward) = _receiveRewards(key, params.reward, params.bonusReward, newIncentive);
     if (params.reward == 0) revert zeroRewardAmount();

     newIncentive.minimalPositionWidth = params.minimalPositionWidth;
     newIncentive.pluginAddress = connectedPlugin;

       key.rewardToken,
       key.bonusRewardToken,
       key.pool,
       virtualPool,
       key.nonce,
       params.reward,
       params.bonusReward,
       params.minimalPositionWidth

     _setRewardRates(IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(virtualPool), params.rewardRate, params.bonusRewardRate, incentiveId);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   function deactivateIncentive(IncentiveKey memory key) external override onlyIncentiveMaker {
     (bytes32 incentiveId, Incentive storage incentive) = _getExistingIncentiveByKey(key);
     // if the virtual pool is deactivated automatically, it is still possible to correctly deactivate it manually
     if (incentive.deactivated) revert incentiveStopped();
 
     IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool virtualPool = IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(incentive.virtualPoolAddress);
     IFarmingPlugin plugin = IFarmingPlugin(incentive.pluginAddress);
 
     incentive.deactivated = true;
     virtualPool.deactivate();
 
     (uint128 rewardRate0, uint128 rewardRate1) = virtualPool.rewardRates();
     if (rewardRate0 | rewardRate1 != 0) _setRewardRates(virtualPool, 0, 0, incentiveId);
 
     IFarmingCenter(farmingCenter).disconnectVirtualPoolFromPlugin(address(virtualPool), plugin);
 
     emit IncentiveDeactivated(incentiveId);

   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraEternalFarming
   function decreaseRewardsAmount(IncentiveKey memory key, uint128 rewardAmount, uint128 bonusRewardAmount) external override onlyAdministrator {
     (bytes32 incentiveId, Incentive storage incentive) = _getExistingIncentiveByKey(key);
     IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool virtualPool = IAlgebraEternalVirtualPool(incentive.virtualPoolAddress);
 
     _distributeRewards(virtualPool);
     (uint128 rewardReserve0, uint128 rewardReserve1) = virtualPool.rewardReserves();
     if (rewardAmount > rewardReserve0) rewardAmount = rewardReserve0;
     if (rewardAmount >= incentive.totalReward) rewardAmount = incentive.totalReward - 1; // to not trigger 'non-existent incentive'
     incentive.totalReward = incentive.totalReward - rewardAmount;
 
     if (bonusRewardAmount > rewardReserve1) bonusRewardAmount = rewardReserve1;
     incentive.bonusReward = incentive.bonusReward - bonusRewardAmount;
 
     virtualPool.decreaseRewards(rewardAmount, bonusRewardAmount);
 
     if (rewardAmount > 0) TransferHelper.safeTransfer(address(key.rewardToken), msg.sender, rewardAmount);
     if (bonusRewardAmount > 0) TransferHelper.safeTransfer(address(key.bonusRewardToken), msg.sender, bonusRewardAmount);
 
     emit RewardAmountsDecreased(rewardAmount, bonusRewardAmount, incentiveId);
   }

# Zero-valued Algebra fee proposals cannot be created
**#214910**
- Severity: Medium
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol` (3 locations)
#### Lines 26-29 — _A separate boolean records proposal presence while the proposal value defaults to zero._

```
  /// @notice Represents whether there is a new Algebra fee proposal or not
  bool public hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal;
  /// @notice Suggested Algebra fee value
  uint16 public proposedNewAlgebraFee;
```
⋯
#### Lines 94-102 — _Only an accepted stored proposal can update the active fee, and acceptance clears the proposal value back to zero._ — _Acceptance updates the active fee and restores the proposal value to zero._

```
  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
  function acceptAlgebraFeeChangeProposal(uint16 newAlgebraFee) external override onlyAdministrator {
    require(hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal, 'not proposed');
    require(newAlgebraFee == proposedNewAlgebraFee, 'invalid new fee');

    // note that the new value will be used for previously accumulated tokens that have not yet been withdrawn
    algebraFee = newAlgebraFee;
    (proposedNewAlgebraFee, hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal) = (0, false);
    emit AlgebraFee(newAlgebraFee);
```
⋯
#### Lines 128-139 — _The proposal guard compares against the zero-valued storage field irrespective of proposal presence, and cancellation resets that field to zero._ — _The proposal range and inequality checks reject zero when the cleared proposal value is zero._ — _The zero proposal is rejected because `proposedNewAlgebraFee` is normally zero, before the proposal flag can be set._ — _The value-only duplicate check rejects a clean-state zero proposal._ — _Cancellation restores the zero proposal sentinel, reintroducing the same blocked state._ — _Cancellation also restores the zero sentinel and clears the presence flag._

```
function proposeAlgebraFeeChange(uint16 newAlgebraFee) external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
  require(newAlgebraFee <= ALGEBRA_FEE_DENOMINATOR);
  require(newAlgebraFee != proposedNewAlgebraFee && newAlgebraFee != algebraFee);
  (proposedNewAlgebraFee, hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal) = (newAlgebraFee, true);
  emit AlgebraFeeProposal(newAlgebraFee);
}

function cancelAlgebraFeeChangeProposal() external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
  (proposedNewAlgebraFee, hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal) = (0, false);
  emit CancelAlgebraFeeProposal();
```
### `src/core/contracts/interfaces/vault/IAlgebraCommunityVault.sol`
#### Lines 85-91 — _The interface exposes fee proposals and cancellation without excluding zero._

```
### `src/core/test/AlgebraVault.spec.ts`
#### Lines 326-350 — _Tests verify the zero default and cancellation reset but do not exercise proposing zero from an active-fee/no-pending-proposal state._

```
    it('can propose new fee and cancel proposal', async () => {
      expect(await vault.proposedNewAlgebraFee()).to.be.eq(0);
      expect(await vault.hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal()).to.be.eq(false);

      await expect(vault.connect(other).proposeAlgebraFeeChange(ALGEBRA_FEE)).to.be.revertedWith(
        'only algebra fee manager'
      );
      await expect(vault.proposeAlgebraFeeChange(1001)).to.be.reverted;

      await vault.proposeAlgebraFeeChange(ALGEBRA_FEE);
      await expect(vault.proposeAlgebraFeeChange(ALGEBRA_FEE)).to.be.reverted;
      expect(await vault.proposedNewAlgebraFee()).to.be.eq(ALGEBRA_FEE);
      expect(await vault.hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal()).to.be.eq(true);

      await expect(vault.connect(other).cancelAlgebraFeeChangeProposal()).to.be.revertedWith(
        'only algebra fee manager'
      );
      await vault.cancelAlgebraFeeChangeProposal();

      expect(await vault.proposedNewAlgebraFee()).to.be.eq(0);
      expect(await vault.hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal()).to.be.eq(false);

      await vault.proposeAlgebraFeeChange(ALGEBRA_FEE);
      await vault.acceptAlgebraFeeChangeProposal(ALGEBRA_FEE);
      await expect(vault.proposeAlgebraFeeChange(ALGEBRA_FEE)).to.be.reverted;
```
## Description

`proposeAlgebraFeeChange` cannot create a zero-valued proposal when `algebraFee` is nonzero and no proposal is pending. In that state, `proposedNewAlgebraFee` is `0`, so the requirement that `newAlgebraFee != proposedNewAlgebraFee` rejects `newAlgebraFee == 0` before `hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal` is set. The contract already maintains `hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal` to distinguish a pending proposal from an empty proposal slot, but the duplicate-value check does not use it. Both acceptance and cancellation restore the proposal state to `(0, false)`, so they recreate the same blocked state. The proposal validation should only reject a value equal to `proposedNewAlgebraFee` when `hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal` is true, allowing zero to be represented as a valid pending proposal.
## Root cause

The duplicate-proposal guard treats the zero-valued `proposedNewAlgebraFee` sentinel as a pending proposal without conditioning the comparison on `hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal`.
## Impact

The fee manager cannot directly initiate the documented transition from a nonzero Algebra fee to `0`. Unless governance accepts an unrelated intermediate nonzero proposal, the Algebra portion of subsequent withdrawals continues to be routed to `algebraFeeReceiver`, including withdrawals of previously accumulated balances. This prevents timely retirement of an active fee configuration and can prolong unintended fee diversion.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { Wallet, getCreateAddress } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { AlgebraCommunityVault, AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable, AlgebraPoolDeployer, TestERC20 } from '../typechain';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { createEmptyFactoryProxy } from './shared/fixtures';

describe('PoC: zero-valued Algebra fee proposals cannot be created', () => {
  let wallet: Wallet;
  let algebraReceiver: Wallet;
  let communityReceiver: Wallet;

  const ACTIVE_ALGEBRA_FEE = 100n;
  const VAULT_BALANCE = 10n ** 18n;

  async function fixture() {
    const [deployer, other, third] = await (ethers as any).getSigners();
    wallet = deployer;
    algebraReceiver = other;
    communityReceiver = third;

    const poolDeployerAddress = getCreateAddress({
      from: deployer.address,
      nonce: (await ethers.provider.getTransactionCount(deployer.address)) + 1,
    });

    const factory = (await createEmptyFactoryProxy()) as AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable;
    await factory.initialize(poolDeployerAddress);

    const poolDeployerFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('AlgebraPoolDeployer');
    await poolDeployerFactory.deploy(factory) as any as AlgebraPoolDeployer;

    const vaultFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('AlgebraCommunityVault');
    const vault = (await vaultFactory.deploy(factory, deployer.address)) as any as AlgebraCommunityVault;

    const vaultFactoryStubFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('AlgebraVaultFactoryStub');
    const vaultFactoryStub = await vaultFactoryStubFactory.deploy(vault);
    await factory.setVaultFactory(vaultFactoryStub);

    const tokenFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('TestERC20');
    const token = (await tokenFactory.deploy(2n ** 255n)) as any as TestERC20;
    await token.transfer(vault, VAULT_BALANCE);

    return { vault, token };
  }

  it('blocks a direct nonzero-to-zero fee proposal and keeps routing withdrawals to Algebra receiver', async () => {
    const { vault, token } = await loadFixture(fixture);

    await vault.changeCommunityFeeReceiver(communityReceiver.address);
    await vault.changeAlgebraFeeReceiver(algebraReceiver.address);

    await vault.proposeAlgebraFeeChange(ACTIVE_ALGEBRA_FEE);
    await vault.acceptAlgebraFeeChangeProposal(ACTIVE_ALGEBRA_FEE);

    expect(await vault.algebraFee()).to.eq(ACTIVE_ALGEBRA_FEE);
    expect(await vault.proposedNewAlgebraFee()).to.eq(0n);
    expect(await vault.hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal()).to.eq(false);

    await expect(vault.proposeAlgebraFeeChange(0)).to.be.reverted;

    expect(await vault.algebraFee()).to.eq(ACTIVE_ALGEBRA_FEE);
    expect(await vault.proposedNewAlgebraFee()).to.eq(0n);
    expect(await vault.hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal()).to.eq(false);

    const vaultHeldBeforeWithdraw = await token.balanceOf(vault);
    const algebraBalanceBefore = await token.balanceOf(algebraReceiver.address);
    const communityBalanceBefore = await token.balanceOf(communityReceiver.address);

    await vault.withdraw(token, vaultHeldBeforeWithdraw);

    const algebraBalanceAfter = await token.balanceOf(algebraReceiver.address);
    const communityBalanceAfter = await token.balanceOf(communityReceiver.address);

    expect(algebraBalanceAfter).to.be.gt(algebraBalanceBefore);
    expect(communityBalanceAfter).to.be.gt(communityBalanceBefore);
    expect(communityBalanceAfter - communityBalanceBefore).to.be.lt(vaultHeldBeforeWithdraw);
    expect(await token.balanceOf(vault)).to.eq(0n);
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC ran successfully in the core Hardhat harness (`unit:cryptoalgebra-integral-core`). It invokes the real `AlgebraCommunityVault.proposeAlgebraFeeChange(0)` after a nonzero fee was accepted and the proposal slot was cleared, observes the revert, confirms the active nonzero fee and cleared proposal state remain unchanged, then withdraws real ERC-20 vault funds and proves part of the balance is still routed to `algebraFeeReceiver` instead of the full amount reaching `communityFeeReceiver`. The test demonstrates the direct nonzero-to-zero transition is blocked; it does not model off-chain governance latency or alternative multi-step nonzero intermediate proposals.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Condition the duplicate proposed-fee rejection on an active proposal, so a cleared zero sentinel no longer blocks proposing zero while preserving rejection of the current active fee and duplicate pending proposals.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol b/src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol
--- a/src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol
+++ b/src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol
@@ -1,149 +1,149 @@
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
 pragma solidity =0.8.20;
 
 import './libraries/SafeTransfer.sol';
 import './libraries/FullMath.sol';
 
 import './interfaces/IAlgebraFactory.sol';
 import './interfaces/vault/IAlgebraCommunityVault.sol';
 
 /// @title Algebra community fee vault
 /// @notice Community fee from pools is sent here, if it is enabled
 /// @dev Role system is used to withdraw tokens
 /// @dev Version: Algebra Integral 1.0
 contract AlgebraCommunityVault is IAlgebraCommunityVault {
   /// @dev The role can be granted in AlgebraFactory
   bytes32 public constant COMMUNITY_FEE_WITHDRAWER_ROLE = keccak256('COMMUNITY_FEE_WITHDRAWER');
   /// @dev The role can be granted in AlgebraFactory
   bytes32 public constant COMMUNITY_FEE_VAULT_ADMINISTRATOR = keccak256('COMMUNITY_FEE_VAULT_ADMINISTRATOR');
   address private immutable factory;
 
   /// @notice Address to which community fees are sent from vault
   address public communityFeeReceiver;
   /// @notice The percentage of the protocol fee that Algebra will receive
   /// @dev Value in thousandths,i.e. 1e-3
   uint16 public algebraFee;
   /// @notice Represents whether there is a new Algebra fee proposal or not
   bool public hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal;
   /// @notice Suggested Algebra fee value
   uint16 public proposedNewAlgebraFee;
   /// @notice Address of recipient Algebra part of community fee
   address public algebraFeeReceiver;
   /// @notice Address of Algebra fee manager
   address public algebraFeeManager;
   address private _pendingAlgebraFeeManager;
 
   uint16 private constant ALGEBRA_FEE_DENOMINATOR = 1000;
 
   modifier onlyAdministrator() {
     require(IAlgebraFactory(factory).hasRoleOrOwner(COMMUNITY_FEE_VAULT_ADMINISTRATOR, msg.sender), 'only administrator');
     _;
   }
 
   modifier onlyWithdrawer() {
     require(msg.sender == algebraFeeManager || IAlgebraFactory(factory).hasRoleOrOwner(COMMUNITY_FEE_WITHDRAWER_ROLE, msg.sender), 'only withdrawer');
     _;
   }
 
   modifier onlyAlgebraFeeManager() {
     require(msg.sender == algebraFeeManager, 'only algebra fee manager');
     _;
   }
 
   constructor(address _factory, address _algebraFeeManager) {
     (factory, algebraFeeManager) = (_factory, _algebraFeeManager);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function withdraw(address token, uint256 amount) external override onlyWithdrawer {
     (uint16 _algebraFee, address _algebraFeeReceiver, address _communityFeeReceiver) = _readAndVerifyWithdrawSettings();
     _withdraw(token, _communityFeeReceiver, amount, _algebraFee, _algebraFeeReceiver);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function withdrawTokens(WithdrawTokensParams[] calldata params) external override onlyWithdrawer {
     uint256 paramsLength = params.length;
     (uint16 _algebraFee, address _algebraFeeReceiver, address _communityFeeReceiver) = _readAndVerifyWithdrawSettings();
 
     unchecked {
       for (uint256 i; i < paramsLength; ++i) _withdraw(params[i].token, _communityFeeReceiver, params[i].amount, _algebraFee, _algebraFeeReceiver);
     }
   }
 
   function _readAndVerifyWithdrawSettings() private view returns (uint16 _algebraFee, address _algebraFeeReceiver, address _communityFeeReceiver) {
     (_algebraFee, _algebraFeeReceiver, _communityFeeReceiver) = (algebraFee, algebraFeeReceiver, communityFeeReceiver);
     if (_algebraFee != 0) require(_algebraFeeReceiver != address(0), 'invalid algebra fee receiver');
     require(_communityFeeReceiver != address(0), 'invalid receiver');
   }
 
   function _withdraw(address token, address to, uint256 amount, uint16 _algebraFee, address _algebraFeeReceiver) private {
     uint256 withdrawAmount = amount;
     if (_algebraFee != 0) {
       uint256 algebraFeeAmount = FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp(withdrawAmount, _algebraFee, ALGEBRA_FEE_DENOMINATOR);
       withdrawAmount -= algebraFeeAmount;
       SafeTransfer.safeTransfer(token, _algebraFeeReceiver, algebraFeeAmount);
       emit AlgebraTokensWithdrawal(token, _algebraFeeReceiver, algebraFeeAmount);
     }
 
     SafeTransfer.safeTransfer(token, to, withdrawAmount);
     emit TokensWithdrawal(token, to, withdrawAmount);
   }
 
   // ### algebra factory owner permissioned actions ###
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function acceptAlgebraFeeChangeProposal(uint16 newAlgebraFee) external override onlyAdministrator {
     require(hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal, 'not proposed');
     require(newAlgebraFee == proposedNewAlgebraFee, 'invalid new fee');
 
     // note that the new value will be used for previously accumulated tokens that have not yet been withdrawn
     algebraFee = newAlgebraFee;
     (proposedNewAlgebraFee, hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal) = (0, false);
     emit AlgebraFee(newAlgebraFee);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function changeCommunityFeeReceiver(address newCommunityFeeReceiver) external override onlyAdministrator {
     require(newCommunityFeeReceiver != address(0));
     require(newCommunityFeeReceiver != communityFeeReceiver);
     communityFeeReceiver = newCommunityFeeReceiver;
     emit CommunityFeeReceiver(newCommunityFeeReceiver);
   }
 
   // ### algebra fee manager permissioned actions ###
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function transferAlgebraFeeManagerRole(address _newAlgebraFeeManager) external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
     _pendingAlgebraFeeManager = _newAlgebraFeeManager;
     emit PendingAlgebraFeeManager(_newAlgebraFeeManager);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function acceptAlgebraFeeManagerRole() external override {
     require(msg.sender == _pendingAlgebraFeeManager);
     (_pendingAlgebraFeeManager, algebraFeeManager) = (address(0), msg.sender);
     emit AlgebraFeeManager(msg.sender);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function proposeAlgebraFeeChange(uint16 newAlgebraFee) external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
     require(newAlgebraFee <= ALGEBRA_FEE_DENOMINATOR);
-    require(newAlgebraFee != proposedNewAlgebraFee && newAlgebraFee != algebraFee);
+    require(newAlgebraFee != algebraFee && (!hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal || newAlgebraFee != proposedNewAlgebraFee));
     (proposedNewAlgebraFee, hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal) = (newAlgebraFee, true);
     emit AlgebraFeeProposal(newAlgebraFee);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function cancelAlgebraFeeChangeProposal() external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
     (proposedNewAlgebraFee, hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal) = (0, false);
     emit CancelAlgebraFeeProposal();
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function changeAlgebraFeeReceiver(address newAlgebraFeeReceiver) external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
     require(newAlgebraFeeReceiver != address(0));
     require(newAlgebraFeeReceiver != algebraFeeReceiver);
     algebraFeeReceiver = newAlgebraFeeReceiver;
     emit AlgebraFeeReceiver(newAlgebraFeeReceiver);
   }
 }

# Configured community receiver cannot use documented withdrawals
**#214912**
- Severity: Medium
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/core/contracts/interfaces/vault/IAlgebraCommunityVault.sol`
#### Lines 47-61 — _Interface documentation promises withdrawal by `communityFeeReceiver`._

```

  /// @dev Can only be called by algebraFeeManager or communityFeeReceiver

  /// @param amount The amount of token

    uint256 amount;

### `src/core/test/AlgebraVault.spec.ts`
#### Lines 181-203 — _Tests cover rejection of a non-role account but do not establish receiver authorization, leaving the interface/implementation mismatch untested._

## Description

The vault interface states that `algebraFeeManager` or `communityFeeReceiver` may call both `withdraw` and `withdrawTokens`. In contrast, `onlyWithdrawer` authorizes only `algebraFeeManager` and addresses recognized by the factory as the owner or as holding `COMMUNITY_FEE_WITHDRAWER_ROLE`. Neither withdrawal entry point adds a `msg.sender == communityFeeReceiver` check, and changing `communityFeeReceiver` merely stores the new nonzero address. Consequently, an administrator can configure a recipient that is unable to invoke the documented self-withdrawal path unless it separately receives the factory role. Tests cover rejection of an unrelated caller but do not verify withdrawal by a configured receiver without that role.
## Root cause

`onlyWithdrawer` implements factory-role-based authorization without including or synchronizing the configured `communityFeeReceiver` required by the interface.
## Impact

A configured community recipient can be unable to initiate payment of accrued community fees through `withdraw` or `withdrawTokens`. Its funds remain dependent on the availability and cooperation of `algebraFeeManager`, the factory owner, or a separately authorized role holder, rather than being claimable by the documented recipient.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import { AlgebraCommunityVault, AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable, TestERC20 } from '../typechain';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { createEmptyFactoryProxy } from './shared/fixtures';

describe('PoC: configured community receiver cannot use documented vault withdrawals', () => {
  const AMOUNT = 10n ** 18n;

  async function deployFixture(): Promise<{
    factory: AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable;
    vault: AlgebraCommunityVault;
    token0: TestERC20;
    token1: TestERC20;
  }> {
    const [deployer] = await ethers.getSigners();

    const factory = await createEmptyFactoryProxy();
    await factory.initialize(deployer.address);

    const vaultFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('AlgebraCommunityVault');
    const vault = (await vaultFactory.deploy(factory, deployer.address)) as any as AlgebraCommunityVault;

    const tokenFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('TestERC20');
    const token0 = (await tokenFactory.deploy(2n ** 255n)) as any as TestERC20;
    const token1 = (await tokenFactory.deploy(2n ** 255n)) as any as TestERC20;

    await token0.transfer(await vault.getAddress(), AMOUNT);
    await token1.transfer(await vault.getAddress(), AMOUNT);

    return { factory, vault, token0, token1 };
  }

  it('reverts for the configured receiver while a separate algebraFeeManager must trigger payment', async () => {
    const { factory, vault, token0, token1 } = await loadFixture(deployFixture);
    const [factoryOwnerAndInitialManager, configuredReceiver, replacementManager] = await ethers.getSigners();

    await vault.changeCommunityFeeReceiver(configuredReceiver.address);
    expect(await vault.communityFeeReceiver()).to.eq(configuredReceiver.address);

    await vault.transferAlgebraFeeManagerRole(replacementManager.address);
    await vault.connect(replacementManager).acceptAlgebraFeeManagerRole();
    expect(await vault.algebraFeeManager()).to.eq(replacementManager.address);

    const withdrawerRole = await vault.COMMUNITY_FEE_WITHDRAWER_ROLE();
    expect(await factory.hasRoleOrOwner(withdrawerRole, configuredReceiver.address)).to.eq(false);
    expect(configuredReceiver.address).to.not.eq(factoryOwnerAndInitialManager.address);
    expect(configuredReceiver.address).to.not.eq(replacementManager.address);

    const receiverToken0Before = await token0.balanceOf(configuredReceiver.address);
    const vaultToken0Before = await token0.balanceOf(await vault.getAddress());

    await expect(vault.connect(configuredReceiver).withdraw(token0, AMOUNT)).to.be.revertedWith('only withdrawer');

    expect(await token0.balanceOf(configuredReceiver.address)).to.eq(receiverToken0Before);
    expect(await token0.balanceOf(await vault.getAddress())).to.eq(vaultToken0Before);

    const receiverToken1Before = await token1.balanceOf(configuredReceiver.address);
    const vaultToken1Before = await token1.balanceOf(await vault.getAddress());

    await expect(
      vault.connect(configuredReceiver).withdrawTokens([
        {
          token: await token1.getAddress(),
          amount: AMOUNT,
        },
      ])
    ).to.be.revertedWith('only withdrawer');

    expect(await token1.balanceOf(configuredReceiver.address)).to.eq(receiverToken1Before);
    expect(await token1.balanceOf(await vault.getAddress())).to.eq(vaultToken1Before);

    await vault.connect(replacementManager).withdraw(token0, AMOUNT);
    expect(await token0.balanceOf(configuredReceiver.address)).to.eq(receiverToken0Before + AMOUNT);
    expect(await token0.balanceOf(await vault.getAddress())).to.eq(0n);

    await vault.connect(replacementManager).withdrawTokens([
      {
        token: await token1.getAddress(),
        amount: AMOUNT,
      },
    ]);
    expect(await token1.balanceOf(configuredReceiver.address)).to.eq(receiverToken1Before + AMOUNT);
    expect(await token1.balanceOf(await vault.getAddress())).to.eq(0n);
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC executed successfully in the core Hardhat unit harness against the real AlgebraCommunityVault implementation. It demonstrates the authorization/documentation mismatch for both withdraw and withdrawTokens with algebraFee disabled; it does not test the algebraFee-enabled split path because the failing gate is the same onlyWithdrawer modifier before fee-splitting logic.
### Validation reasoning

PoC validation command completed successfully.
## Remediation
### Explanation

Adds the configured communityFeeReceiver directly to the vault's withdrawal authorization, matching the interface while preserving existing algebra fee manager and factory role/owner access.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol b/src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol
--- a/src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol
+++ b/src/core/contracts/AlgebraCommunityVault.sol
@@ -1,149 +1,154 @@

 import './interfaces/vault/IAlgebraCommunityVault.sol';
 
 /// @title Algebra community fee vault
 /// @notice Community fee from pools is sent here, if it is enabled
 /// @dev Role system is used to withdraw tokens
 /// @dev Version: Algebra Integral 1.0
 contract AlgebraCommunityVault is IAlgebraCommunityVault {
   /// @dev The role can be granted in AlgebraFactory
   bytes32 public constant COMMUNITY_FEE_WITHDRAWER_ROLE = keccak256('COMMUNITY_FEE_WITHDRAWER');
   /// @dev The role can be granted in AlgebraFactory
   bytes32 public constant COMMUNITY_FEE_VAULT_ADMINISTRATOR = keccak256('COMMUNITY_FEE_VAULT_ADMINISTRATOR');
   address private immutable factory;

   address public communityFeeReceiver;
   /// @notice The percentage of the protocol fee that Algebra will receive
   /// @dev Value in thousandths,i.e. 1e-3
   uint16 public algebraFee;
   /// @notice Represents whether there is a new Algebra fee proposal or not
   bool public hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal;
   /// @notice Suggested Algebra fee value
   uint16 public proposedNewAlgebraFee;
   /// @notice Address of recipient Algebra part of community fee
   address public algebraFeeReceiver;
   /// @notice Address of Algebra fee manager
   address public algebraFeeManager;
   address private _pendingAlgebraFeeManager;
 
   uint16 private constant ALGEBRA_FEE_DENOMINATOR = 1000;
 
   modifier onlyAdministrator() {
     require(IAlgebraFactory(factory).hasRoleOrOwner(COMMUNITY_FEE_VAULT_ADMINISTRATOR, msg.sender), 'only administrator');
     _;
   }

-    require(msg.sender == algebraFeeManager || IAlgebraFactory(factory).hasRoleOrOwner(COMMUNITY_FEE_WITHDRAWER_ROLE, msg.sender), 'only withdrawer');
+    require(

   }
 
   modifier onlyAlgebraFeeManager() {

   constructor(address _factory, address _algebraFeeManager) {

   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function withdraw(address token, uint256 amount) external override onlyWithdrawer {
     (uint16 _algebraFee, address _algebraFeeReceiver, address _communityFeeReceiver) = _readAndVerifyWithdrawSettings();
     _withdraw(token, _communityFeeReceiver, amount, _algebraFee, _algebraFeeReceiver);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function withdrawTokens(WithdrawTokensParams[] calldata params) external override onlyWithdrawer {
     uint256 paramsLength = params.length;
     (uint16 _algebraFee, address _algebraFeeReceiver, address _communityFeeReceiver) = _readAndVerifyWithdrawSettings();
 
     unchecked {
       for (uint256 i; i < paramsLength; ++i) _withdraw(params[i].token, _communityFeeReceiver, params[i].amount, _algebraFee, _algebraFeeReceiver);
     }
   }
 
   function _readAndVerifyWithdrawSettings() private view returns (uint16 _algebraFee, address _algebraFeeReceiver, address _communityFeeReceiver) {
     (_algebraFee, _algebraFeeReceiver, _communityFeeReceiver) = (algebraFee, algebraFeeReceiver, communityFeeReceiver);
     if (_algebraFee != 0) require(_algebraFeeReceiver != address(0), 'invalid algebra fee receiver');
     require(_communityFeeReceiver != address(0), 'invalid receiver');
   }
 
   function _withdraw(address token, address to, uint256 amount, uint16 _algebraFee, address _algebraFeeReceiver) private {
     uint256 withdrawAmount = amount;
     if (_algebraFee != 0) {
       uint256 algebraFeeAmount = FullMath.mulDivRoundingUp(withdrawAmount, _algebraFee, ALGEBRA_FEE_DENOMINATOR);
       withdrawAmount -= algebraFeeAmount;
       SafeTransfer.safeTransfer(token, _algebraFeeReceiver, algebraFeeAmount);
       emit AlgebraTokensWithdrawal(token, _algebraFeeReceiver, algebraFeeAmount);
     }
 
     SafeTransfer.safeTransfer(token, to, withdrawAmount);
     emit TokensWithdrawal(token, to, withdrawAmount);
   }
 
   // ### algebra factory owner permissioned actions ###
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function acceptAlgebraFeeChangeProposal(uint16 newAlgebraFee) external override onlyAdministrator {
     require(hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal, 'not proposed');
     require(newAlgebraFee == proposedNewAlgebraFee, 'invalid new fee');
 
     // note that the new value will be used for previously accumulated tokens that have not yet been withdrawn
     algebraFee = newAlgebraFee;
     (proposedNewAlgebraFee, hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal) = (0, false);
     emit AlgebraFee(newAlgebraFee);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function changeCommunityFeeReceiver(address newCommunityFeeReceiver) external override onlyAdministrator {
     require(newCommunityFeeReceiver != address(0));
     require(newCommunityFeeReceiver != communityFeeReceiver);
     communityFeeReceiver = newCommunityFeeReceiver;
     emit CommunityFeeReceiver(newCommunityFeeReceiver);
   }
 
   // ### algebra fee manager permissioned actions ###
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function transferAlgebraFeeManagerRole(address _newAlgebraFeeManager) external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
     _pendingAlgebraFeeManager = _newAlgebraFeeManager;
     emit PendingAlgebraFeeManager(_newAlgebraFeeManager);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function acceptAlgebraFeeManagerRole() external override {
     require(msg.sender == _pendingAlgebraFeeManager);
     (_pendingAlgebraFeeManager, algebraFeeManager) = (address(0), msg.sender);
     emit AlgebraFeeManager(msg.sender);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function proposeAlgebraFeeChange(uint16 newAlgebraFee) external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
     require(newAlgebraFee <= ALGEBRA_FEE_DENOMINATOR);
     require(newAlgebraFee != proposedNewAlgebraFee && newAlgebraFee != algebraFee);
     (proposedNewAlgebraFee, hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal) = (newAlgebraFee, true);
     emit AlgebraFeeProposal(newAlgebraFee);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function cancelAlgebraFeeChangeProposal() external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
     (proposedNewAlgebraFee, hasNewAlgebraFeeProposal) = (0, false);
     emit CancelAlgebraFeeProposal();
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraCommunityVault
   function changeAlgebraFeeReceiver(address newAlgebraFeeReceiver) external override onlyAlgebraFeeManager {
     require(newAlgebraFeeReceiver != address(0));
     require(newAlgebraFeeReceiver != algebraFeeReceiver);
     algebraFeeReceiver = newAlgebraFeeReceiver;
     emit AlgebraFeeReceiver(newAlgebraFeeReceiver);
   }
 }

# Validate the immutable core-factory dependency
**#214914**
- Severity: Medium
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/plugin/contracts/BasePluginV1Factory.sol` (4 locations)
#### Lines 16-18 — _The Algebra factory dependency is immutable._

```

  address public immutable override algebraFactory;

```
⋯

### `src/core/contracts/AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.sol` (2 locations)
#### Lines 142-146 — _Classic pool creation reaches the default plugin factory before deploying the pool._

```
    address defaultPlugin;
    if (address(defaultPluginFactory) != address(0)) {
      defaultPlugin = defaultPluginFactory.createPlugin(computePoolAddress(token0, token1), token0, token1);
    }
    pool = IAlgebraPoolDeployer(poolDeployer).deploy(defaultPlugin, token0, token1, address(0));
```
⋯
#### Lines 227-231 — _Recovery requires replacing the registered plugin factory through an owner-only setter._

```
  /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraFactory
  function setDefaultPluginFactory(address newDefaultPluginFactory) external override onlyOwner {
    require(newDefaultPluginFactory != address(defaultPluginFactory));
    defaultPluginFactory = IAlgebraPluginFactory(newDefaultPluginFactory);
    emit DefaultPluginFactory(newDefaultPluginFactory);
```
## Description

`BasePluginV1Factory` commits `_algebraFactory` to immutable storage without checking that it is nonzero, code-bearing, compatible with `IAlgebraFactory`, and the intended trusted core-factory endpoint. The address is both the exact caller permitted by `createPlugin` and the external authorization and pool-lookup source used by `onlyAdministrator` and `createPluginForExistingPool`. Consequently, a zero, EOA, incompatible, or wrong factory address makes provisioning and administrative calls fail; with `address(0)`, no caller can satisfy `msg.sender == algebraFactory`. If this unusable instance is registered as `defaultPluginFactory`, `AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.createPool()` reverts while attempting to create the plugin, before deploying the pool. Because the dependency is immutable, the instance cannot be repaired in place; deployment must validate the endpoint before assignment, with the core configuration updated to a replacement if an invalid instance was registered.
## Root cause

The constructor assigns the immutable `algebraFactory` dependency without validating it as a nonzero, compatible, trusted Algebra factory contract.
## Impact

A configuration mistake can prevent classic pool creation for as long as the invalid plugin factory remains the core factory's default, and it disables plugin provisioning and administrator-controlled configuration on that instance. An endpoint that is not the intended authority can also supply the authorization results used for administrative operations, including beacon upgrades, allowing callers authorized by that endpoint to change plugin-wide configuration. The core owner can restore the integration by registering a valid replacement factory, but the immutable misconfigured deployment remains unusable.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { getCreateAddress } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import {
  abi as POOL_DEPLOYER_ABI,
  bytecode as POOL_DEPLOYER_BYTECODE,
} from '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/artifacts/contracts/AlgebraPoolDeployer.sol/AlgebraPoolDeployer.json';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { createEmptyFactoryProxy, tokensFixture } from './shared/externalFixtures';

describe('PoC immutable BasePluginV1Factory algebraFactory dependency', () => {
  async function factoryWithPoolDeployerFixture() {
    const [deployer] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const poolDeployerAddress = getCreateAddress({
      from: deployer.address,
      // createEmptyFactoryProxy deploys the factory implementation, ProxyAdmin, and proxy
      // before this fixture deploys the AlgebraPoolDeployer.
      nonce: (await ethers.provider.getTransactionCount(deployer.address)) + 4,
    });

    const factory = await createEmptyFactoryProxy();
    await factory.initialize(poolDeployerAddress);

    const poolDeployerFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory(POOL_DEPLOYER_ABI, POOL_DEPLOYER_BYTECODE);
    const poolDeployer = await poolDeployerFactory.deploy(factory);
    expect(await poolDeployer.getAddress()).to.eq(poolDeployerAddress);

    const pluginImplementation = await (await ethers.getContractFactory('AlgebraBasePluginV1')).deploy();
    const pluginFactoryFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory('BasePluginV1Factory');
    const validPluginFactory = await pluginFactoryFactory.deploy(factory, pluginImplementation.target);
    const zeroFactoryPluginFactory = await pluginFactoryFactory.deploy(ethers.ZeroAddress, pluginImplementation.target);

    return { factory, validPluginFactory, zeroFactoryPluginFactory };
  }

  it('lets an unchecked zero immutable factory brick default plugin provisioning and classic pool creation', async () => {
    const { factory, validPluginFactory, zeroFactoryPluginFactory } = await loadFixture(factoryWithPoolDeployerFixture);

    const { token0, token1 } = await tokensFixture();
    const token0Address = await token0.getAddress();
    const token1Address = await token1.getAddress();

    // Control: the same public factory entry point succeeds when the default plugin factory
    // was constructed with the real Algebra factory address.
    await factory.setDefaultPluginFactory(await validPluginFactory.getAddress());
    const controlPool = await factory.createPool.staticCall(token0Address, token1Address);
    await expect(factory.createPool(token0Address, token1Address)).to.emit(factory, 'Pool');
    expect(await factory.poolByPair(token0Address, token1Address)).to.eq(controlPool);
    expect(await validPluginFactory.pluginByPool(controlPool)).to.not.eq(ethers.ZeroAddress);

    const { token0: badToken0, token1: badToken1 } = await tokensFixture();
    const badToken0Address = await badToken0.getAddress();
    const badToken1Address = await badToken1.getAddress();
    const expectedBlockedPool = await factory.computePoolAddress(badToken0Address, badToken1Address);

    // Vulnerable configuration: the constructor accepted address(0) as the immutable factory,
    // and the core owner can register that unusable instance as the default plugin factory.
    await factory.setDefaultPluginFactory(await zeroFactoryPluginFactory.getAddress());
    expect(await factory.defaultPluginFactory()).to.eq(await zeroFactoryPluginFactory.getAddress());

    // Impact: any external caller using the real core factory to create a classic pool now
    // reverts inside BasePluginV1Factory.createPlugin because msg.sender can never equal address(0).
    await expect(factory.createPool(badToken0Address, badToken1Address)).to.be.revertedWithoutReason;

    // The failed provisioning happens before AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable deploys or records the pool,
    // leaving the pair uncreatable until the owner replaces the default plugin factory.
    expect(await factory.poolByPair(badToken0Address, badToken1Address)).to.eq(ethers.ZeroAddress);
    expect(await zeroFactoryPluginFactory.pluginByPool(expectedBlockedPool)).to.eq(ethers.ZeroAddress);

    // The same immutable dependency also bricks admin operations on that plugin factory instance:
    // onlyAdministrator dereferences IAlgebraFactory(address(0)) and cannot authorize anyone.
    await expect(zeroFactoryPluginFactory.setFarmingAddress(await validPluginFactory.getAddress())).to.be.revertedWithoutReason;
  });
});
```

### Considerations

PoC demonstrates the concrete zero-address immutable dependency variant. It proves deployment of the real BasePluginV1Factory with algebraFactory = address(0), registration of that instance as AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.defaultPluginFactory by the core owner, a real AlgebraFactoryUpgradeable.createPool() revert before pool registration, and bricked BasePluginV1Factory administrator access. It does not separately demonstrate EOA, incompatible-contract, or wrong-trusted-factory variants.

## Remediation
### Explanation

The constructor now rejects non-contract factory addresses and probes every IAlgebraFactory method used by this plugin factory (POOLS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE, hasRoleOrOwner, and poolByPair) before committing the immutable dependency, preventing zero, EOA, and incompatible endpoints from producing an irreparable deployment.
### Patch

```diff
diff --git a/src/plugin/contracts/BasePluginV1Factory.sol b/src/plugin/contracts/BasePluginV1Factory.sol
--- a/src/plugin/contracts/BasePluginV1Factory.sol
+++ b/src/plugin/contracts/BasePluginV1Factory.sol
@@ -1,127 +1,133 @@
 // SPDX-License-Identifier: BUSL-1.1
 pragma solidity =0.8.20;
 
 import '@openzeppelin/contracts/proxy/beacon/BeaconProxy.sol';
 import '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/contracts/interfaces/IAlgebraFactory.sol';
 import './interfaces/IBasePluginV1Factory.sol';
 import './libraries/AdaptiveFee.sol';
 import './interfaces/IAlgebraBasePluginV1.sol';
 
 /// @title Algebra Integral 1.0 default plugin factory
 /// @notice This contract creates Algebra default plugins for Algebra liquidity pools
 contract BasePluginV1Factory is IBasePluginV1Factory {
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   bytes32 public constant override ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_FACTORY_ADMINISTRATOR = keccak256('ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_FACTORY_ADMINISTRATOR');
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   address public immutable override algebraFactory;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   AlgebraFeeConfiguration public override defaultFeeConfiguration; // values of constants for sigmoids in fee calculation formula
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   address public override farmingAddress;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBeacon
   address public override implementation;
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   mapping(address poolAddress => address pluginAddress) public override pluginByPool;
 
   modifier onlyAdministrator() {
     require(IAlgebraFactory(algebraFactory).hasRoleOrOwner(ALGEBRA_BASE_PLUGIN_FACTORY_ADMINISTRATOR, msg.sender), 'Only administrator');
     _;
   }
 
   constructor(address _algebraFactory, address _basePluginV1Implementation) {
+    require(_algebraFactory.code.length != 0, 'Invalid algebra factory');
+    IAlgebraFactory factory = IAlgebraFactory(_algebraFactory);
+    bytes32 poolsAdministratorRole = factory.POOLS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE();
+    factory.hasRoleOrOwner(poolsAdministratorRole, address(this));
+    factory.poolByPair(address(0), address(0));
+
     algebraFactory = _algebraFactory;
     defaultFeeConfiguration = AdaptiveFee.initialFeeConfiguration();
 
     _setImplementation(_basePluginV1Implementation);
 
     emit DefaultFeeConfiguration(defaultFeeConfiguration);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IAlgebraPluginFactory
   function createPlugin(address pool, address, address) external override returns (address) {
     require(msg.sender == algebraFactory);
     return _createPlugin(pool);
   }
 
   /// @notice This factory does not support the custom pool creation hook flow.
   /// @dev BasePluginV1Factory was not developed for custom pool hooks. This implementation exists only to satisfy
   /// the updated IAlgebraPluginFactory interface, which includes hook methods for custom pool logic.
   function beforeCreatePoolHook(address, address, address, address, address, bytes calldata) external pure override returns (address) {
     revert('Hooks not supported');
   }
 
   /// @notice This factory does not support the custom pool creation hook flow.
   /// @dev BasePluginV1Factory was not developed for custom pool hooks. This implementation exists only to satisfy
   /// the updated IAlgebraPluginFactory interface, which includes hook methods for custom pool logic.
   function afterCreatePoolHook(address, address, address) external pure override {
     revert('Hooks not supported');
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   function createPluginForExistingPool(address token0, address token1) external override returns (address) {
     IAlgebraFactory factory = IAlgebraFactory(algebraFactory);
     require(factory.hasRoleOrOwner(factory.POOLS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE(), msg.sender));
 
     address pool = factory.poolByPair(token0, token1);
     require(pool != address(0), 'Pool not exist');
 
     return _createPlugin(pool);
   }
 
   function _createPlugin(address pool) internal returns (address) {
     require(pluginByPool[pool] == address(0), 'Already created');
     IAlgebraBasePluginV1 volatilityOracle = IAlgebraBasePluginV1(address(new BeaconProxy(address(this), '')));
     volatilityOracle.initialize(pool, algebraFactory, address(this));
     volatilityOracle.changeFeeConfiguration(defaultFeeConfiguration);
     pluginByPool[pool] = address(volatilityOracle);
     return address(volatilityOracle);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   function setDefaultFeeConfiguration(AlgebraFeeConfiguration calldata newConfig) external override onlyAdministrator {
     AdaptiveFee.validateFeeConfiguration(newConfig);
     defaultFeeConfiguration = newConfig;
     emit DefaultFeeConfiguration(newConfig);
   }
 
   /// @inheritdoc IBasePluginV1Factory
   function setFarmingAddress(address newFarmingAddress) external override onlyAdministrator {
     require(farmingAddress != newFarmingAddress);
     farmingAddress = newFarmingAddress;
     emit FarmingAddress(newFarmingAddress);
   }
 
   /**
    * @dev Upgrades the beacon to a new implementation.
    *
    * Emits an {Upgraded} event.
    *
    * Requirements:
    *
    * - msg.sender must be the plugin adminisrator.
    * - `newImplementation` must be a contract.
    */
   function upgradeTo(address newImplementation) external onlyAdministrator {
     _setImplementation(newImplementation);
   }
 
   /**
    * @dev Sets the implementation contract address for this beacon
    *
    * Requirements:
    *
    * - `newImplementation` must be a contract.
    */
   function _setImplementation(address newImplementation) private {
     if (newImplementation.code.length == 0) {
       revert BeaconInvalidImplementation(newImplementation);
     }
     implementation = newImplementation;
     emit Upgraded(newImplementation);
   }
 }

# Ownership transfers leave stale pool-deployment authority
**#214917**
- Severity: Medium
- Validity: Unreviewed
## Source locations
### `src/plugin/contracts/CustomPoolPluginFactory.sol` (3 locations)
#### Lines 60-73 — _Initialization grants `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and `CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER` to the initializer._ — _The initializer grants CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER to the initial caller._

```
  function initialize(address _factory, address _algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint, address _pluginImplementation) external initializer {
    require(_factory != address(0));
    require(_algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint != address(0));

    __AccessControlEnumerable_init();
    __Ownable2Step_init();

    factory = _factory;
    algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint = _algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint;
    defaultFeeConfiguration = AdaptiveFee.initialFeeConfiguration();

    _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, msg.sender);
    _grantRole(CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER, msg.sender);
    _setImplementation(_pluginImplementation);
```
⋯
#### Lines 83-105 — _Private-mode custom-pool deployment relies on `CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER`._ — _Private deployment checks the independent role rather than current ownership._

```
  function deployCustomPool(address tokenA, address tokenB, bytes calldata data) external returns (address customPool) {
    if (!isPublicPoolCreationMode) {
      _checkRole(CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER);
    }
    require(isWhitelistedToken[tokenA], 'TokenA not whitelisted');
    require(isWhitelistedToken[tokenB], 'TokenB not whitelisted');

    (address token0, address token1) = _sortTokens(tokenA, tokenB);
    address expectedPool = IAlgebraFactory(factory).computeCustomPoolAddress(address(this), token0, token1);
    require(_pendingCustomPoolByAddress[expectedPool].creator == address(0), 'Pool creation pending');

    _pendingCustomPoolByAddress[expectedPool] = PendingCustomPool({
      creator: msg.sender,
      token0: token0,
      token1: token1,
      plugin: address(0),
      dataHash: keccak256(data)
    });

    customPool = IAlgebraCustomPoolEntryPoint(algebraCustomPoolEntryPoint).createCustomPool(address(this), msg.sender, tokenA, tokenB, data);
    require(customPool == expectedPool, 'Invalid custom pool');
    require(isCustomPool[customPool], 'Custom pool hook missing');
  }
```
⋯
#### Lines 237-244 — _Ownership transfer synchronizes only `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, not `CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER`._

```
  /// @dev Transfers ownership of the contract to a new account.
  function _transferOwnership(address newOwner) internal override {
    _revokeRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, owner());
    super._transferOwnership(newOwner);
    if (owner() != address(0)) {
      _grantRole(DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE, owner());
    }
  }
```
## Description

The initializer grants both `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` and `CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER` to its caller. However, `_transferOwnership` migrates only `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE`, leaving `CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER` assigned to the former owner and not automatically granting it to the successor. When public creation mode is disabled, `deployCustomPool` authorizes callers through `CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER` rather than current ownership. Consequently, a former owner can continue deploying pools for whitelisted token pairs after ownership changes. The ownership-transfer path should explicitly revoke the owner-derived deployer role from the prior owner and assign it to the new owner where that role is intended to follow ownership, including the renouncement case.
## Root cause

`_transferOwnership` synchronizes `DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE` but does not revoke or reassign the independently granted `CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER` role.
## Impact

A former owner can create unwanted custom pools and occupy deterministic pool slots for selected whitelisted token pairs after an authority handover. This can prevent the new owner from deploying its intended pool for an affected pair until the stale role is revoked, and a renounced factory may retain the stale deployment authority without a default administrator to remove it.
## Proof of concept
### Test case

```
import { getCreateAddress } from 'ethers';
import { ethers } from 'hardhat';
import { loadFixture } from '@nomicfoundation/hardhat-network-helpers';
import {
  abi as POOL_DEPLOYER_ABI,
  bytecode as POOL_DEPLOYER_BYTECODE,
} from '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/artifacts/contracts/AlgebraPoolDeployer.sol/AlgebraPoolDeployer.json';
import {
  abi as ENTRY_POINT_ABI,
  bytecode as ENTRY_POINT_BYTECODE,
} from '@cryptoalgebra/integral-periphery/artifacts/contracts/AlgebraCustomPoolEntryPoint.sol/AlgebraCustomPoolEntryPoint.json';
import {
  abi as PROXY_ADMIN_ABI,
  bytecode as PROXY_ADMIN_BYTECODE,
} from '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/artifacts/@openzeppelin/contracts/proxy/transparent/ProxyAdmin.sol/ProxyAdmin.json';
import { expect } from './shared/expect';
import { createEmptyFactoryProxy, tokensFixture } from './shared/externalFixtures';

const transparentUpgradeableProxyArtifact = require(
  '@cryptoalgebra/integral-core/artifacts/@openzeppelin/contracts/proxy/transparent/' +
    'TransparentUpgradeableProxy.sol/TransparentUpgradeableProxy.json'
);
const { abi: TransparentUpgradeableProxy_ABI, bytecode: TransparentUpgradeableProxy_BYTECODE } = transparentUpgradeableProxyArtifact;

describe('PoC: CustomPoolPluginFactory stale deployment authority', () => {
  async function customPoolPluginFixture() {
    const { token0, token1 } = await tokensFixture();
    const [initialOwner, newOwner] = await ethers.getSigners();
    const poolDeployerAddress = getCreateAddress({
      from: initialOwner.address,
      nonce: (await ethers.provider.getTransactionCount(initialOwner.address)) + 4,
    });

    const factory = await createEmptyFactoryProxy();
    await factory.initialize(poolDeployerAddress);

    const poolDeployerFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory(POOL_DEPLOYER_ABI, POOL_DEPLOYER_BYTECODE);
    await poolDeployerFactory.deploy(factory);

    const entryPointFactory = await ethers.getContractFactory(ENTRY_POINT_ABI, ENTRY_POINT_BYTECODE);
    const entryPoint = await entryPointFactory.deploy(factory);
    await factory.grantRole(await factory.CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER(), entryPoint);
    await factory.grantRole(await factory.POOLS_ADMINISTRATOR_ROLE(), entryPoint);

    const pluginImplementation = await (await ethers.getContractFactory('AlgebraBasePluginV1')).deploy();
    const customFactoryImplementation = await (await ethers.getContractFactory('CustomPoolPluginFactory')).deploy();
    const proxyAdmin = await (await ethers.getContractFactory(PROXY_ADMIN_ABI, PROXY_ADMIN_BYTECODE)).deploy();
    const customFactoryProxy = await (
      await ethers.getContractFactory(TransparentUpgradeableProxy_ABI, TransparentUpgradeableProxy_BYTECODE)
    ).deploy(customFactoryImplementation.target, proxyAdmin.target, '0x');
    const customFactory = await ethers.getContractAt('CustomPoolPluginFactory', customFactoryProxy.target);

    await customFactory.initialize(factory, entryPoint, pluginImplementation);
    await entryPoint.setCustomPoolDeployer(await customFactory.getAddress(), true);

    const token0Address = await token0.getAddress();
    const token1Address = await token1.getAddress();
    await customFactory.setTokenWhitelistBatch([token0Address, token1Address], true);

    return { initialOwner, newOwner, token0Address, token1Address, factory, customFactory };
  }

  it('lets the former owner deploy and occupy a whitelisted custom-pool slot after ownership is handed over', async () => {
    const { initialOwner, newOwner, token0Address, token1Address, factory, customFactory } = await loadFixture(customPoolPluginFixture);

    const customPoolDeployerRole = await customFactory.CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER();
    const defaultAdminRole = await customFactory.DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE();
    expect(await customFactory.isPublicPoolCreationMode()).to.eq(false);

    await customFactory.transferOwnership(newOwner.address);
    await customFactory.connect(newOwner).acceptOwnership();

    expect(await customFactory.owner()).to.eq(newOwner.address);
    expect(await customFactory.hasRole(defaultAdminRole, initialOwner.address)).to.eq(false);
    expect(await customFactory.hasRole(defaultAdminRole, newOwner.address)).to.eq(true);

    // Vulnerability: the ownership handover did not migrate the owner-derived deployment role.
    expect(await customFactory.hasRole(customPoolDeployerRole, initialOwner.address)).to.eq(true);
    expect(await customFactory.hasRole(customPoolDeployerRole, newOwner.address)).to.eq(false);

    const expectedPool = await factory.computeCustomPoolAddress(await customFactory.getAddress(), token0Address, token1Address);

    await expect(customFactory.connect(initialOwner).deployCustomPool(token1Address, token0Address, '0xabcd')).to.emit(factory, 'CustomPool');

    expect(await customFactory.isCustomPool(expectedPool)).to.eq(true);
    expect(await factory.customPoolByPair(await customFactory.getAddress(), token0Address, token1Address)).to.eq(expectedPool);
    expect(await factory.customPoolByPair(await customFactory.getAddress(), token1Address, token0Address)).to.eq(expectedPool);
    expect(await customFactory.pluginByPool(expectedPool)).to.not.eq(ethers.ZeroAddress);

    // The new owner can administer roles, but cannot replace the occupied deterministic pair slot.
    await customFactory.connect(newOwner).grantRole(customPoolDeployerRole, newOwner.address);
    await expect(customFactory.connect(newOwner).deployCustomPool(token0Address, token1Address, '0x1234')).to.be.revertedWithoutReason;
  });

  it('also leaves the stale deployer active after ownership is renounced with no default admin left to revoke it', async () => {
    const { initialOwner, token0Address, token1Address, factory, customFactory } = await loadFixture(customPoolPluginFixture);

    const customPoolDeployerRole = await customFactory.CUSTOM_POOL_DEPLOYER();
    const defaultAdminRole = await customFactory.DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE();
    const expectedPool = await factory.computeCustomPoolAddress(await customFactory.getAddress(), token0Address, token1Address);

    await customFactory.renounceOwnership();

    expect(await customFactory.owner()).to.eq(ethers.ZeroAddress);
    expect(await customFactory.getRoleMemberCount(defaultAdminRole)).to.eq(0);
    expect(await customFactory.hasRole(customPoolDeployerRole, initialOwner.address)).to.eq(true);

    await customFactory.connect(initialOwner).deployCustomPool(token0Address, token1Address, '0xfeed');

    expect(await customFactory.isCustomPool(expectedPool)).to.eq(true);
    expect(await factory.customPoolByPair(await customFactory.getAddress(), token0Address, token1Address)).to.eq(expectedPool);
  });
});
